name: Against All Odds
description: For each combat tag you have on your character, increase your damage by 2% (max of 14%).

name: Emergency Reserves
description: When you get hit below 20% health, gain 20% tempo immediately.
additionalInfo: 3 minute cooldown.

name: Unswayed
description: The effects of Taunt and Encore no longer work on you.
additionalInfo: The Taunt Mantra and Cornered Fool no longer work on you. Sing will still Charm you.

name: Kick Off
description: You easily brush off shorter falls, taking no damage. Your first wall jump will always send you higher than normal. Gain a speed boost after wall jumping over a wall.
additionalInfo: Falls are considered to be 10 studs shorter, reducing fall damage. Climb height is increased by 15% with a 3s CD. Slide jumping further increases climb height.

name: Steady Footing
description: You're much more resistant to being pushed around.
additionalInfo: Knockback is reduced by 20%. Ice's slide distance effect is removed.

name: Time To Go
description: Taking a life grants a speed boost for 10 seconds. Taking a player's life doubles the speed boost and the duration.

name: An Ironsinger's Instinct
description: Successfully dodging an attack coats you in metal and reduces the damage of the next attack taken.
additionalInfo: Grants 60% damage reduction for 2 seconds. Ends early if you take damage. 18 second cooldown.

name: Exposed Durability
description: Deal 10% more damage to opponents with no armor durability left.
additionalInfo: Procs against Berserk users and while Berserk is active.

name: Phantom Edge
description: Your weapon M1's have +0.25 range.

name: Everchanging Aegis
description: You take 20% less from attacks the same element as the last element you were hit with, but 10% more damage from attacks from different element.
additionalInfo: Your Aegis type can swap on block, dodge, and parry.

name: Neural Overload
description: You can input up to 4 copies of each Mantra ingredient instead of being limited to 3.

name: Overflowing Dam
description: Having full Ether for 2 seconds or more grants an aura to your attacks that grant them 10% more damage.
additionalInfo: For every point of Intelligence below 40, Overflowing Dam's damage bonus will be reduced by 0.125%, having a minimum damage buff of 6.875% at 15 Intelligence.

name: Perfect Flash
description: Having over 95% health causes your mantras to do +25% damage. This damage bonus will scale down to 10% if your enemies are far away.

name: Wyvern's Claw
description: You deal 10% more damage while airborne. Mantras receive a 5% damage increase instead.
additionalInfo: Activates after not being in contact with a grounded surface for ~0.75 seconds.

name: Aerogliding
description: When falling from a high place, hold spacebar to generate wind currents until you hit the floor. Also gives you more airtime with Gliders.
additionalInfo: When active, create an aura that reduces fall speed and stops fall damage. Automatically ends after 5 seconds. The altitude loss while gliding is significantly reduced. This effect stacks with Tiran's Feathered Glider.

name: Gale Trap
description: Knocking a player places a wind trap, causing anyone to pick up that body to get sent flying. Gain a speed boost picking up the body yourself. Killing PvE opponents gives you Gale Reflection instead.
additionalInfo: Marks players knocked by you for 6s with "Gale Trap". If the user picks up a target they've marked, they will gain a 35% speed boost for 20 seconds. But if anyone else attempts to pick up the marked target, they will be ragdolled and flung upwards. This includes the user's allies. Gale Reflection activates upon getting hit by an enemy, granting damage reduction to the attack and placing a Gale Trap on them. The damage of the Gale Trap scales with the strength of the enemy you killed.

name: Suffocating Impact
description: When flourishing enemies into walls they are suffocated and winded for a short duration.

name: Stifled Jump
description: Suffocating now applies Dazed if enemies jump. Suffocated PvE enemies now also get Sluggish when they are suffocated.
additionalInfo: The daze effect lasts for 1 second.

name: Apothecary
description: Potions you prepare will have amplified positive effects when consumed, and amplified negative effects when thrown.
additionalInfo: Additively increases potion Potency by 125%. Acts similarly to a potion ingredient, remaining active if you no longer have the Talent.

name: Chain Reaction
description: When applying a potion effect to someone who already has one, the new effect is amplified. You have a 25% chance not to deplete potions when drinking them.
additionalInfo: Procs when a thrown potion replaces a different potion's effect, increasing your potion's effect by 40% multiplicatively.

name: Placebo Effect
description: Drinking potions near allies will share the potion's effect with them.
additionalInfo: Also procs potion sickness, causing allies to throw up upon usage if they've ingested a potion recently.

name: Potion Quaffer
description: You're accustomed to drinking toxic fluids quickly. You'll get along famously with the other patrons at the tavern. Drinking potions slows less and grants superior regenerative effects to you.
additionalInfo: Drink potions 30% faster. Increases the effectiveness of Health Regeneration potions by 15%, Sanity Restoration and Ether Regeneration potions by 30%, and removes the -25% effectiveness Instant Health potions have.

name: Endurance Runner
description: Your speed is decreased less by low health.

name: Scaredy Cat
description: When enemies initiate a fight first, gain a speed boost.

name: Conditioned Runner
description: You regenerate health faster than normal when sprinting below 75% HP. The health amount scales with your agility stat.
additionalInfo: After 3 seconds of sprinting without taking damage, gain increased health regeneration.  The increased health regeneration is equal to +(Agility × 2)% health regen, having no bonus at 0 Agility, and scaling up to +200% at 100 Agility. This Talent is disabled in Chime of Conflict.

name: Approaching Singularity
description: You now gain +1% Mantra PEN for every 10 point of Intelligence.
additionalInfo: Gives 0.1% Mantra PEN per point in Intelligence.

name: Flame Within
description: An application of Pleeksty's concept of the inner flame, also known as the soul of man. Set yourself ablaze to gain more move speed and 10% extra damage.
additionalInfo: 8 second cooldown on cast. The self burn can only be dispelled by using the tool again or through the rain/sea.

name: Proficient Baiting
description: Casting your line excites ocean life, reducing the chances of fishing up trash.
additionalInfo: Reduces the likelihood of fishing up trash items such as Seaweed or Leather Boots.

name: Hook, Line, and Sinker
description: Once something's caught your line, it's much harder to get loose.
additionalInfo: Slightly increases margin of failure before losing a fish.

name: Fisher's Lure
description: Fish are drawn to your line more quickly.
additionalInfo: Slightly increases the chance of hooking something while fishing.

name: Collapsed Lung
description: Block breaking an opponent closes off their ability to Vent for 8s, with this duration scaling with Strength. PvE enemies instead get Collapsed.
additionalInfo: This effect lasts 8 seconds and loses 0.04s for every investment point below 100 Strength. The Collapsed status effect reduces the posture damage affected enemies deal to you by 40%.

name: Carnivore
description: In return for losing the ability to eat vegetation, satiate your hunger by killing others.
additionalInfo: Cannot be obtained if you have the Vegetarian Flaw.

name: Grand Feast
description: Regain tempo, ether, blood and health when gaining hunger from killing.
additionalInfo: Health gain is disabled in PvP combat. On proc, gain 40% tempo, 55% Ether, 3% blood, and 5% health.

name: Sunken Predator
description: Enemies you hit in the water or the depths have their speed buffs nullified and are slowed.

name: Oath: Arcwarder
description: You vow to be a shield for your comrades, to wear your regalia with pride and serve the greater collective. From each according to their ability, to each according to their needs.

name: Arc Module: Dash
description: [In Arc Suit] Your dashes become Jet Dashes, allowing you to attack while dashing.
additionalInfo: Jet dashes go much further than regular dashes. Also allows the user to M1 while performing a dash, ending their dash early.

name: Arc Module: Eject
description: [In Arc Suit] When blockbroken, eject from your suit.
additionalInfo: Your posture will be set to 50% on activation.

name: Arc Module: Enhance
description: [In Arc Suit] Your Arcwarder Mantras deal increased damage.
additionalInfo: Arc Beam's base dmg is increased by 50%, Arc Wave's base damage is increased by 25%.

name: Arc Module: Guard
description: [In Arc Suit] You can block attacks from any direction and cannot be backstabbed.
additionalInfo: Prevents "backhit" Talents from proccing and grants 360 block against all attacks.

name: Arc Module: Leap
description: [In Arc Suit] Holding Spacebar after double jumping propels you up for a short duration.
additionalInfo: 10 second CD outside of combat, 15 second CD in combat.

name: Arc Module: Null
description: [In Arc Suit] Outgoing and incoming enchant effects are nullified. Can be toggled with N.

name: Master Craftsman
description: Your skills alone substitute the need for a Craft Station.
additionalInfo: You can craft items that normally require a Crafting Station from your inventory.

name: Deep Wound
description: Assassinating a target applies anti-heal for 20s and gives you a speed boost for 6s. Assassination damage now scales with level against mobs.
additionalInfo: Applies 30% anti-heal.

name: Lights Out
description: Assassinations now give you 30% PEN and blind the target for 5s. Those you carry are now blindfolded.

name: Lowstride
description: When crouching, your stealth and roll distance are increased. Your speed while crouching is less slow. You now draw your weapon silently.
additionalInfo: Doubles the stealth bonuses from crouching; stealth × 1.5 + 50 -> stealth × 2 + 100. Also silences the sheathe sound effect.

name: Unseen Threat
description: You can assassinate those with weapons out provided you're not in combat yourself. Those you assassinate are slowed and unable to jump for 3s.

name: Authority Intimidation
description: Lightning moves slow your opponent more.

name: Resolve Crusher
description: Lightning moves now apply stacks of 'Resolve Crusher'. At 4 stacks, you apply 'Electrified' to your opponent. Attacks from Electrified opponents are converted into lightning damage, but will deal 10% less damage to you.
additionalInfo: Resolve Crusher's "Electrified" effect is only applied after the 5th stack (not the 4th stated by the Talent). Each stack lasts for 5 seconds. Electrified lasts for 5 seconds. Damage debuff only applies against weapon attacks.

name: First Interrogation
description: Attacks from opponents who are Electrified will give you ether proportional to their initial damage.
additionalInfo: Only procs on weapon attacks from Electrified opponents. Ether given is half of their scaled damage.

name: Second Interrogation
description: Attacks from Electrified opponents deal 50% less damage and 50% less posture damage to you.
additionalInfo: Does not stack with Resolve Crusher's damage reduction, instead it replaces it with this, more potent, effect. Only applies against weapon attacks.

name: Horn of Authority
description: Mark escaping prisoners.

name: Authority Ensign
description: You are a member of the Authority deployed to the Eastern Luminant. You may find trouble with the local factions and must become stronger through advancing the Authority's position.

name: Battle Tendency
description: You can breathe more easily with +20% faster posture regen.
additionalInfo: This only affects passive posture regeneration.

name: Braced Collapse
description: After being block broken, the next attack to hit you deals reduced damage.
additionalInfo: After being block broken, reduce the next instance of damage by 20%. This has no cooldown.

name: Moving Fortress
description: Blocking no longer slows you down as much.
additionalInfo: Increases your movement speed while blocking by 5%, from -25% movement speed to -20%.

name: Perseverance
description: Reduces the duration you're Ragdolled and Unconscious for by 25%.
additionalInfo: This can stack with other Talents to reduce knock time even further. (Ex. Defiance)

name: Reinforced Armor
description: Incoming PEN is reduced by 30%.
additionalInfo: Loses 0.8% PEN resistance per point below 90 Fortitude, capping at 10% PEN resistance at 65 Fortitude.

name: Armored Plating
description: Put on extra plating on your armor, giving you 50 temp health whenever you are put in combat. Due to the weight of this additional plating, you have reduced speed at all times.

name: Crossguard
description: If you are using a sword, you gain 10% chip against other opponents wielding swords.
additionalInfo: This is additive to weapon chip damage.

name: Riot Shield
description: While you are fighting two or more opponents and are using a shield, reduce the total amount of chip damage you take by 40%.
additionalInfo: Grants 40% damage reduction to chip damage, does not reduce your opponent's chip % by 40.

name: Oppressive Force
description: When using a weapon found in the Merit Armory, gain a unique two-hit flourish that does not knock back opponents and dazes them.
additionalInfo: The first hit deals your regular M1 damage and posture damage, the second hit deals 80% of your weapon's scaled damage with 7 posture damage. The damage and posture damage of the second hit cannot be buffed. The second hit does not count as a weapon attack, and therefore it does not benefit from any of your weapon's stats and cannot proc Talent effects.

name: Steel Tread
description: Gain a bit of knockback resistance as well as damage resistance against attacks that ragdoll you.

name: Oath: Blindseer
description: You vow to not let the horrors of the world pierce your tightly fastened blindfold. Everything is simply as we choose to perceive it.
additionalInfo: You can now see while blinded, but the world gains a blue hue.

name: All-Seeing Eye
description: The mystic eye through which you now see the world can perceive the imperceptible. Invisible foes are highlighted.
additionalInfo: Invisible players, including yourself, and monsters are revealed by a Blindseer Eye icon showcasing their current position.

name: Berserk
description: One with nothing to lose has everything to gain. Succumb to burning rage within and enter Berserk State.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that, while active, turns all incoming damage into true damage, but gives you increased melee PEN. You gain increased PEN on your light attacks, scaling on how low your health is, and +10% PEN on your critical attacks. The PEN gained on light attacks in PvP does not bypass the PEN cap, and requires Million Ton Piercer to go over +50%. In PvE, gain +100% PEN on your M1s instead. Lasts 20 seconds, halved to 10 if you do not meet the Talent requirements.

name: Oath: Bladeharper
description: You vow to carry your blades as an instrument, to lend yourself to any cause it guides you to. Collapse the infinite number of possibilities ahead of you into just one. The blade keeps you as much as you keep it.

name: Float Like a Butterfly
description: While having True Strength active, cancel your air dash to enter a frenzy of slashes.
additionalInfo: 5s CD. Only accessible if True Strength is active. Deals 24 Oath + Slash damage (4 hits that deal 7 damage each).

name: Lithe Step
description: When Sprinting, roll-cancel and instantly vanish and surge with unmatched speed.
additionalInfo: Provides a brief speed boost on proc. 3s CD, reduced to 1s if in True Strength.

name: Reveal
description: Pour your heart out, and reveal your true strength.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that activates True Strength on use. While active, you will passively accumulate Wither. Reveal will automatically end if your health goes below 10%.

name: Soaring Storm
description: Empower your uppercuts with the way of the blade, after Lithe Stepping, flourishing, or landing an Oath ability.
additionalInfo: Proc condition is removed and damage is increased if in True Strength. Applies to all forms of uppercuts, including Mantras and certain weapon criticals. Deals 24 Oath + Slash damage (6 hits that deal 4 damage each), this is increased to 39 damage (6 hits that deal 6.5 damage each) if you are in True Strength.

name: Untouchable
description: By landing consecutive hits on your opponent without taking any damage, reveal your True Strength for a short duration.
additionalInfo: Grants True Strength for 15 seconds on proc. Untouchable requires 10 'Untouchable Stacks'. Being hit by any non-self damage source will reset all Untouchable Stacks. Weapon attacks give 2 stacks each, and non-weapon attacks give 1 stack each.

name: Oath: Blightsurger
description: Fists and storm. Wield sacred lightning, tear through foes and leave them withered.

name: Anchor Shock
description: Your Blightshock prevents targets from using mobility mantras.

objectives: Use Sovereign State while in combat 67 times

additionalInfo: This puts your opponent's mobility slot Mantras on a 3 second cooldown whenever Blightshock is applied from a Blightsurger Mantra.

name: Blight Pierce
description: Your Blightshock attacks pierce through your enemies hyperarmor and gain more penetration.

objectives: Use Sovereign State while in combat 37 times

additionalInfo: Blightshock now works similar to regular Shock, canceling hyperarmor.

name: Blighted Touch
description: Landing Basic Attacks during Sovereign State now applies Blightshock.

objectives: Use Sovereign State while in combat 22 times

additionalInfo: This allows your Sovereign Bangle to apply Wither on hit.

name: Blightlash
description: Your swing range is enhanced during Sovereign State.

objectives: Use Sovereign State while in combat 82 times

additionalInfo: Increases the range of the Sovereign Bangle from 6 to 7.

name: Sovereign State
description: Landing physical hits builds your Blight Meter. At full gauge, enter a Blight State that changes your critical and empowers Blightsurge abilities.
additionalInfo: Landing Galebreathe Mantras, Thundercall Mantras, weapon attacks, and Blightsurger Mantras gives Blight Meter. Press [X] while having at least 30% Blight Meter to enter the Sovereign State. Your weapon is replaced with Sovereign Bangle and the Wither applied on Blightsurger Mantras is increased while in Sovereign State.

name: Bloodwarden's Sense
description: Enemies you attack with a mantra above 60% Blood Poisoning are marked with Bloodwarden's Mark for 5s.
additionalInfo: Adds a red highlight to the player and makes them take 20% more Blood Poisoning.

name: Smell of Blood
description: Enemies that touch your blood pools or are blockbroken by you are afflicted with Bloodscent for 6s.
additionalInfo: Your opponent's blood (or blood hemorrhaging in PvE) percentage is shown as a red number, and their blood poison percentage is shown as a pink number next to their character on proc.

name: Bloodrend Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Bloodrend to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Bloodrend Attribute. This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Bloodrender
description: Grants you the ability to command Blood as a Bloodrender. Your Bloodrend mantras replenish your blood, steal blood and apply 'Blood Poisoning'.

name: Adept Bloodrender
description: You can now obtain 1-star Bloodrender mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Expert Bloodrender
description: You can now obtain 2-star Bloodrender mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Master Bloodrender
description: You can now obtain 3-star Bloodrender mantras. Your maximum blood capacity is 25% more than a normal individual. You regen blood at a quicker pace.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Crimson Fountain
description: Blockbreaking or flourishing an enemy now spills a pool of blood below them. Blood mantras cast within blood pools have a reduced blood cost.

name: First Blood
description: Your first blood mantra you use in combat has no blood cost and deals additional blood drain .

name: Hemorrhaging Blow
description: Block breaking your opponent with a blood mantra turns your opponent's combat healing into damage for 8 seconds.
additionalInfo: The damage to healing conversion is 1:1, meaning 20 healing = 20 damage. Works on all non-passive healing. 55 second cooldown, starting once the guardbreak occurs.

name: Rush Hour
description: Stab yourself to become stronger, faster, and deal increased blood bar damage.
additionalInfo: Use the Rush Hour tool to gain the Rush Hour status effect, granting a 30% speed boost, a 15% damage buff, and an increase to blood damage. This passively drains the user's health and blood while active. Recover 5% blood whenever you land an attack.

name: Sanguine Siphon
description: Landing a critical attack while in a blood pool will consume that pool and empower your next blood mantra.
additionalInfo: Grants a 20% damage buff to the next Mantra cast.

name: Blood and Iron
description: Pulling rods out of your opponent now replenishes an equivalent amount of blood.

name: Brain Death
description: Enemies that are already suffocated will have their suffocation duration extended when hit by a bloodrend mantra.
additionalInfo: Applies a new stack of suffocation on proc.

name: Cold Blooded
description: Chilled enemies passively build up blood poison, alternatively when crystals explode it'll apply blood poison. (DOES NOT STACK)
additionalInfo: Applies 12.5% blood poisoning over the duration of the chill or 25% blood poisoning on crystal explosion. Only crystal explosions applied through maximizing crystal stacks will proc this Talent.

name: Electrolyte
description: Hitting Bloodrend mantras while having temporary health applies Shocked while removing a portion of temporary health.
additionalInfo: Applies a Surge Rod instead if you have Surge Path. Consumes 4 Temporary Health on proc.

name: Malevolent Sapper
description: The more blood poisoning your opponent has, the more ether your shadow mantras steal from your opponent.

name: Bruiser's Mixup
description: Switching your Fist Style mid-fight makes your basic Fist attacks inflict bleed temporarily.
additionalInfo: Lasts for 4 seconds.

name: Impairing Blow
description: [Greataxes] Basic Attacks will slightly slow your enemy for 2 seconds. Running attacks will slow your enemy for 3 seconds. Gain +20% posture damage against enemies with speed boosts.
additionalInfo: Does not proc on uppercut.

name: Brazen Blow
description: [Greataxes] Attacking an enemy slowed by your Greataxe grants you temporary hyperarmor.
additionalInfo: Only procs on weapon attacks. Does not proc on uppercut. 20 second cooldown.

name: Heavy Fatigue
description: [Greataxes] Hitting an enemy slowed by your Greataxe temporarily reduces how far they can roll and applies Sluggish to PvE enemies for a few seconds.
additionalInfo: Does not proc on uppercut.

name: Rending Impact
description: [Greataxes] Block breaking an enemy applies knockdown.
additionalInfo: Only procs on guardbreaks from weapon attacks. Applies knockdown for 1.2s.

name: Defensive Reprisal
description: Being flourished grants you 10% posture resistance for 20s.
additionalInfo: Defensive Reprisal's duration will be reduced by 0.177s for every point in Fortitude below its requirements, having a minimum duration of 15.55s duration with 40 Fortitude.

name: Dancing Guard
description: Parrying an opponent and then parrying another enemy in quick succession applies slow for 7s.
additionalInfo: Dancing Guard's duration will be reduced by 0.086s for every point in Fortitude below its requirements, having a minimum duration of 4.86s at 30 Fortitude.

name: Down to your Level
description: While you have a speed debuff, your Basic Attacks slow your enemies for 5s.
additionalInfo: Down to your Level's duration will be reduced by 0.05s for every point in Fortitude below 60, capping at a minimum of 3.75s with 35 Fortitude. The slow only procs on M1s or critical attacks with the M1 tag. Procs from Entanglement, Daze, Chill and most other things that slow you down.

name: Knuckle Guard
description: Hitting Dazed enemies grants you 10% posture resistance for 15s.
additionalInfo: Knuckle Guard's duration will be reduced by 0.1s for every point of Fortitude and Strength below its requirements, having a minimum possible duration of 10.4 seconds with 30 Fortitude and 4 Strength.

name: Swift Rebound
description: Move faster after successfully dodging an attack.

name: Evasive Expert
description: Your speed boost granted from dodging is increased.

name: Risky Moves
description: When you successfully dodge, you'll automatically dodge the next attack.
additionalInfo: Attacking will cancel the effect early. 20 second cooldown.

name: Ghost
description: Dodging a move will briefly make you invisible, ending early if you attack.
additionalInfo: The invisibility and I-frame duration is 1.2 seconds if you have 40 or higher Agility. Ghost's duration will be reduced by 0.0133 seconds per point in Agility under 40, capping at 0.866 seconds at 15 Agility. 20 second cooldown.

name: Oath: Chainwarden
description: You vow to be the chain that binds the wicked and drags them back where they belong. There are those in this world who should not be free.

name: Perpetual Wrath
description: Unleash the true power of Restrain. Each successive hit will increase its damage.

or.slay: 1 Player with Hunted Authority reputation or Humanoid Boss

additionalInfo: Enchaining targets and hitting Chained targets with Restrain will add 1 stack of Perpetual Wrath. Each stack of Perpetual Wrath increases Restrain's (Mantra) damage by 8, capping out at 4 stacks for +32 damage.

name: Chainlash
description: On flourish, gain the ability to summon a chain on an enemy for 5 seconds by right clicking. This lets you whip your chain to seize and yank enemies towards you, setting them up for a crushing kick.

or.slay: 2 Players with Hunted Authority reputation or Humanoid Bosses

additionalInfo: Right clicking after a flourish will enchain your target and pull them towards you. M1ing after the pull will perform a Crushing Kick, dealing high damage.

name: Champion's Regalia
description: Flourishing an opponent grants you +50% posture damage on Basic Attacks for 10 seconds.

name: Defiance
description: Negative status effects are half as effective when you are below 35% HP.
additionalInfo: The Effectiveness of Defiance will be lessened if you do not meet its Willpower requirement. Works on: Burn damage, the duration of Chill, Winded, Suffocation, time knocked, Ring of Pestilence, and Sightless Still, Crystal and Surge Rod gain, Blood Poisoning gain and Wither gain.

name: Underdog
description: You deal 2.5% more damage to those with higher HP than you, scaling up to 4% at 60 WLL. Additionally, you deal +10% more damage to physically larger foes.
additionalInfo: Underdog grants a 2.5% damage buff at 20 Willpower, this is increased by 0.0375% damage per Willpower above 20, capping at 4% with 60 Willpower. Grants a 2.875% damage buff at requirements. "Higher HP" refers to current HP.

name: Charismatic Cast
description: Landing a hit with a mantra on an enemy applies Charmed. Allies recover from being knocked twice as quickly when Charmed by you.
additionalInfo: Charismatic Cast's Charm lasts 10 seconds.

name: Chaotic Charm
description: Charm enemies nearby when attacked at low health. Enemies affected by this charm have their damage increased to anyone but you, and deal reduced damage towards you.
additionalInfo: Applies Chaotic Charm for 15 seconds, granting an additional source of damage reduction. Chaotic Charm gains 0.15% damage reduction for every point in Charisma you have.

name: Lasting Charisma
description: Enemies charmed by your mantras are charmed longer.
additionalInfo: This adds 10 seconds to Charismatic Charm's Charm duration, but this will be reduced by 0.16s for every point of Charisma below 55, capping at 15.8 seconds at 30 Charisma.

name: Tough Love
description: Deal 10% more damage to enemies Charmed by you. Mantras deal +5% instead. Being hit by someone the same Aspect or Oath as you applies Charmed briefly.
additionalInfo: Charms for 2 seconds with a 1 second cooldown. Tough Love's damage buff affects all sources of Charm, not just Tough Love's. Tough Love's damage buff is affected by the damage modifier cap.

name: Dazing Finisher
description: Flourishing enemies that are charmed by you cause them to not be knocked back and dazed instead.
additionalInfo: Applies Daze for 3.35 seconds on proc. This duration is reduced by 0.02 seconds for every point under 55 Charisma, having a minimum duration of 2.85 seconds at 30 Charisma.

name: Christmas Miracle
description: Christmas Mod Shop reward. Regens hunger and thirst. "Thank you so much K1!" Heh, no problem guys. All in a day's work.

name: Freezing Wight
description: Your Haunted Gale now procs Chilled.
additionalInfo: Applies Chill for 7 seconds or 1 Crystal on proc. Additionally, this adds the Frostdraw damage type to your Ghosts/Apparitions. Also procs on Specter Apparitions.

name: Destructive Recovery
description: [Greatsword] Enemies recover 20% less Posture when parrying.

name: Heavy Hitter
description: [Heavy Weapons] Your posture damage is increased by 5%.

name: Lord's Tithe
description: Everyone you Reinforce is drained of their Ether while Reinforced. Drain scales with your Shadowcast. Drain health from PvE opponents as well.
additionalInfo: Steals Ether (or health in PvE) in pulses.

name: Grand Support
description: Everyone you buff with Reinforce is healed lightly. You're healed slightly if you heal others.
additionalInfo: Heals you for 2% of your maximum health, increased by 1% for every player buffed. Heals affected players by 3% of their maximum health.

name: Oath: Contractor
description: Your heart is forever now eternally tied to Zi'eer, the 4th Prophet of the Ministry. You swear to serve under his will, no matter the cost.

objectives: Good Etris & Ministry reputation and talk to yunshul

name: Hidden Tendril
description: Landing any physical mantra places a Hidden Tendril on the opponent.
additionalInfo: Also procs on physical critical attacks, uppercuts, and flourishes.

name: String Trick
description: Pulls together any two opponents you've attached Hidden Tendril to.

or.slay: Grip 3 players with Oaths in Depths

additionalInfo: Does not proc on non-humanoids. Deals a small amount of damage on proc.

name: Pressure Detonation
description: Block breaking an opponent with a Shadow mantra generates a small vacuum that suffocates those hit and steals their Tempo.
additionalInfo: If the user has the Apparitions Talent, this can proc apparitions by inflicting suffocation.

name: Finishing Touch
description: [Dagger] Instantly execute enemies finished with the critical attack of your dagger.
additionalInfo: Your critical must knock the opponent for this Talent to proc.

name: Knife's Journey
description: [Dagger] Cancelling an enemy's Mantra windup with your Basic Attacks now deals 15% more damage
additionalInfo: In PvE, your Dagger attacks have a 15% chance to critically hit, dealing 5x damage. This does not proc "on critical attack" effects, and cannot proc on Moppet's critical attack.

name: Successive Throw
description: [Dagger] When you successfully flourish an enemy, you throw out a dagger afterwards
additionalInfo: There is a 1.5 second delay after your flourish before the dagger is thrown. This deals 5 Slash damage.

name: Chilling Flourish
description: When flourishing an enemy, they leave behind a trail of ice in the direction you send them.
additionalInfo: Leaves 3-4 ice patches on the ground.

name: Spike Traps
description: Press F during the wind up of your Ice Spikes to create traps around you instead of spawning a spike in the normal spot.
additionalInfo: Spikes activate upon being stepped on.

name: Condensation Drip
description: Passively collect condensation from the air, greatly reducing your thirst.
additionalInfo: Reduces the passive thirst drain by 3x.

name: Cool Head
description: If set on fire while on ice, immediately put it out and gain the Cool Head status for 30s. During Cool Head, you cannot be lit on fire.
additionalInfo: 15 second cooldown, starting when the effect ends.

name: Fragile Freeze
description: Your Basic Attacks and Criticals now apply Frozen to Chilled opponents on guardbreak.
additionalInfo: Encases them in ice, removing their ability to move, parry, block, or dodge for a short amount of time. Taking damage by any non-Frostdraw damage source (including damage over time effects) will end the freeze early. You can spam Parry, Dodge, or Jump to get out of Freeze faster.

name: Preceding Chill
description: Enemies hit during the last moments of your ice beam are frozen.
additionalInfo: If the user has Crystallization, this Talent no longer freezes but instead causes crystals to explode.

name: Golden Age
description: Your Iron Pull now detonates Crystals and overloads Surges.

name: Blood Thirsty
description: Gain a speed boost after causing an opponent heavy blood loss.

name: In a Hurry
description: You grip faster with a movement speed boost.
additionalInfo: Reduces grip time by 0.5 seconds (16.67% faster).

name: Muffled Screams
description: You quieten the cries of help of those you execute, reducing the distance at which their allies will hear it and come to assist, and reducing the effectiveness of Talents that slow your executions.
additionalInfo: NPCs have a shortened aggro range from gripping allies in proximity. Defiant Until The End and Last Second Negotiations affect your grip speed less.

name: Blighted Song
description: Attaching your Shadow Chains to enemies disables yours and the enemy's ability to cast mantras. You take reduced damage from enemies while this is applied.
additionalInfo: Grants the user and the chained opponent 20% damage reduction against outside attacks.

name: Dark God
description: If a Shadowcast mantra would drin your opponent's Ether to 0, drain from their Tempo instead and increase your Tempo. Shadowcast mantras will now raise your tempo if your ether is full.

name: Dark Synergy
description: Engulf your enemy in shadows when flourishing them.
additionalInfo: Deals 5 Shadowcast damage on proc.

name: Dark Waltz
description: Anytime you guardbreak your opponent with a light attack or critical, steal half of your opponent's current tempo. Also apply Ether Sunder to PvE enemies.

name: Dark Hours
description: Your Shadowcast Mantras deal 15% more damage at night and in realms the Sun does not reach.
additionalInfo: Night cycle is XX:50 to XX:10 in real-time.

name: Dark Rift
description: Enter a rifted state when you successfully dodge, where you can't be damaged until its duration ends. Can be cancelled early if you attack.
additionalInfo: Lasts 1.8 seconds with a 20 second cooldown that starts on proc. Blocking, parrying, dodging, or sliding will also cancel the effect. You cannot use Mantras during Dark Rift.

name: Night Terror
description: Your light attacks now proc Fear the Dark.
additionalInfo: Also procs on weapon criticals. Despite its description, this Talent immediately applies the Fear status for 1 second with no cooldown (they are not required to run away from you).

name: Overwhelming Drain
description: If multiple enemies are hit by your Shadow Eruption, they are Dazed for 0.7s.

name: Shadow Overflow
description: Extra ether stolen with mantras are exerted as dark energy, damaging and absorbing ether from those nearby.
additionalInfo: Has a 4 second cooldown. Deals 5 Shadowcast damage on proc.

name: Oath: Dawnwalker
description: You vow to forever reach towards the brilliant Light. There is no shadow that your radiance cannot expunge.

name: Absolute Radiance
description: Dealing damage with Dawnwalker mantras briefly makes you immune to all elemental effects for a short period.
additionalInfo: All elemental status effects cannot be applied to you during Absolute Radiance.

name: Protagonist Syndrome
description: The grasp of shadow is meaningless in the face of your blinding light. Your Dawnwalker mantras are empowered after getting hit by Shadowcast.
additionalInfo: Increases your Dawnwalker Mantra damage by 30% after being hit by Shadowcast damage. This cannot be self procced by using Shade Devour.

name: Luminous Flash
description: After dealing a certain amount of damage in Absolute Radiance, gain a chance to empower your strikes with pure light.
additionalInfo: During Absolute Radiance, your M1 attacks have a chance to proc Luminous Flash, applying the damage modifier hardcap as a damage buff.

name: Blackhole
description: Your singularity pulls everyone nearby in.
additionalInfo: Pulls anyone nearby in a medium sized aoe to the closest opponent you hit with a shadow mantra.

name: Energy Siphon
description: Your singularity now pulls ether from the extra players affected by Blackhole.
additionalInfo: Takes 15 Ether from the affected opponent on proc.

name: Call of the Deep
description: Sink beneath the waves and return to the Depths
additionalInfo: When used in the overworld, play an animation and sink into the first layer. This does not count as a drown. When used in the Depths, teleport to Castle Light with a 20 minute cooldown.

name: Deepbound Contract
description: You progress much faster in the Depths, and slower on the overworld. You can regain sanity at Castle Light, but will always face the strongest foes in your Trial.
additionalInfo: You can always enter Castle Light, even if you've drowned. Your Depths trial will always be an Enforcer or harder.

name: Spell Shout
description: You will now shout your mantra name upon cast
additionalInfo: The player will say the name of the Mantra they cast in a chat bubble. e.g. casting Fire Blade will make the player say "Fire Blade!" Renaming a Mantra will Spell Shout the new Mantra name.

name: Frozen Web
description: Landing a critical with a Static Link on your opponent applies Chilled.
additionalInfo: Applies Chill for 7 seconds and Bottom Freeze. Has a 4 second cooldown.

name: Buster Call
description: Radio in the Authority's navy for a buster call, sending out a barrage of bombardment wherever you see fit.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that lights a flare and highlights a large AoE on the ground. After a considerable delay, that location will be bombed several times, dealing very high damage. Cannot directly knock players. Applies burn on hit. 24 hour cooldown.

name: Officer's Slash
description: You now gain an additional critical attack with Authority armory weaponry while your regular critical attack is on cooldown.
additionalInfo: Deals 35 Slash damage. 20 second cooldown.

name: Officer's Training
description: While using a Sword or Rapier, take 30% less posture damage from criticals.

name: Target Focus
description: Enemies you charm take more damage from your squadmates in your party.

name: Ethiron's Gaze
description: Your eyes have been opened to the wasteland. You can see through the harsh fog of the storm of the Eternal Gale more clearly now.

quests: Complete Erosius Amaltus Univortus Casius Walistoshus Quest

additionalInfo: The snow in the Second Layer no longer affects your ability to see. Also reduces the visual clutter of snow in the overworld.

name: Concussion
description: Enemies you flourish into walls have their vision altered for a short duration and are dazed longer than usual. Flourished PvE enemies get Stagger for a few seconds.

name: Concussive Force
description: Enemies you knocked remain downed longer than usual.
additionalInfo: Enemies remain knocked for 15 seconds instead of 10.

name: Precise Swing
description: After landing a critical your next basic attack will gain 25% chip past your opponent's block.
additionalInfo: Procs even if your critical is parried or blocked. The Precise Swing status effect will be lost should your next M1 land or get parried. This is additive with all other sources of Chip Damage.

name: Spine Cutter
description: Hitting an enemy in the back after a roll cancel will initiate a second attack that deals your weapon's raw damage.
additionalInfo: The second slash has no PEN. Procs on certain physical Mantras and criticals with the M1 tag. Has a 5 second cooldown.

name: Steady Nerves
description: You dance from toe to toe - successful dodges restore posture.
additionalInfo: Restore 2 flat posture on a successful dodge.

name: Strong Hold
description: [Medium Weapons] When above half health and two-handing, posture damage taken is reduced by 5%.

name: Strong Stern
description: The duration you are dazed from wall bangs is cut in half. Slightly reduce your guardbreak stun time from PvE enemies as well.

name: Tap Dancer
description: Dodging immediately after a roll-cancel no longer puts your Dodge on a longer cooldown.
additionalInfo: Negate the extra half a second cooldown added to the roll following a roll-cancel.

name: Concussive Flash
description: Your blinding light now concusses foes.
additionalInfo: People blinded by Flame Blind are Dazed for 2 seconds.

name: Charged Return
description: Being under an elemental status effect causes your Basic Attacks and Criticals to do 10% more damage.
additionalInfo: Procs on Burn, Chill, Shock, Fear, Winded, and Suffocation.

name: Nullifying Clarity
description: Deal 10% more damage to enemies with elemental status effects, but remove the status on hit.
additionalInfo: Procs on Burn, Chill, Shock, Fear, Winded, and Suffocation. Only works on M1s.

name: Cornered Fool
description: Blockbreaking a Charmed opponent procs Taunt for 5s, making them take and deal more damage.
additionalInfo: Despite what the description states, this applies Taunt for 6 seconds. Every point of Charisma below 85 will reduce the duration of this Taunt by 0.035 seconds, capping at a minimum of 5.12 seconds with 60 Charisma. The Taunt damage buff is also applied to the attack that guard broke. 15 second cooldown.

name: Give and Take
description: Deal less damage to comrades and receive less damage from comrades.
additionalInfo: This does not apply to self damage. Stacks multiplicatively with Loyalty.

name: Off Your Game
description: You now slow Taunted enemies when you hit them.

name: Robber Baron
description: Halves the number of items you drop on death. You no longer lose Notes on death.
additionalInfo: Lose 25% of your non-Soulbound/Enchanted items on death instead of 50%.

name: Ether Absorption
description: Receive Ether back when inflicted with damage from Mantras.

name: Eureka
description: Gain a stack of Inspiration every time you land or parry a Mantra. Whiffing a Mantra removes a stack of Inspiration. Reaching 3 stacks grants +10% Mantra Damage to your next Mantra attack.
additionalInfo: Landing and parrying Mantras grants Inspiration stacks. Mantras cap at giving 1 stack per, and you do not gain stacks from autoparry frames.

name: Keen Recovery
description: Landing a basic attack after feinting a mantra will restore the feinted mantra's ether cost.
additionalInfo: The ether restored scales on your Intelligence. At 55 Intelligence this will restore 100% of the Mantra's Ether cost, scaling up or down if you have more or less than this Intelligence investment.

name: Behind You
description: Landing a basic attack behind your enemy after feinting a mantra will apply an ether slash, dealing extra damage based on how much ether you have left.
additionalInfo: Deals 15 physical damage when at full Ether.

name: Unwavering Focus
description: When your mantras are parried, receive less posture (scales with intelligence).
additionalInfo: Grants 0.3% posture resistance per point in Intelligence, capping at +21% at 70 Intelligence.

name: Reverse Leech
description: Anytime you proc Behind You, steal ether from your opponent too.
additionalInfo: Behind You is procced by landing a basic attack behind your enemy after feinting a Mantra.

name: Oath: Fadetrimmer
description: You vow to forever hone your precision with the scissors. There will never be another fringe incident again.

name: Barber's Skillset
description: What type of look are we going for today?
additionalInfo: Gives a Talent tool that opens an outdated version of the Barber UI. When selecting others: Changes what haircut your Fadetrimmer Mantras apply on hit. When selecting yourself: Changes your own hair.

name: Hair Product
description: What's in these things?
additionalInfo: Gives a Talent tool that shows a popup menu and allows you to select either Flammable, Charming, or Revitalizing Hair Sprays. Your Hair Spray will change to the chosen effect.

name: Hair Spray
description: Apply your Hair Products.
additionalInfo: Flammable applies Burn or causes an Eruption; parryable and blockable. Charming applies Charm for 15 seconds; parryable and blockable. Revitalizing heals 10% of the affected entity's health; unparryable and unblockable. 10 second cooldown.

name: Meteor Impact
description: Aerial moves you land will follow up into a devastating slam. This is also possible when you yourself gets hit by an aerial move.
additionalInfo: Deals 10 flat Flamecharm damage on top of your weapon's scaled damage. Procs by light attacking after using certain Mantras that end with both the user and the victim suspended in the air.

name: Phoenix Impact
description: If you Meteor Slam an opponent whilst on fire, restore some HP and Ether.
additionalInfo: Heals 4% max HP and restores 20 ether.

name: Fang and Coil
description: Adopt the path of the serpent.

objectives: Speak to Vesque while having ally Etrea reputation
Spawn in with the Fang and Coil Fist style

additionalInfo: Allows you to use the Fang and Coil fist style.

name: Fishman
description: When your Blood is over 50%, you won't drown when Unconscious in water. Gain additional healing from knocking others Unconscious in water.

name: Landshark
description: Killing a Megalodaunt will grant lifesteal on your attacks for 30 seconds.
additionalInfo: The lifesteal only works in PvE.

name: Dancing Steps
description: Fire mantras now move you in the direction you're facing.
additionalInfo: Casting a Flamecharm Mantra will give you a moderate boost of horizontal movement in the direction your character is facing. This will still proc even if the Mantra is feinted. 5 second cooldown.

name: Graceful Steps
description: Your dancing steps now gives a faster speed boost.
additionalInfo: The speed boost has a very short duration; having a fast swingspeed weapon is recommended to capitalize off this Talent's effect. 5 second cooldown.

name: The Final Act
description: Landing a fire mantra immediately after flourishing an opponent will cause them to explode.
additionalInfo: Deals 5 Flamecharm damage on proc.

name: Cauterized Wounds
description: Blood loss from all sources is lowered.
additionalInfo: Does not reduce the blood damage of 'blood drain' effects, such as casting or being hit by Bloodrend Mantras, blood drain potions, and the blood loss Corrupt Resonance downside. Stacks multiplicatively with Alloyblood. The effectiveness of this Talent is reduced if you are using the Curse of the No Life King enchantment.

name: Warding Radiance
description: Every fire mantra builds up one halo stack. At 3 stacks a halo appears that allows you to slide further. Hell's Partisan is also triggered passively while this is active.
additionalInfo: Allows you to proc Hell's Partisan on Flamecharm Mantras that aren't Fire Forge while you have the halo active. Lasts 60 seconds, but cannot be refreshed.

name: Flamewalker
description: When Warding Radiance is active you leave trails of flame when you slide.

name: Hell's Partisan
description: After landing a flame dagger on an opponent, your next hit against them will impale with a divine spear from above.
additionalInfo: Deals 5 Flamecharm damage. Parryable, but not blockable or dodgeable due to hitstun.

name: Flamecharm Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Flamecharm to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Flamecharm Attribute. This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Flamecharmer
description: Grants you the ability to command Fire as a Flamecharmer.

name: Adept Flamecharmer
description: You can now obtain 1-Star Leveled Flamecharmer Mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Expert Flamecharmer
description: You can now obtain 2-Star Leveled Flamecharmer Mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Master Flamecharmer
description: You can now obtain 3-Star Leveled Flamecharmer Mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Azure Flames
description: Many of your flames turn blue, signifying their increased intensity.
additionalInfo: Increases burn damage by 12.5%. Increases the radius and posture damage of Eruptions. Increases Flame of Denial's duration by 25%.

name: Temperature Shock
description: Your fire mantras now detonate any stacked crystals.
additionalInfo: This has a 4 second cooldown.

name: Exoskeleton
description: You have a layer of fortified Natural Armor that replenishes when you rest. Your Natural Armor will resist 10% Physical Damage when active.
additionalInfo: Exoskeleton's resistance will be less effective if you do not meet its Fortitude requirement, losing 0.125% resistance for every point under 40 Fortitude, capping at 6.875% resistance with 15 Fortitude. Chitin's resistances stack multiplicatively with Exoskeleton.

name: Glacial Mobility
description: Cast while slide-jumping to perform a running attack with your ice sabers.
additionalInfo: The Talent activates after you've slide jumped, and not during the slide jump, contrary to the Talent description.

name: Frostdraw Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Frostdraw to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Frostdraw Attribute. This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Frostdrawer
description: Grants you the ability to command Ice as a Frostdrawer.

name: Adept Frostdrawer
description: You can now obtain 1-Star Leveled Frostdrawer Mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Expert Frostdrawer
description: You can now obtain 2-Star Leveled Frostdraw Mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Master Frostdrawer
description: You can now obtain 3-Star Leveled Frostdraw Mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Cold Front
description: Your vent is imbued with glacial frost.
additionalInfo: Venting creates an ice patch on the floor and applies Chill to any enemy hit by it. Increases your Vent damage by 40% and changes its damage type to Frostdraw.

name: Fulgurite Formation
description: When your Crystals explode, lightning strikes. When your Surge charges Overload on an enemy, your Crystals apply twice on them for 8s.
additionalInfo: The lightning strikes deal 5 typeless damage with a 4 second cooldown. The double Crystal application buff does not stack with successive Fulgurite Formation procs. Procs Grounding Bolt.

name: Orbital Ice
description: When landing a parry while standing on ice, automatically form a ring of ice that grants 15% Physical Resistance. The ring will break after sustaining a certain amount of damage, scaling with your Frostdraw.
additionalInfo: 90 second cooldown. Durability of Orbital Ice is equal to "Frostdraw investment +10".

name: Glacial Coasting
description: Sliding while Orbital Ice is active leaves trails of ice.

name: Frozen Legs
description: Chilled applied by Mantras prevents your opponents from rolling.
additionalInfo: Lasts for 0.75 seconds.

name: Imperium Kata
description: Wield an advanced form of the Legion's martial arts

objectives: Obtain the Legion Intelligence, defeat Titus, return to Caitus

additionalInfo: Allows you to use the Imperium Kata fist style.

name: Legion Kata
description: Gain the ability to use the Legion's martial arts.

objectives: Talk with Amara while having Captain's Rec in your inventory.

additionalInfo: Allows you to use the Legion Kata fist style.

name: Galebreathe Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Galebreathe to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Galebreathe Attribute.

name: Galebreather
description: Grants you the ability to command wind as a Galebreather.

name: Adept Galebreather
description: You can now obtain 1-Star Leveled Galebreathe mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Expert Galebreather
description: You can now obtain 2-Star Leveled Galebreathe mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Master Galebreather
description: You can now obtain 3-Star Leveled Galebreathe mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: After Cut
description: If an attack is physical and wind it will apply an after cut that does 5% of the damage you dealt. If an attack was a mantra, it does 2.5% damage instead.
additionalInfo: The damage After Cut deals is based on the attack's final damage, post modifiers and resistances.

name: Breathing Impact
description: Knocking enemies into objects with wind spells deals additional blunt damage based on how hard they're hit.
additionalInfo: The increased damage dealt is based on the attack's initial damage and your opponent's acceleration. Very ping/server reliant.

name: Inhale
description: Canceling a Wind Mantra stores it for 5 seconds, empowering the next Wind Mantra cast in that time. [7 sec CD, gets removed upon landing a light attack]
additionalInfo: Inhaling adds (Mantra level multiplied by 2)% damage to the next Galebreathe Mantra cast. Grants a speed boost for 3 seconds. Additionally grants the Maestro's Blade status effect, allowing your basic attacks to proc After Cut. The Mantra modifiers on the inhaled Mantra are passed onto the next eligible Mantra cast.

name: Neuroplasticity
description: Your mind is a pliable, flexible substance. The Ether cost of additional modifications to your Mantras is now reduced by 10%.
additionalInfo: The reduced cost on Mantra modifiers does not apply retroactively to previously modified Mantras until you rejoin.

name: Glass Path: Crystallization
description: Your ice abilities no longer grant a slow effect or the ability to freeze and instead cause ice crystals to grow on your opponent.
additionalInfo: Turns your Frostdraw pink. Applying chill or freeze applies red ice crystals on the enemy instead of slowing opponent. Stacking 5 ice crystals or guard breaking an opponent who has crystals makes them explode. Each crystal has 3 base damage with 5 Frostdraw scaling, increasing by 0.015 damage per Frostdraw investment for a maximum damage of 4.5 each at 100 Frostdraw. 1 second cooldown on explosion proc.

name: Crystal Shrapnel
description: Your crystal explosions now have an AoE that applies crystals to all hit.
additionalInfo: Does not hit allies or the target you procced the Crystal explosion on. Scales off Frostdraw investment and amount of crystals present.

name: Reclaimed Glass
description: Your Crystal Shrapnel explosions now grant you and any allies caught in them 10% Elemental Resistance for 10 seconds.
additionalInfo: The duration of this effect is refreshable by reproccing it.

name: Fortitude Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your fortitude to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Fortitude Attribute. The stat requirements to obtain this Talent will be increased to 77 or 78 if your Aspect has increased Fortitude on spawn, though this limitation will be removed if you have the Multifaceted Echo Unlock. The quest requirement for this Talent will be removed if you've obtained it previously on your account.

name: Bodkin Arrow
description: Your charged shots now do extra armor damage to armored enemies and extra damage to unarmored enemies.

name: Hard Stop
description: Landing a charged shot will knock your opponent back.

name: Precision Crusher
description: Landing a charged shot will knock your opponent down instead of back.

name: Armor Piercing
description: [Guns] Your gun attacks now ignore 10% of an opponent's blunt armor. Applied Multiplicatively before PEN is applied.
additionalInfo: This has heavy diminishing returns in effectiveness with the more PEN you have. Elemental guns may not benefit from this Talent at all depending on your opponent's resistances, as the highest resistance value is prioritized.

name: Execution
description: Your offhand gun attacks now count as flourishes and do a flat 20 extra damage when used with no bullets.
additionalInfo: Deals true damage. Only works if you do not have bullets in your inventory. Also procs on the offhand shots of Dual Gun attacks, but it deals 5 true damage instead if used on Dual Guns.

name: Gunpowder Blast
description: Pistol shots without bullets do 2 extra posture. [Dual Guns]
additionalInfo: Pistol blast shots deal 2 more posture damage if you have no bullets in your inventory.

name: Hip Shooter
description: When wielded with a Medium/Heavy weapon, your side gun can now fire a bullet projectile.
additionalInfo: 5 second cooldown. Requires ammunition in your inventory to be used.

name: Parting Gift
description: After you land a flourish, gain the ability to shoot bullets for 5 seconds. [Dual Gun]
additionalInfo: On proc, all dual gun M1s within the next 5 seconds have projectiles.

name: True Ether Bullets
description: Using Ether Bullets applies elemental damage of your highest investment.
additionalInfo: Landing 2 shots will make the 3rd shot deal elemental damage and apply the status effect correlating to your highest attunement. This Talent will not do anything if you do not have an attunement.

name: Prime Ether Bullets
description: Your bullets take one less hit to proc elemental effects and now have slight intelligence scaling. [Dual Gun]
additionalInfo: True Ether Bullets now procs in 2 hits instead of 3. Adds 1.2 Intelligence scaling to your Pistols.

name: Quickdraw
description: Allows you to fire your offhand gun right after swinging. [Not necessary on dual guns]
additionalInfo: Allows the user to instantly start attacking with their offhand gun after attacking with their main weapon.

name: Quick Swap
description: Massively reduce your bullet swap cooldown. [Dual Gun]

name: Brain Rattler
description: [Clubs] Guardbreaking an opponent with your Critical rattles their brain in its container, causing increased blood loss, applies Stagger to PvE enemies and blurs their vision.

name: Dispatch
description: [Clubs] Bear Trapped targets deal 20% less posture. Dazed targets deal 20% less posture. This can stack.

name: Hammerfall
description: [Clubs] Aerial attacks do 25% more posture damage when blocked.

name: Fan the Flames
description: Your stored Wind mantras can now empower your Fire mantras.
additionalInfo: The benefits of Inhale can now be applied to your Flamecharm Mantras.

name: All the Dead Gods
description: Your Basic Attacks now apply anti-heal and 5% Heal Boost against PvE for 8s.
additionalInfo: Whenever you land a Basic Attack, the target has most healing forms reduced/disabled for 8 seconds. Your anti-heal potency scales on your Willpower + Intelligence investment, only having 100% anti-heal if your Intelligence and Willpower attributes add up to at least 105. Increases the duration of all other Anti-Heal effects you apply by 2 seconds.

name: All Above, Gods Below
description: Any healing your opponent were to receive while All The Dead Gods is active on them is stolen and given to you, increase your PvE Heal Boost to 15% as well.
additionalInfo: Only applies to "active" healing. The duration of this effect will be reduced if you do not meet the Talent's requirements. This will not proc if you are the one who applied the healing; you cannot heal yourself by healing your opponent.

name: Heretic's Sutra
description: A chant that steers you into the state of Insanity for 20 seconds.

quests: Have had tier 1 insanity (shivering), and talk to Kasen, located in Layer 2 Floor 1.

additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that drains the user's sanity on proc. If your sanity is above 80%, it will be set to 65% on use. If your sanity is below 80%, it will be reduced by 15% on use. Passively procs Shared Misery and Piercing Will for 15 seconds. The cooldown and windup of Heretic's Sutra scale on your Willpower investment, but the scaling is largely negligible.

name: Sin Stacker
description: Your All The Dead Gods' duration is now based on how many stacks of antiheal you already have on your opponent, increase your PvE Heal Boost to 10% as well.
additionalInfo: Each stack of any anti-heal increases the duration of subsequent anti-heal stacks by 1 second. For example, your first hit will apply anti-heal for 8 seconds, and your next hit will apply 9 seconds of anti-heal, and so on. Each stack of anti-heal has an independent duration, decaying independently of each other.

name: Brick Wall
description: You refuse. You cannot be knocked off your feet until you are knocked completely Unconscious. Also reduces the duration of Knockdown.
additionalInfo: Grants full immunity to ragdoll. The knockdown duration reduction scales on your combined Fortitude and Willpower investment, being fully negated if you have 100 points invested into each attribute.

name: Not a Scratch
description: You don't show any signs of damage
additionalInfo: Your clothing no longer gets blood splotches and you no longer play low health animations at low health. Your outfit no longer tears when your armor durability is low. Rhythm users can no longer see your health. If you have less than 100 Willpower, your character has a chance to scream in agony upon taking damage.

name: Peripheral Vision
description: Your glare now ignores if your opponent is facing you.

name: Bottom Freeze
description: Hitting chilled enemies with Ice Projectiles while they are on ice freezes them to the ground.
additionalInfo: Prevents you from rotating your character and moving around overall. Taking damage from any source will end Bottom Freeze early.

name: Cryonis
description: All ice spells casted ontop of ice cost less Ether.
additionalInfo: Reduces the Ether cost of Frostdraw Mantras by 40% when standing on ice.

name: Frost Buster
description: Greatsword Criticals and Greathammer Criticals now leave a place Ice below the path they carve.
additionalInfo: On critical, create three moderately large ice patches in a linear path in front of yourself. These patches last 1 minute 30 seconds. Despite what the Talent description states, Greathammers do not proc Frost Buster but Greataxes do. Greatcannons do not proc Frost Buster either.

name: Frozen Anchor
description: Apply bottom freeze and chill to your opponent whenever you land a flourish, uppercut, or crit.
additionalInfo: Bottom Freeze will be removed if the target takes damage from any source. This makes this Talent extremely ineffective on multihit criticals. The Chill applied from this Talent lasts 12 seconds. 10 second cooldown.

name: Frostbite
description: Enemies can no longer heal when Chilled by you. PvE enemies also net you 5% more Heal Boost when Chilled.

name: Frozen Pin-Cushion
description: Your Ice Daggers now apply Frozen.
additionalInfo: Instantly detonates crystals if you have Crystallization Path.

name: Saint Jay
description: When a Chilled enemy receives a heal, it's nullified and 60% of the healing is redirected to you. While this is active and they are on ice your rate of healing is increased, raise your PvE Heal Boost to 10% as well.
additionalInfo: When a Chilled enemy receives a heal, it's nullified and 60% of the healing is redirected to you. While this is active and they are on ice your rate of healing is increased, raise your PvE Heal Boost to 10% as well.

name: Union Card
description: A card representing your membership in the Ignition Union. Entitles you to speedier experience gain from Dungeons and Jobs, though the fees will slightly reduce your experience gain outside of these.
additionalInfo: Gain increased EXP gain from Jobs and Dungeons, but reduced EXP gain from any other content.

name: Union Pager
description: Check up on job listings remotely.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that acts as a remote-access Job Board, allowing you to pick up jobs from any location.

name: Union Hook
description: You can now make use of the Ignition Union hooks to ascend or descend.

quests: "Save Epsi in the entrance of Firfire then speak to Alpha

name: Agitating Spark
description: Applying Burning to enemies spreads it to anyone nearby. Including yourself.
additionalInfo: On proc, a small orange particle will trail between the burning target you hit and other targets nearby, setting them on fire and granting Emperor Flame stacks. Agitating Spark bypasses block and parry. Agitating Spark procs from self damage do not apply burn. 1 second cooldown.

name: Immolation
description: Fire spells cost 70% less while on fire. If you hit someone while on fire, apply fire damage. You take 50% less damage from self-inflicted flames.
additionalInfo: "Self-Inflicted flames" include Flame Within, Agitating Spark you spread and environmental burns created by you. "Apply fire damage" applies the burn status effect instead of adding Flamecharm damage. This applies burn regardless of Flamecharm path. Instead, all instances of Physical damage, and all attacks that have the slash (blood particle) fx on hit will proc Immolation, applying burn.

name: Phoenix Flames
description: Any time you would burn to death, you instead rise again with 50% of your health restored. Has a 60 second cooldown.
additionalInfo: Healing scales on your Flamecharm investment; heals 25% health at 0 Flamecharm and scales up to 50% health at 75 Flamecharm, gaining 0.33% healing per point in Flamecharm. If you used Flame Within while knocked to proc Phoenix Flames, then the healing received will be halved.

name: Corpse Explosion
description: Bodies that you burn to death immediately explode, dealing massive damage. Your fires will incinerate unconscious targets much faster.
additionalInfo: Executing targets by burning them takes 3.5 seconds instead of 7. The explosion does not work.

name: Pleeksty's Faith
description: When on fire, automatically quench flames at the cost of some ether.
additionalInfo: Consumes 20 Ether on proc. Does not proc on self-inflicted flames.

name: Pleeksty's Will
description: You gain significantly more ether from consuming elemental ingredients.
additionalInfo: Consuming Gale Stones, Heartstars, Dying Embers, Spark Glands, and Frigid Prisms gives significantly more Ether.

name: Ad Astra
description: Return Home
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that allows you to travel to and from The Floating Keep.

name: Chitin
description: You have a layer of Natural Armor that replenishes when you rest
additionalInfo: Grants 5% physical damage reduction in the form of Natural Armor. This stacks multiplicatively with Exoskeleton. Increases Exoskeleton's durability by 200.

name: Deepfolk
description: The secrets of the Deep are easier for you to unravel. Your mind is sturdier against its effects, as well as using less Knowledge in Knowledge exchanges.
additionalInfo: Increases Sanity gain by 1.2x. Deep Shrine Knowledge cost is reduced by 1 (this cannot go below 1).

name: Feathered Glider
description: As a show of independence when they come of age, Tirans will strike out on their own with just their hand-crafted glider, gliding down from the mountain peaks where they make their homes. You take 10% less fall damage.
additionalInfo: Provides a Glider with infinite durability. The color of this Glider is dependent on your aspect variant, but it can be dyed.

name: Echolocator
description: Your highly tuned hearing helps you navigate, seeing better in the dark and sensing potential threats.
additionalInfo: Pings the location of nearby players who unsheathe their weapons (even through Tacet and Lowstride) and event spawns.

name: Loyalty
description: Your bond with your allies is strong enough to reduce damage between you.
additionalInfo: Allies take 35% less damage from you and deal 35% less damage to you. This stacks multiplicatively with Give and Take.

name: Mark of Jurik
description: Mark of Jurik, the Moonseye. A beacon of calm, those in your presence are resistant to insanity.
additionalInfo: Gain a tool that lowers the sanity drain of nearby players. Also buffs affected players' HP regen and slightly buffs their food & thirst replenishment from consuming food and their blood regen. 4m CD. These buffs last 1 minute, the HP regen is 15% of their total HP over that one minute period, healing 0.25% HP per second. Also buffs non allies. Does not require you to be resting at a campfire.

name: Mark of Ku
description: Mark of Ku, the Mother. Improves the rest of those in your presence.
additionalInfo: Gain a tool that buffs the blood regen of nearby players. Also buffs the affected players' HP regen and slightly buffs their sanity and their food & thirst replenishment from consuming food. 3m 30s CD. These buffs last 1 minute, the HP regen is 15% of their total HP over that one minute period, healing 0.25% HP per second. Also buffs non allies. Can only be used while you are resting on a campfire.

name: Mark of Nemit
description: Mark of Nemit, the First Beast. Food consumed in your presence is more nourishing.
additionalInfo: Gain a tool that buffs the food and thirst replenishment of nearby players. Also buffs the affected players' HP regen and slightly buffs their blood regen and sanity. 3m 30s CD. These buffs last 1 minute, the HP regen is 15% of their total HP over that one minute period, healing 0.25% HP per second. Also buffs non allies. Can only be used while you are resting on a campfire.

name: Maudet
description: Your understanding of your destiny is such that learning new things often comes naturally to you. People appreciate your diplomatic ways of speaking.
additionalInfo: Gain 3 free investment points to invest every time you level up. This stacks with Autodidact. Your starting reputation with all factions is higher.

name: Molt
description: Ailments and blessings alike fade away more quickly.
additionalInfo: The duration of Chill, Suffocation, and all potion effects is reduced.

name: Mothwing Dust
description: You release Mothwing Dust when others are the first to strike, granting you vision of your attacker. Your antennae improve your peripheral senses, narrowing the angle at which you can be backstabbed.
additionalInfo: Upon being hit at the start of combat, cover your opponent in Mothwing Dust, applying a red highlight on your opponent for 10 seconds. This highlight can be seen through walls.

name: Navae's Guidance
description: Navae's star guides your path, showing you the way forward. Right-clicking on maps sets a Waymarker which can be followed. You are less prone to starvation.
additionalInfo: Receive a compass, displayed at the top of your screen, which points East. Right clicking on the map will place a waypoint or change the location of a pre-existing one. Waymarkers can be seen both in the physical world and on the map. The passive hunger loss is reduced.

name: Nightchild
description: Relying on your instincts, you are naturally more stealthy. You are more nimble on wooden surfaces.
additionalInfo: Multiplies all stealth gained by 1.2x. Gain +20% Stealth on spawn.

name: Seaborne
description: You have a keen understanding of ships and their maintenance.
additionalInfo: Ship purchase price is reduced by 20%, ships turn 20% faster, and have 10% more health. Repairing a ship with a Repair Hammer takes less time.

name: Teachings of the Edenkite
description: Find your centre.
additionalInfo: Allows you to meditate, emitting a white aura and causing two white orbs to circle your head. Very heavily reduces your hunger and thirst consumption while you passively gain EXP and Attribute EXP and regenerate health at a mediocre rate, which is slightly reduced when in combat.

name: Versatile
description: You learn how to use new pieces of equipment quicker than others. You can equip things at 3 points lower than the requirement.
additionalInfo: Reduces the attribute requirements of all equipment and weapon items by 3. This is applied to each requirement individually, meaning you can save upwards of 12 points.

name: Backstabber
description: Landing a backhit with a light attack causes you to grab your opponent and stab them again, dealing an extra 15 damage. [15 second CD]
additionalInfo: Deals 20 damage, not 15. You gain a 10% swing speed buff when standing behind targets when this is off cooldown. Has no range limit. Also procs on criticals with the M1 tag. Proccing Backstabber gives the target 3 seconds of Backstabber immunity. Applies daze and ragdolls.

name: Executioner's Frenzy
description: Landing a light attack while their posture is paused reduces their assassination cooldown by 5 seconds.
additionalInfo: This works on Paused Posture caused from Stature Break or Maiming Claws.

name: Fatal Stealth
description: You deal increased backstab damage to opponents based on how high your stealth stat currently is.
additionalInfo: Grants a 0.2% damage buff to attacks that hit your opponent's back for every 1% stealth you have. This only works on stealth gained from Equipment or Outfit sources. Felinor's innate stealth multiplier has no effect on this. This does not work on assassinations.

name: Flanking Maneuvers
description: Enemies you assassinate take more PEN from your squadmates in your party.

name: Stature Break
description: Landing a backstab of any kind disables posture for 4 seconds. [8 second CD]
additionalInfo: While their posture is paused, your opponent cannot restore posture by parrying, spitting, passive posture restoration, or through Steady Nerves. All other forms of posture restoration ignore this effect entirely.

name: Tacet Minimization
description: Focus your Tacet even further, allowing the radius at which you get spotted to become smaller temporarily.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that massively reduces the size of your Tacet bubble on use.

name: Critical Engine
description: You gain the ability to use Deep Gems on your critical attack. Hold out the Deep Gem you wish to apply to your crit then use the tool to enhance your critical.
additionalInfo: Hold out the Deep Gem you wish to equip to your weapon and click to apply it, similar to equipping a Deep Gem to a Mantra. This does not consume the Deep Gem on use. Blue Gems have a unique interaction with this Talent, granting Ether back based on scaled damage dealt.

name: Ironsing Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Ironsing to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Ironsing Attribute. This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Ironsinger
description: Grants you the ability to command Metal as an Ironsinger. Press X to Pull on Metal Rods.
additionalInfo: Ironsing mantras apply stacks of Metal Rods on targets. Pressing [X] will pull affected towards you, with the strength of the pull depending on the amount of Metal Rods present. You cannot apply more than 5 Metal Rods to one target, unless you have one of the Rending Needle Talents.

name: Adept Ironsinger
description: You can now obtain 1-star Ironsinger mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Expert Ironsinger
description: You can now obtain 2-star Ironsinger mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Master Ironsinger
description: You can now obtain 3-star Ironsinger mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Alloyblood
description: You don't bleed like others do. Bleed damage reduced by 30%. Blood loss is reduced by 75%.
additionalInfo: The effects of Alloyblood scale linearly with Ironsing investment, losing 0.3% bleed damage reduction and 0.75% blood loss damage reduction for every point in Ironsing below 100. Blood loss reduction is less effective if you are using the Curse of the No Life King Enchantment and stacks multiplicatively with Cauterized Wounds. The blood loss reduction does not affect blood drain effects like casting or being hit by Bloodrend Mantras, blood drain potions, and the blood loss Corrupt Resonance downside.

name: Heavy Shoulders
description: If your opponent has 3 or more rods, their dodges are slower.
additionalInfo: Reduces roll distance by 10%.

name: Laced Traps
description: People hit by your 'Caltrops' cannot jump and are slowed for a small duration, while also applying Sluggish to PvE enemies for a few seconds.
additionalInfo: Landing a Caltrop slows down your opponent and disables their ability to jump for 1.1 seconds. This effect refreshes if the victim gets hit by another Caltrop.

name: Metal Shackles
description: Guardbreaking an opponent prevents them from receiving speed boost for 5 seconds, while PvE opponents will be Sluggish for 12 seconds.

name: Piercing Metal
description: Deal additional armor damage to enemies per metal rod affecting them.
additionalInfo: Each rod increases armor damage dealt through weapon attacks and Mantras by 5%. This does not affect armor drain effects such as the Metal enchantment.

name: Thornmail
description: Getting flourished applies a metal rod on your attacker.

name: Willpower Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your willpower to its fullest.

quests: Speak to Akira in the Depths then speak to him again after he moves to Castle Light

additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Willpower Attribute. The stat requirements to obtain this Talent will be increased to 77 or 78 if your Aspect has increased Willpower on spawn, though this limitation will be removed if you have the Multifaceted Echo Unlock. The quest requirement for this Talent will be removed if you've obtained it previously on your account.

name: Grand Skewer
description: Your Grand Javelin now carries opponents through the air.
additionalInfo: Press [F] during Grand Javelin's windup to activate this effect. This does not work in Layer 1.

name: Oath: Jetstriker
