description: You vow to flow with the Song itself, drifting across where the trails may take you. If the Song permeates everything, then let it be your conduit, and you its master.
additionalInfo: Gain Momentum by sprinting. At maximum Momentum, your Jetstriker Mantras deal 20% more damage.

name: Acceleration Points
description: Striking an opponent in the back with mobility mantras or Basic Attacks now steals and grants additional momentum.

name: Decisive Winds
description: When damage below 50% health, don an aura of Decisive Winds for 10s.
additionalInfo: The Decisive Winds status effect grants a 25% speed boost as long as you are within 20 studs of the target who initiated this effect. This procs through block, parry, and dodge, but not on self damage. 30 second cooldown.

name: Jetstream Pursuit
description: Upon a successful flourish, teleport to the opponent when they stop moving. Receive a significant boost of momentum.

name: Rush of Ancients
description: Dashing at maximum sprint momentum makes you one with the wind itself.
additionalInfo: Extends your dash distance and makes you invisible for a very brief duration when you dash.

name: Stratos Step
description: Holding space while climbing will now let your perform Stratos Steps to get even higher.
additionalInfo: Stratos Steps will only proc twice before going on a cooldown. Said cooldown applies to individual steps. Additionally, Stratos Step consumes Ether per step.

name: Electrify
description: Shock yourself and apply Amped for 15s. Can be used while Carried to escape.
additionalInfo: If used while not being carried, this deals 5% of your current health as self damage on proc. Additionally, you will gain the Amped status effect for 15 seconds, increasing your weapon damage by 10% and allowing your weapon attacks to apply Shock on hit. However, incoming damage will be increased by 10%. 1 minute cooldown.

name: Amplified Reflexes
description: Amped now grants enhanced speed and parkour.
additionalInfo: While Amped, your walk speed will be increased by 50% and your climb height will be increased by 15%. You also gain a slight sprint speed buff.

name: Amplified Rage
description: Amped now grants you an additional +10% weapon damage. Also self-damage and cooldown by 3x.
additionalInfo: Increases Amped's damage buff from 10% to 20%. The final sentence in this Talent's description is lying; it does not increase Electrify's cooldown, nor its self damage.

name: Jus Karita
description: Adopt the kick-based fighting style of the Justicars.

objectives: Spawn in with the Jus Karita Fist style

additionalInfo: Allows you to use the Jus Karita fist style.

name: Justicar's Prowess
description: Jus Karita gains +30% posture damage against other fist styles.
additionalInfo: Gain +30% posture damage on weapon attacks against opponents using Way of Navae, Fang and Coil, Imperium Kata, Untrained Fist, or Legion Kata.

name: Justicar's Renewal
description: Hitting an opponent with your Jus Karita critical resets the cooldown. (Cooldown of 10 seconds).
additionalInfo: Landing Jus Karita's critical attack will reset its cooldown. This has a 10 second cooldown. Also procs if Jus Karita's critical is blocked or parried.

name: Flying Swiftkick
description: Hitting a Jus Karita critical attack while Swiftkick Prodigy is active will greatly slow your enemy, and consume your speed boost.

name: Kickstart
description: Play the resurrector. Use your lightning to defibrillate your allies on the battlefield.
additionalInfo: Heals the person for 10% of their maximum health if you successfully resurrect them. Kickstart consumes 5% of your Ether on use, and then another 20% if the Kickstart was successful. Kickstart has a 3 second long animation, in which you cannot act. This can be used on players using Cap Artist. Despite the description stating "allies," this can be used on non-allies and humanoid NPCs.

name: Blade's Edge
description: [Spears] Damage dealt with the tip of the spear is increased by 10%
additionalInfo: The "tip of the spear" is the end of your weapon's range.

name: Defensive Sweep
description: [Spears] Posture breaking an opponent grants you +50% PEN for 3 seconds.
additionalInfo: This does not bypass the PEN cap. 14 second cooldown.

name: Driving Impact
description: [Spears] The first hit of your Spear's Critical Attack will deal greatly increased posture damage. Subsequent hits will do reduced posture damage.
additionalInfo: The first hit of your default spear critical will deal double the posture damage. The second hit of your default spear critical will not deal posture damage.

name: Lancer's Impale
description: [Spears] Hitting an enemy after a perfect dodge makes your next attack deal 30% bleed damage. If that attack would already bleed, it adds +10% chip damage instead.

name: Hoplite
description: Posture damage is reduced by 15% when wielding a spear and standing still.

name: Eruption Path: Lava Serpent
description: Your fire abilities no longer proc burn and instead proc an eruption under the enemies feet.
additionalInfo: Eruptions have a base damage of 15 with 5 Flamecharm scaling. Eruptions have a 3s proc cooldown. You can still apply burn via Immolation, Flash Point, and Agitating Spark.

name: Empowered Eruption
description: Your next Eruption after landing a critical is Empowered with +50% range and damage. 10s cooldown.

name: Flash Point
description: Block breaking an opponent causes your Eruptions to be Empowered for the next 10s. Block breaking an opponent with a Fire Mantra procs Burning.
additionalInfo: 45 second cooldown on the Empowered Eruption effect.

name: The Floor is Lava
description: Your Eruptions leave lethal pools of lava beneath them. Don't fall in.
additionalInfo: The duration and damage of the lava pools scale on your Flamecharm investment.

name: Callout
description: You can mark objects or enemies by pressing Z, which will mark them for all nearby allies.

name: Spotter
description: Marking enemies while in Rhythm will now indicate their health status to your allies.
additionalInfo: Using Callout while in Rhythm will showcase the health value of the target to your allies.

name: Observation
description: Dodge frames are larger if you cancel your roll immediately.
additionalInfo: Cancelling your roll quickly will keep your dodge for as active as a full roll, giving you an additional ~0.1s immunity.

name: Safety Dance
description: Your base dodge frames are increased by 0.05s.
additionalInfo: Dodge IFrames increased from 0.3s to 0.35s.

name: Air Pressure
description: Dodging an attack or hitting an enemy's block will transform your next dash into a Gale Dash. Gale Dashes carry you further than regular dashes and have extended iframes, but will clear immediately should you initiate an attack.

name: Cyclone Blade
description: After a successful Gale Dash you wrap your weapon in wind, causing your next Light attack to do +15% damage as bleed and have +10% chip damage.
additionalInfo: Lasts for 3 seconds with no cooldown. Phantom Step dashes will also proc this effect. Despite stating "Light Attack", this Talent also procs on weapon criticals.

name: Pressure Break
description: Breaking an enemy's posture will cause them to take intense wind pressure, increasing the attack's damage by +15% and flinging the enemy backwards.

name: Wind Step
description: Create a step of wind below you when jumping in the air. Jumping while sliding down a slope or off a cliff launches you forwards.
additionalInfo: Jump while airborne to double jump, leaving behind a wind pad that other players can also use. Alternatively, jumping while sliding down a slope will perform a Gale Leap that propels you forwards. While in combat, this ability cost Ether to use.

name: Scorched Peak
description: Blockbreaking an enemy on fire or with a fire mantra causes them to be struck by lightning.
additionalInfo: Deals 10 Thundercall damage on hit. "On fire" refers to the Burn status effect. This can proc Grounding Bolt.

name: Comeback Kid
description: When waking up from being knocked you are unable to be knocked down for 5 seconds. (120 second cooldown)
additionalInfo: 2 minute cooldown.

name: Last Resort
description: Deal +5% more damage when your health is below 25%.

name: The Eleventh Hour
description: When below 15% health your mantras require no ether to cast for 11 seconds.
additionalInfo: Lasts 30 seconds with a 90 second cooldown.

name: Oath: Linkstrider
description: You vow to give up your own life for the sake of others. Stepping out of the fray, you become a foundation of your allies' strength.

name: Entropy Link
description: The world is broken, linked by fragile webs. Traverse the path by stating your destination amidst the flame.
additionalInfo: You are able to fast travel to certain places while resting at a campfire. Locations are unlocked by interacting with special meteorites that are scattered around the map. By sitting at a campfire and typing out the name of the desired meteorite, you will be transported directly to it.

name: Symbiotic Link
description: Activate by pressing X while hovering over an ally or enemy. The Links are destroyed when you receive damage from a non-ally, you stray too far or you activate it again. Only one cord of each type may exist at once, links give a 3 second warning in break range, in the warning phase, they can't be broken.
additionalInfo: Blue Cords (Allies) gain a speed boost, 20% damage resistance, and a 5% damage increase. Red Cords (Enemies) gain a minor speed debuff. Allows you to passively see the health bars of your allies.

name: Mark of the Lone Warrior
description: Progress much faster when progressing alone. Gain a damage boost when facing threats alone and also when outnumbered.
additionalInfo: Gain an experience gain multiplier if nobody else has combat tagged the enemy. Gain a 5% damage buff against enemies who have combat tagged you, or enemies you've combat tagged if the opponent has less than or an equal amount of combat tags as you.

name: Silencer's Song
description: Silencer's Blade now procs on your mantras.
additionalInfo: Landing any Mantra on a suffocated target creates a new stack of suffocation that lasts 5 seconds. Additionally, you gain a 22.5% speed boost for 3 seconds.

name: Old Habits Die Hard
description: Blocking an attack with your lingering block frames after failing a parry will cause the attack to deal 15% less posture damage.

name: Thresher Claws
description: Grants +5% Weapon PEN.

name: Leg Shot
description: [Rifles] Landing your critical slows your enemy for a bit while making PvE enemies Sluggish, and also disables any speed boosts they get for the next 10 seconds.

name: Stock Bash
description: [Rifles] Your running attacks now apply a brief amount of daze and Stagger PvE enemies.
additionalInfo: Applies daze for one second.

name: Tactical Reload
description: [Rifles] Activate to make your rifle shoot bullets for 15 seconds.
additionalInfo: Upon activating the Talent tool, your rifle will gain the ability to fire Bullets for 15 seconds. 90 second cooldown. Does not work on Rifle Spear.

name: Impervious Slumber
description: Getting hit while Unconscious no longer resets your time Unconscious.

name: Breathing Exercise
description: Your sanity recovers more quickly once out of terrifying situations.
additionalInfo: Your passive sanity regen is increased by 50%.

name: Conquer your Fears
description: Killing the beings of the deep replenishes your sanity somewhat. When an Ally grips an enemy nearby to you, you regain Sanity.
additionalInfo: Recover Sanity when killing monsters in the Depths, with the Sanity restored depending on how strong the monster is. Gain Sanity whenever a nearby ally executes a humanoid target.

name: Disbelief
description: Reduces the duration of illusions cast on you by 30%. Halves the duration of the Charmed status on you.
additionalInfo: All Visionshaper clones have a 30% less duration when cast on you. Halves the duration of Charmed.

name: Intuitive Repairs
description: Your 'Iron Skin' repairs armor while it's active.
additionalInfo: Iron Skin regenerates your armor and Natural Armor while its active.

name: Metal Absorption
description: Your 'Iron Hug' also absorbs armor from the enemy.
additionalInfo: Iron Hug will steal 10% of your opponent's current armor durability and siphon it back to yourself.

name: Metal Eater
description: When you have no ether, consume Armor durability to cast your Ironsing mantras.
additionalInfo: Consumes 30% of your maximum armor on proc, regardless of the Ether cost of the Mantra.

name: Metal Thief
description: Pulling an opponent absorbs a portion of their current Armor durability.
additionalInfo: Steals 2% of your opponent's current armor durability per rod.

name: Polished Armor
description: You receive 5% less damage when your Armor protects you from an attack and has over 90% durability. This 5% will scale up to 10% less damage at 100 MTL.
additionalInfo: The damage reduction of Polished Armor is increased by 0.05% per Ironsing investment, granting 8.75% damage reduction at requirements.

name: Chain of Perfection
description: You gain stacks of Perfection on hitting mobs with Weapon Attacks or Mantras. Mantras are only worth half a stack.

requirements.slay: Any boss, while solo and without taking any damage.

additionalInfo: Gain a 5% damage buff against PVE enemies per stack of Perfection above 5, capping at +100% damage at 25 stacks. This is treated as a final damage multiplier and it bypasses the damage modifier cap. All stacks of Perfection are lost upon taking any damage, excluding self damage.

name: Echoing Lunatic
description: Your Ardour Scream now inflicts insanity.

name: Lose Your Mind
description: Deal more damage the more insane you are. Grants +15% damage at maximum insanity.
additionalInfo: Starting at 70% Sanity, gain a damage buff that scales non-linearly on your current Sanity percentage.

name: Shared Misery
description: Using a M1/Critical Attack on an enemy while losing sanity causes them to lose sanity.
additionalInfo: If you are actively losing sanity or have used Heretic's Sutra in the past 15 seconds, remove 3% of the target's maximum sanity, scaled down if you have less than 85 Willpower.

name: Charisma Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your charisma to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Charisma Attribute. The stat requirements to obtain this Talent will be increased to 77 or 78 if your Aspect has increased Charisma on spawn, though this limitation will be removed if you have the Multifaceted Echo Unlock. The quest requirement for this Talent will be removed if you've obtained it previously on your account.

name: Murmur: Ardour
description: An application of your Soul Murmur that enables one to channel the murmur into raw strength. Press H.
additionalInfo: Drains Ether while active, with the Ether drain scaling inversely with your level and being entirely negated at Power 20. Ardour automatically deactivates if you run out of Ether. Increases the posture damage of M1s and critical attacks with the M1 tag by 20%. Reduces incoming posture damage by 15%. Additionally applies a +15% damage buff to M1s and critical with the M1 tag that guard break.

name: Ardour Scream
description: Amplify your shout into a scream using Ardour, dominating weaker foes, Victims take 12.5% more damage and 50% more posture damage for 10s.
additionalInfo: Consumes 100% of your Ether on use. Ardour Scream requires you to have a minimum of 100% Ether to be casted. Having the Soul Infusion Talent will reduce this to a minimum of 40% Ether.  Combat tags opponents hit. Notably, its damage and posture damage buffs are applied on-hit to incoming attacks rather than being a debuff that increases damage/posture damage taken, meaning Ardour Scream is affected by the damage and posture damage modifier caps. Also has a 95-Stud range (245 if Soulbreaker),

name: Murmur: Rhythm
description: An application of your Soul Murmur that enables the user to perceive the subtle murmur emanating from all things. Press G while crouched.

objectives: Complete Kadrivus Entomolius Auditan's Quest in the Second Layer

additionalInfo: Pings all nearby Monsters, NPC’s, and Players, through walls while gray-scaling your screen. Red = Low Health, Yellow = Moderate Health, Grey = Healthy.

name: Murmur: Tacet
description: An application of your Soul Murmur that enables the user to suppress their own murmur. Press T while crouched.
additionalInfo: On use, a sphere around your character will be created. To everyone outside of the sphere, you are invisible. The size of the Tacet sphere scales inversely on your level and your stealth stat, becoming smaller the higher your level and the more stealth you have. In PvE you become effectively invisible to enemies at almost any range. Tacet will deactivate if you: stop crouching for 3 seconds, sprint for 1.5 seconds, use any attack, get hit, or use Soulbreaker's Formless ability. Tacet will be disabled during Hell Mode, Diluvian, and Depths Trials.

name: Armor Conserver
description: You lose 15% less armor when hit.
additionalInfo: Does not affect Natural Armor from Exoskeleton and Chitin.

name: Lightweight
description: Move faster when your armor runs out of durability.
additionalInfo: Grants a +25% movement speed buff. This is not a speed boost, meaning it won't proc any speed boost-reliant Talents.

name: Padded Armor
description: While your armor is broken (or if you have no armor), you take 5% less damage.
additionalInfo: The 3% Blunt Armor is multiplicative with other sources of Blunt resistance.

name: Steel Scales
description: You take an additional 5% less damage when your armor is broken.
additionalInfo: The 3% Slash Armor is multiplicative with other sources of Slash resistance.

name: Captain Etrea
description: [Fists] Moving while blocking with a shield no longer slows you down.

name: Fists of Fortitude
description: Fists Every 6 hits with your fists builds up a shield of endurance reducing incoming damage by 15%. 70s CD
additionalInfo: Lasts 10 seconds then goes on cooldown once the buff ends. You can only gain stacks from M1s or criticals with the M1 tag.

name: Way of Navae
description: Gain the ability to use fist combat against weapons. Including the ability to block weapons with your hands using Ether.

objectives: Bring a Navaen Hostage to the Eastern Camp Master, Beiruul, or Eastern Nomad Leader.

additionalInfo: Allows you to use the Way of Navae fist style.

name: Defensive Stance
description: [Rapier] Gain more parry frames the lower your health is.

name: Duelist's Lunge
description: [Rapier] Running attacks deal increased posture damage. Upon landing your Critical, your next running attack will have increased range.
additionalInfo: Running attacks with rapiers deal 35% more posture damage. After landing a Critical, the next rapier running attack gains 2 range.

name: Frenzied Dance
description: [Rapier] The more posture you currently have, the more chip and posture damage you deal.

name: Pressure Skewer
description: [Rapier] Flourishing an enemy causes your M1's to deal additional chip damage, blood loss and makes your hits deal 3 extra true damage until you take damage.
additionalInfo: Increases blood bar damage by 50% and grants +25% Chip damage while active. These bonuses apply to M1s and criticals with the M1 tag.

name: Fast Blade
description: Extend the speed boost you get from successfully parrying an attack.
additionalInfo: Increases the speed boost duration from parrying by 3 seconds.

name: Lightspeed Reflexes
description: Feinting your Basic Attacks gives a very brief auto-parry window.

name: Speed Emission
description: Gain a slight speed boost after landing a vent

name: Oath: Oathless
description: You vow to never be bound to any Oath; to live your life free of restraint. If free will is an illusion, why not make it a convincing one?

objectives: Talk to Cerulean in the cave near Miner's Landing docks, 10 minutes of playtime

additionalInfo: Notably, the Oath Armor given by this Talent is affected by PEN and will be nullified if you run out of armor durability. Additionally, due to how resistances work, Oath attacks that have dual damage typings will ignore your Oath armor.

name: All Knowing
description: Your prediction now ignores the range requirement to reflect attacks.

name: Intelligence Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Intelligence to its fullest.

objectives: Complete the Birdcage puzzle then eat several Bluecaps

additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Intelligence Attribute. The stat requirements to obtain this Talent will be increased to 77 or 78 if your Aspect has increased Intelligence on spawn, though this limitation will be removed if you have the Multifaceted Echo Unlock. The quest requirement for this Talent will be removed if you've obtained it previously on your account.

name: Successive Prediction
description: Predicting an attack will briefly allow you to predict another.
additionalInfo: Allows you to reflect the entirety of multi-hit moves.

name: Twelve Steps Ahead
description: Landing Prediction will halve the cooldown to a minimum of 2s. Whiffing will double the cooldown to a maximum of 30s. This effect stacks for up to 30 seconds.
additionalInfo: This effect requires your opponent to be within 90 studs of you. For every point of Intelligence below 80, Prediction's maximum cooldown will be increased by 0.125 seconds, capping at 33.13 seconds with 55 Intelligence.

name: Absolute Force
description: Evolve the technique of your Oppressive Force, letting both hits of your flourish deal 50% more posture damage.
additionalInfo: Because the second hit of Oppressive Force cannot receive posture damage modifiers, this Talent only benefits the initial hit of your Oppressive Force flourish.

name: Amp Overdrive
description: Guardbreaking an opponent causes them to take extra thunder damage and applies Electrify for 7 seconds.
additionalInfo: Deals 15 Thundercall damage. The Electrify status effect changes your opponent's damage type to Thundercall and gives you 10% damage reduction to their attacks.

name: Martial Brutality
description: The less health your opponent has, the more posture you deal to them.
additionalInfo: Increases your posture damage by 0.1% per 1% health missing, up to a maximum of +10% posture damage against someone at 0% health.

name: Shocking Reverb
description: Landing enough lightning mantras without getting hit grants you a defensive lightning cloak for 15 seconds, letting you negate damage from light attacks and ironsing.
additionalInfo: You need to reach a threshold of 150 scaled damage with Thundercall Mantras without being hit to proc this Talent. The damage buildup to reach the threshold is unaffected by resistances and damage modifiers. Also negates damage from critical attacks and Silentheart abilities. 2 minute cooldown.

name: Lock n Load
description: [1H Guns] The first bullet in your gun does more damage when fully loaded. This damage buff scales with the number of bullets up to 15%.

name: Rapid Fire
description: [1H Guns] When you land a critical shot, gain Rapid Fire for 2s. 12s Cooldown.
additionalInfo: The Rapid Fire status effect entirely removes your Pistol critical cooldown for its duration, allowing you to spam it. Procs on dodge, block, and hit.

name: Rapid Reload
description: [1H Guns] You have 20% faster reload when reloading an empty pistol
additionalInfo: Reduces the total time taken to reload a pistol from empty by 0.1 seconds.

name: Sleight of Hands
description: [1H Guns] When you flourish an opponent you instantly load a bullet.

name: Ultrakill
description: [1H Guns] When under the effects of Rapid Fire you reload 2X as fast.

name: Cult of Personality
description: You gain +3% PEN for each person Charmed, capping at +15% PEN.
additionalInfo: The PEN gain per target will be reduced if you do not meet Cult of Personality's Charisma requirement.

name: Pardon Me
description: Crimes you commit in allied territories are often ignored. Who's asking?
additionalInfo: Guards will not aggro onto you if you perform a crime in their territory if you have neutral or higher reputation with the faction.

name: Excavator
description: Chance to receive two sets of ore when mining, mine ores a lot faster.

objectives: Turn in 5 pure ores at a Blacksmith.

name: Harvester
description: Chance to receive two sets of ingredients when harvesting.

name: Celebrity
description: Your base reputation with factions is higher and your reputation caps out higher. Reduces the penalty for committing crimes.

name: Under The Radar
description: The negative reputation threshold for a faction to put out posters of you is now higher.

name: You'll Need To Get Past Me
description: When you're attacked, one of your many allies will leap into action to protect their boss.
additionalInfo: Spawns in an allied NPC to attack whoever hits you. This Talent can only proc if you are not in combat. The cooldown of this Talent scales on your Charisma investment, having a base cooldown of 69.286 seconds with each investment point into Charisma decreasing this by 0.143 seconds. At requirements, this Talent will have a 59 second cooldown, has a maximum cooldown of 62 seconds at 50 Charisma, and a minimum cooldown of 55 seconds at 100 Charisma.

name: Going Nowhere
description: When enemies dodge your attacks, their momentum is killed and they're briefly prevented from sprinting.

name: Volcanic Glass
description: Detonating crystals causes an eruption soon after.

name: Hungry Flames
description: When you have no Ether, consume Stomach and Water to instantly cast your next fire mantra [15 second CD].

name: Blood Bag
description: You receive extra blood from knocking an enemy.

name: Blood Transfusion
description: Successfully landing a critical attack while under a negative status effect will transfer the effect plus recover a small portion of your blood bar.
additionalInfo: 20 second cooldown.

name: Open Wound
description: Guardbreaking enemies leaves enemies more susceptible to blood loss from Bloodrend mantras.

name: Kj's Courage
description: Gain 10% more Knowledge from all sources, rounded down.
additionalInfo: Due to it rounding down, this Talent will only activate if you get at least 10 Knowledge in one instance.

name: Nanji's Training
description: Nanji shows you a better way to properly block attacks using a weapon, granting you 1 Posture.

name: Supernatural Sense
description: After dealing with literal ghosts, you feel emboldened.

name: Bulldozer
description: Enemies you flourish into a wall have a chance of breaking the wall and are guard broken on impact.
additionalInfo: This has a 50% chance to break destructible objects when you flourish people into them.

name: Broken Ankles
description: Blockbreaking an opponent puts their Mobility slot Mantras on CD for 12s.
additionalInfo: Broken Ankles' duration will be reduced by 0.15 seconds for every point in Strength below 70, capping at 8.25 seconds with 45 Strength. 30 second cooldown.

name: Piercing Blow
description: Attacks that break an opponent's block ignore their Armor resistances.
additionalInfo: Gain +50% PEN on attacks that guardbreak.

name: Shield Breaker
description: Blunt damage now fully ignores the posture bonus from shields.

name: Unwavering Resolve
description: Getting parried punishes your posture 33% less.
additionalInfo: The posture reduction effect is reduced by 0.433% for every point in Strength below 40, having a minimum value of 22% posture reduction from being parried at 15 Strength.

name: Million Ton Piercer
description: Gain 5% extra PEN and remove the cap on your PEN. Go beyond your limits.
additionalInfo: Removes the 50% cap on Melee PEN.

name: Jolting Current
description: Your lightning attacks in water strike others near them with lightning.
additionalInfo: While you and your opponent are in the water, landing any attack that would apply Shock or a Surge Rod will strike other waterborne targets in a 20 stud AoE from the initial target, dealing 50% of the attack's damage and applying Shock or a Surge Rod.

name: Rending Needle: Augmenter
description: If an enemy has 5 or more rods, your Ironsing Pull will use their rods to form a powerful sword to attack with. This also makes your Metal Armament stronger while the weapon is equipped.
additionalInfo: Replaces your current weapon with the Metal Greatsword for 10 seconds when you Pull an enemy who has 5 Metal Rods on them. While Metal Greatsword is equipped, your Metal Armament damage is increased by 50%.

name: Rending Needle: Conductor
description: 5 metal rods will combine into a conductor rod. If an enemy uses a non-Ironsing elemental mantra, they're dealt with their element back in return.
additionalInfo: Upon applying 5 Metal Rods to a target, the Rods will converge into a Conductor Rod. Conductor Rods cannot be pulled. If an enemy affected by a Conductor Rod casts a Mantra, they will lose 5% of their maximum armor, and if that Mantra was a non-Ironsing/Bloodrend elemental Mantra, they will be afflicted with their Attunement's status effect, causing the Rod to fall off. Conductor Rods last 30 seconds or until a non-Ironsing/Bloodrend elemental Mantra is cast.

name: Conductor's Cable
description: Applying Conductor rods on opponents steals some of their armor to you.
additionalInfo: Creating a Conductor Rod drains 10% of your opponent's maximum armor.

name: Rending Needle: Impaler
description: If an enemy is affected by 5 or more metal rods, your Ironsing Pull instead pulls out all of the rods for massive damage.
additionalInfo: Increases the Metal Rod cap from 5 to 10. You can no longer use Metal Pull unless the target has at least 5 rods. Your Metal Pull now deals damage, with the damage scaling based on the amount of Rods applied. Impaler Rods individually have a base damage of 4, with 5 Ironsing scaling, gaining 0.02 damage per Ironsing investment. This will deal 5.5 damage per rod at 75 Ironsing and 6 damage per rod at 100 Ironsing.

name: Rending Needle: Jailer
description: If an enemy has 5 or more rods, your Ironsing Pull will restrain them for 1s instead of pulling them.
additionalInfo: Increases the Metal Rod cap from 5 to 10, and you can no longer use Metal Pull unless the target has at least 5 rods. Upon pulling a target, they will be unable to sprint or dodge, for a duration that scales on your Ironsing investment. For every rod you apply past 5, deal 3 damage on your pull, capping at 15 damage at 10 rods.

name: Family Recipe
description: You can now craft bombs at a crafting bench.
additionalInfo: Bombs are crafted with 2 Iron and 1 Coal. Pressing E while holding a bomb will throw it, while pressing M1 while holding a bomb will drop it at your feet. Bombs have a 5 second cooldown on throw. Bombs do not deal self damage. Bomb damage scales on your Intelligence attribute, dealing 10 damage at 0 Intelligence and scaling up to 45.5 damage at 100 Intelligence. Bombs deal typeless damage, ignoring armor.

name: Incendiary Formula
description: Bombs will set your enemies on fire upon detonation, as well as launch with more force. Bombs will deal 20% increased damage to burning enemies.
additionalInfo: Bombs apply burn on hit. Bombs will deal 20% more damage to burning targets, regardless of where the burn came from.

name: Sulphur Surprise
description: Your cooldown for throwing bombs will be shortened after your first bomb damages an enemy.
additionalInfo: Reduces the bomb throw cooldown from 5 seconds to 4 seconds. This only applies to the bomb thrown directly after this Talent procs, not on the bomb that procced this Talent. 20 second cooldown.

name: Hot Potato
description: Gain a large boost of speed after throwing a bomb. Your bombs have a chance to detonate twice.
additionalInfo: This speed boost lasts 2 seconds.

name: Explosive Efficiency
description: Crafting a bomb will yield two bombs. Chance to make three.

name: Pocket Bombs
description: You have a chance to activate a bomb in your inventory when damaged
additionalInfo: On proc, this consumes 1 Iron Bomb to drop 2 bombs at your feet. This has a 1 second cooldown, with the cooldown activating any time you take damage, even if the effect did not proc.

name: Chorus of Souls
description: Alone, the Wisps lack a voice. But surrounded by so many, the frequencies overlap and you hear it true.
additionalInfo: Grants heavily increased health regeneration if you have all Wisps active. If one of your Wisps runs out, or is not equipped this Talent will deactivate until you recast the Wisp. This Talent will not work if you no longer have the Oathless Oath. This healing is reduced by 0.48% for every point in each Attunement stat that is below 30. Having more than 30 points in an Attunement does not compensate for this.

name: Will o' Wisp
description: Your mastery over the Wisps of the Song enables you to mediate the innate conflicts between your wisps, allowing any number of Wisps to be active at a time.
additionalInfo: Allows the player to have multiple Wisp Mantras active at once.

name: Wisp Convergence
description: When empowered by the Chorus, your Wisps now grant their elements to your strikes.
additionalInfo: While Chorus of Souls is active, your weapon attacks will apply Burn, Chill, Shock, Winded, Shadow, Metal Rods, and Blood Poison. This Talent will not activate unless you have every Attunement's Wisp Mantra equipped and active. If one of your Wisps runs out, this Talent will deactivate until you recast the Wisp. This Talent will not work if you no longer have the Oathless Oath.

name: Light Weapons Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Light Weapons attribute to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 Attribute cap on Light Weapons.

name: Medium Weapons Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Medium Weapons attribute to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 Attribute cap on Medium Weapons.

name: Heavy Weapons Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Heavy Weapons attribute to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 Attribute cap on Heavy Weapons.

name: Oath: Saintsworn
description: A vow to the fallen heroes. Press L to swap to Saintsblade.
additionalInfo: While the Saintsblade is equipped, your Saintsworn Talents will be activated and you can utilize the Blade of Saints Mantra. By using the Saintsblade's critical attack, you can cycle between the Saint Stances. Each Saint Stance is attributed to one of the Attunements, potentially changing the effects of your Saintsworn Talents and altering your Blade of Saints Mantra.

name: Saint's Negation
description: Once per stance cycle you can fully block an attack that matches your Saint Stance.
additionalInfo: Allows you to fully negate the damage of one attack that has a damage type that corresponds with your current Saint Stance. Can only proc once per full cycle, meaning you'll have to fully cycle through all of the Stances before you can proc it again.

name: Saint's Overload
description: After a full rotation of stances your elemental scaling is increased by 15% and Mantra Modifiers increased by 10%.
additionalInfo: Increases your Attunement investment scaling by 15% and the effects of your Mantra modifiers by 10% for a few seconds after performing a full rotation of Saint stances. You'll need to fully cycle through all of the Stances before you can proc this effect again.

name: Saint's Synergy
description: 15% of your highest element scaling is applied to other elemental damage.
additionalInfo: 15% of the investment scaling from your highest Attuned stat is added to your other Attuned Mantras, granting them slight dual scaling.

name: Antithetic Salts
description: Alter your brews to invert their effects. Does not count towards the ingredient limit.
additionalInfo: Gives you a Talent tool-like ability that acts as a potion ingredient on use. When applied to your potions, it inverts the effects of the ingredients in the potion.

name: Aromatic Salts
description: Alter your brews to create lingering clouds of mist on shattering. Does not count towards the ingredient limit.
additionalInfo: Gives you a Talent tool-like ability that acts as a potion ingredient on use. This changes your thrown potions to a lingering cloud that lasts for 10 seconds, applying the potion's effects on each hit.

name: Biotic Salts
description: Alter your brews to not provide their positive effects to your enemies. Does not count towards the ingredient limit.
additionalInfo: Gives you a Talent tool-like ability that acts as a potion ingredient on use. This halves the negative effects of your potion if used on allies (including yourself) and halves the positive effects of your potions if used on enemies.

name: Enhanced Flow
description: Refine your Rush Hour, allowing you to now also gain temp health whenever you hit a player while using Rush Hour. You now also take less damage from Rush Hour.
additionalInfo: When you land basic attacks during Rush Hour, gain Temporary Health equal to 30% of your weapon's scaled damage. This cannot give more than 50 Temporary Health in a singular instance. Reduces Rush Hour's self damage by 22%, from 4.5 damage per tick to 3.5 damage per tick. Despite what the description states, this Talent still procs when hitting monsters or other non-player enemies.

name: Torture Mastery
description: Landing a critical on opponents applies 15 seconds of Torture Mastery. Heal any chip damage off players who have Torture Mastery on them. This duration is doubled if you have Rush Hour on.
additionalInfo: On proc, all chip damage you deal will be converted into healing. The conversion rate is 1:1.

name: Dark Receiver
description: Shadow moves will also steal Ether from those you are Static Linked tethered to.

name: Blood Bank
description: Consuming 'Charm' now gives slight temporary health.
additionalInfo: Grants 25 Temporary Health on proc. This Talent only procs via Donation Drive and Manipulator. Has an indirect 10 second cooldown due to it relying on Manipulator.

name: Sharing is Caring
description: Charmed on opponents also slightly increases your blood drain against them.

name: Windwaker
description: Call upon a gust of wind to propel your boat even faster.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that can only be used while on a boat and out of combat. On use, the boat will gain a very large amount of additional speed for a short duration.

name: Dirty Boxing
description: Hitting an enemy with a Basic Attack after feinting applies bleed, obscures their vision slightly and makes PvE enemies Sluggish.
additionalInfo: 8 second cooldown.

name: Pocket Sand
description: [Fist] Feinting into an uppercut blinds, applies Stagger to PvE enemies and also applies Dazed briefly. We're even now, right? 30s cooldown
additionalInfo: 30 second cooldown.

name: Gilded Path: Scrapsinger
description: Flourishing an enemy consumes any rods they have and siphons their armor to you per rod.
additionalInfo: Your Ironsing abilities and status effects are now yellow.

name: Artisan's Blade
description: Activating Scrapsinger forges a metal blade behind you for every 2 rods you consume. Metal blades will fire at a target upon landing an ironsing or metal infused attack.
additionalInfo: Each Artisan Blade has 8 Base damage with 5 Ironsing scaling, gaining 0.04 damage per Ironsing investment. Artisan Rods deal 4.5 posture damage if blocked. Pulling rods normally also procs this Talent. "Metal infused attacks" refers to Ironsing legendary weapon attacks.

name: Masterwork
description: Successful hits from Artisan's Blades will proc metal rods and deal 50% more damage.

name: Refine and Reuse
description: Consuming rods with Scrapsinger reduces incoming PEN against you for 14 seconds. Each rod reduces PEN by 5% multiplicatively.

name: Songs Unforged
description: Your weapon criticals will now activate scrapsinger.

name: Reshape and Remold
description: Successful procs of Scrapsinger will increase the amount of armor damage your opponent takes. After hitting 10 stacks, the opponent will take +5% damage until the stacks drop below 10.
additionalInfo: Increases the armor drain effect of your rods by 25%, from 2% drain to 2.5%.

name: Gruesome Harvest
description: Landing Bloodrend mantras on opponents with over 70% blood poison will give you slight temporary health.
additionalInfo: Grants 15 flat temporary health on proc. Has a 2 second cooldown.

name: Hemolysis
description: Deal 20% more critical attack damage to opponents with over 25% blood poisoning.

name: Hemolytic Transfusion
description: Guardbreaking an enemy with a Bloodrend mantra increases the amount of blood poison from the attack.

name: Juicy Snack
description: Eliminating enemies returns their amount of blood poison as health to you.
additionalInfo: The healing gained is 1:1 with Blood Poison applied.

name: Panacea
description: Hitting an enemy with a Bloodrend mantra stops their blood poison from decaying briefly.
additionalInfo: Lasts 7 seconds.

name: Tainted Ground
description: Enemies who stand in blood pools will not decay blood poison and gain 15% more blood poisoning.

name: Vasculitis
description: Hitting your opponent while they have over 20% blood poisoning disables their deep gems for a brief duration while giving you Gem Enhancement against PvE temporarily.
additionalInfo: On proc, your opponent will be unable to use their Deep Gems for 8 seconds. Gem Enhancement increases the effectiveness of your Deep Gems in PvE.

name: Shadowcast Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Shadowcast to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Shadowcast Attribute. This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Shadowcaster
description: Grants you the ability to command shadows as a Shadowcaster.

name: Adept Shadowcaster
description: You can now obtain 1-star Leveled Shadowcaster Mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Expert Shadowcaster
description: You can now obtain 2-star Leveled Shadowcaster Mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Master Shadowcaster
description: You can now obtain 3-star Leveled Shadowcaster Mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Blossoming Darkness
description: The more Ether you drain during Shadow Roar, the bigger it gets.

name: Fear the Dark
description: Enemies that run from you after being hit by your shadows will hang in place briefly.
additionalInfo: After you land a Shadowcast Mantra, if your opponent attempts to distance themselves from you, they will be locked in place for 1.5 seconds.

name: Lasting Sorrow
description: Shadows last longer on your opponent.
additionalInfo: Doubles the proc window of Fear the Dark.

name: Shadow Travel
description: Teleport to a location in exchange for Ether cost. Certain ranges will require a health sacrifice. Be careful as this technique can prove lethal to the user.
additionalInfo: Deals 0.25 self damage per stud teleported. This can kill you if you don't have enough health to survive the teleport. If your teleport distance is less than 300 studs, you will not take self damage. Drains 100 Ether on use, with each stud travelled increasing this Ether cost by 0.2. The maximum distance you can travel is based on your Ether.

name: Sightless Still
description: The more a person is affected by your Shadowcast the more you obscure their vision. Block breaking an opponent obscures their vision even more and applies Ether Sunder to PvE

name: Singularity
description: Enemies will briefly hang in place immediately after being hit by a shadow move.

name: Knight's Rally
description: When using a shield, you ready your block more quickly after taking a hit.

name: Turtle Shell
description: If your shield is on your back, take reduced backstab damage and negate Spine Cutter.
additionalInfo: If you have a shield equipped and your main weapon two-handed, your shield will be put on your back. This grants 12.5% damage reduction against attacks that hit your back and prevents your opponent from proccing Spine Cutter.

name: Grounding Bolt
description: Anytime you summon a lightning strike on your oppponent, disable their ability to jump. Uppercutting your opponent while they are unable to jump now strikes them with another bolt of lightning.
additionalInfo: The anti-jump effect lasts 10 seconds and can have its duration refreshed by landing another eligible lightning strike attack. Lightning strikes from Grounding Bolt deal 15 Thundercall damage, and are procced by landing any uppercut, including uppercut-tagged Mantras. The lightning strikes have no cooldown, and can be caused by uppercutting a target who is under the effect of any anti-jump status effect, such as Taunt or Bear Trap; it does not explicitly have to be Grounding Bolt's anti-jump for the lightning strikes to trigger. Apply the Grounding Bolt effect by landing lightning strikes from Scorched Peak, Fulgurite Formation, the Specialist Set equipment Talents, and Storm/Stormbreaker enchantments during the rain.

name: Silencer's Blade
description: Meleeing a 'Suffocated' opponent will extend the duration of the Suffocation and grant a speed boost.
additionalInfo: Landing M1 attacks or criticals with the M1 tag on suffocated targets applies a new stack of suffocation that lasts 5 seconds. Grants a 22.5% speed boost for 3 seconds on proc.

name: A World Without Song
description: Every 3 hits with a Wind Mantra now procs Suffocating.
additionalInfo: Scales down to 4 hits when under 75 Galebreathe, and 5 hits when under 40 Galebreathe.

name: Oath: Silentheart
description: You vow to reject the Words of the Song, denying yourself of mantras in pursuit of your own path to true strength, no matter the cost. You can wield weapons with 25 points below their usual requirements.
additionalInfo: If you have any Mantras, they will be unusable and will be entirely invisible. The weapon requirement reduction effect only reduces weapon stat requirements, and not attribute requirements. Additionally, it stacks with Khan's Versatile. Silentheart abilities can proc the Enchantment of your equipped weapon with a 30 second cooldown.

name: Dread Fighter
description: Parrying and getting hit by mantras now give you stacks of Dread. Each stack lasts for 15 seconds.
additionalInfo: Each stack of Dread Fighter grants 5% Mantra damage reduction, capping at 5 stacks for 25% Mantra damage reduction.

name: Flow State
description: Enter a moment of extreme focus in which you can change the windup of your special attacks with the correct timing.
additionalInfo: Activating Ankle Cutter, Mayhem, Relentless Hunt, or Rising Star within 2 seconds of activating Flow State will enhance these attacks. Flow State has a 10 second cooldown, but landing a Flow State-enhanced Silentheart ability will reset its cooldown. Flow State may affect the damage, wind-up, number of attacks, sound effect, or properties of Silentheart abilities.

name: Mayhem
description: Initiate a special dash attack by pressing M1 during the start of your dodge.
additionalInfo: 16s CD per weapon type, 6s CD if feinted. Movesets and damage differ depending on weapon type. Gains the ability to autogrip if it is enhanced by Flow State.

name: Relentless Hunt
description: M1 while doing an Aerial Attack to initiate a special gap closer attack.
additionalInfo: 20s CD per weapon type, 6s CD if feinted. Movesets differ depending on weapon type. The Light Weapon variant hits twice if it is enhanced by Flow State.

name: Rising Star
description: Press CTRL + M2 to activate a special uppercut attack.
additionalInfo: 12s CD per weapon type, 4s CD if feinted. Procs all "on Uppercut" Talents. Movesets differ depending on weapon type.

name: Silent Cascade
description: Landing physical attacks on an opponent charges up your Silent Cascade, a devastating barrage that can be released with CTRL + M2.
additionalInfo: Landing 8 weapon attacks or Silentheart abilities grants the Silent Cascade status effect, allowing you to use the Silent Cascade attack. This effect lasts 30 seconds or until you use Silent Cascade. Deals 7.5 Oath damage per hit (6).

name: True Vantage
description: Venting makes you invisible briefly, as well as boosting your speed.
additionalInfo: Changes your Vent color to match the color of your Silentheart Tattoos.

name: Unmatched Dexterity
description: Press X to Quick Swap between weapons within your toolbar.
additionalInfo: You can now swap weapons and equipment while in combat. Pressing X will swap your current weapon with a random weapon in your hotbar. The keybind can be changed in settings.

name: Vengeful Pursuit
description: Your running attacks that don't hit send out a special mid-range crescent projectile that slows on hit. Tracks onto those with their backs turned to you.
additionalInfo: Base damage and scaling differ depending on weapon type. 8 second cooldown.

name: Golden Tongue
description: Typing or using a gesture gives a random buff to you and those around you. (60 second cooldown)
additionalInfo: This can either restore 30% of your maximum Ether or grant 10% damage reduction with a visual effect similar to Reinforce. The buff given to each player is rolled independently. Golden Tongue has a 70 second cooldown at 0 Charisma, with every Charisma invest reducing its cooldown by 0.25 seconds.

name: Snake Oil
description: Gain 40% more Notes from selling items. This is getting downright criminal. But I'm just a talent description, I can't stop you.

name: Absolute Pitch
description: You can cast Ritual Mantras instantly.
additionalInfo: If you have less than 100 Intelligence, this will instead halve the required Ritual Keys (rounded up).

name: Ether Overdrive
description: Gain 5% extra PEN and remove the cap on your PEN. Go beyond your limits.
additionalInfo: Removes the 50% cap on Mantra PEN.

name: Bloodiron Spirit
description: You regain some Armor upon killing enemies.
additionalInfo: Restores 2.5% of your maximum armor upon executing an enemy.

name: Oath: Soulbreaker
description: The sum of your fragments is greater than the whole. Though your very being is splintered and threatening to drift apart, every shard of you Vows to remain One. Your Oath is a solvent that joins all of your distinct selves into the gestalt you.

objectives: Have Hero reputation with Etris, Have a bell, Talk to Theadre and Yunshul
Use a Sinner's Ash inside Duke's manor after clearing it

additionalInfo: Your Ardour gains a new visual effect.

name: Soul Infusion
description: Infuse Ardour into your executions. If your execute is interrupted, the opponent remains down for a longer amount of time. Your Ardour Screams are projected further.

objectives: Talk to X amount of Shrine's

additionalInfo: Increases your execution speed by 40%, down to 1.8 seconds from 3 seconds. Upon successfully performing an execution, use Ardour Scream for free. Your Ardour Scream range is buffed, sfx is changed, and minimum Ether cost required to cast Ardour Scream is reduced from 100% Ether to 40%.

name: Formless
description: Teleport to a location within your Tacet bubble. Receive a slight speed boost when activating Tacet.

objectives: Talk to X amount of Shrine's

additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that costs 50 Ether with a 5 second cooldown. This tool allows you to teleport to your cursor's location, but you cannot teleport outside of the Tacet bubble. On teleport, Tacet will end early. The speed boost gained from using Tacet lasts 2.5 seconds.

name: Heart Reverb
description: Those picked up by your Rhythm are marked for 8 seconds. Whenever an opponent dodges your attack, detect their rhythm and vigor. You can use Rhythm while standing.

objectives: Talk to X amount of Shrine's

additionalInfo: If someone performs an action within Rhythm's range, they will be highlighted red, even through walls. Rhythm will now stay active after uncrouching, only deactivating if done so manually or if you take damage. If an enemy dodges your attack, their health and posture percentages will be displayed in text next to their character briefly.

name: Haunted Path: Specter
description: Build up spectral energy by performing successful dodges and landing Wind mantras. Your abilities no longer suffocate enemies.
additionalInfo: Turns your Galebreathe white. Increases the potency of your Winded from a 5% swing decrease to 15%.

name: Phantom Step
description: Press X to begine running at high speeds. While in Phantom Step, your dashes transform into Gale Dashes. (Must have at least 10% Spectral Gauge)
additionalInfo: Additionally grants a speed boost for the full duration. While active, your Spectral Gauge will be passively drained.

name: Vanishing Wraith
description: Your 'Aerial Attacks' while in Phantom Step will now teleport you behind your target.

name: Possession
description: After an apparition hits an enemy, receive 7.5% posture damage on all Galebreath attacks for 8 seconds. If the apparition hits while you have Phantom Step active, receive a 7.55% chip damage buff for 6 seconds.
additionalInfo: The chip damage buff only applies to Galebreathe Mantras.

name: Oath: Starkindred
description: You vow to feel the knowledge of all that is, all at once. Your heart beats with the world itself, as the Stars above watch over you.

objectives: Talk to Samael in the Derelict Highchurch (Songseeker Wilds) and kill Iblis, The Fallen Angel, then return to Samael.

name: Death From Above
description: Upon cancelling your Air Dash, reveal your wings and strike your enemy.
additionalInfo: Air dash canceling with your weapon equipped grants your Starnkindred Wings. Air dash canceling with your weapon equipped and your wings out performs a three hit slashing attack that deals 25 Oath/Slash damage per hit. Deals 15 Posture damage per hit.

name: Ichor Imbuement
description: Using a Starkindred mantra while your wings are not out increases the damage they deal by 2 times.
additionalInfo: Buffs any Starkindred Mantra if your wings are not out on cast.

name: Static Link
description: Flourishing or uppercutting an enemy creates a static link between you and your enemy.
additionalInfo: Lasts 15 seconds. The links are non-refreshable, meaning you will need to wait until after the duration ends to reapply them.

name: Jumper Cables
description: Being made Unconscious with an active tether allows you to steal health from a tethered target and not be made Unconscious.
additionalInfo: Whenever you would get knocked but have a tether active, steal HP from the target to survive the hit. This has a 4 second cooldown.

name: Link Conduction
description: While you have active tethers your lightning mantras cost less ether.
additionalInfo: Each active Link reduces the Ether cost of your Thundercall Mantras by 30%.

name: Static Ace
description: Using Lightning Stream with an active tether link targets your closest active link.
additionalInfo: Heavily reduces the windup of Lightning Stream.

name: Static Allure
description: Having two active tethers will cause the previous tethered enemy to get magnetized to your newest tethered enemy, also increases the duration of tethers by 15 seconds.
additionalInfo: Instantly procs when you create a new Static Link. The extra Link duration only applies to the Static Link that procced the magnetization effect.

name: Storm Link
description: While you have a Static Link on someone, your Wind mantras that hit them are imbued with flashes of Lightning.
additionalInfo: Adds a secondary instance of damage to your Galebreathe Mantras if they hit a Static Linked target. This deals 10% of your attack's scaled damage as Thundercall damage.

name: Grasp on Reality
description: Damage taken from insanity is reduced.
additionalInfo: Reduces damage taken from Scratching.

name: Magical Resolve
description: Being hit increases Ether regen for a short duration, the strength of the regen scales off your Willpower.

name: Unfazed
description: You are more resilient to the side effects of going insane. You no longer Shiver and you Panic with less severity.
additionalInfo: You now shiver at tier 2 Insanity instead of Tier 1. You now scratch yourself at tier 3 Insanity instead of tier 2. You can no longer Panic.

name: Voltaic Conductor
description: Your Thundercall Mantras deal 30% chip damage against enemies with conductor rods.

name: Iron Gut
description: You have resistance against being poisoned by foods.
additionalInfo: Heavily reduces the chance that you vomit upon eating bad food. This does not work on Pufferfish.

name: Termite
description: You can eat things most would consider inedible.
additionalInfo: Allows user to eat Sticks, Bamboo, Beeswax, Coral, Spider Eggs, all Lotuses, and every Ore.

name: Dustlunge
description: You can now assassinate your enemies from much farther, shadestepping to their location if they're too far. Assassinating an enemy will automatically assassinate other nearby enemies.

name: None Left Behind
description: You can now shadestep to pick up Unconscious humanoids far away from you.

name: Foolish Outburst
description: Blocking or parrying a vent will absorb the Tempo cost of the vent. A Tactician steadies the course of battle.
additionalInfo: Steals 40% of the Tempo used. Every point in Intelligence below 50 will reduce the Tempo steal by 0.66%, capping at a minimum of 23.33% of the Tempo absorbed with 25 Intelligence.

name: Hard Read
description: Hitting your opponent during a feint will cause them to be Dazed.
additionalInfo: Applies Daze for 1 second.

name: Punishing Blow
description: [Heavy Weapons] Daze opponents for 1s and Stagger PvE enemies for 2s when you interrupt their Basic Attack / actions with your own.
additionalInfo: If you M1 your opponent during their M1 animation, they will be dazed for 1 second. Also procs if you land a critical with the M1 tag during their M1 animation.

name: Target Switch
description: Parrying an opponent then hitting someone else makes your next mantra free.
additionalInfo: This effect is signalled by a yellow halo. Has a 4 second activation window with a 10 second duration.

name: Water off a Duck's Back
description: Venting will shift any elemental status effects affecting you onto those hit by your vent.
additionalInfo: Transfers Suffocation, Winded, Chill, Shock, Burn, and potion effects from yourself to your enemy on vent.

name: Controlled Combustion
description: Your Agitating Spark no longer spreads to your allies.
additionalInfo: Your Agitating Spark cannot spread to you either.

name: Artisan Chef
description: The food you cook now becomes Artisan food, increasing its hunger and thirst gained by +25%.

objectives: Cook 50 Food items (batch cooking does not count).

additionalInfo: Increases food nutritional value by 25%. Increases the healing gained from using Fondant Splitter's critical.

name: Master Chef
description: Buffs applied by food you cook now have their buff effects amplified by +30%.

objectives: Cook 50 Food items (batch cooking does not count).

additionalInfo: Increases the duration of food buffs by 30%. Increases the healing gained from using Fondant Splitter's critical.

name: Explosive Finish
description: If an enemy is on fire when you flourish, blast them away with a fire blast.
additionalInfo: Deals 5 Flamecharm damage. Upon proccing Emperor Flame, this Talent will be put on a 3s cd.

name: Flaming Flourish
description: Set enemies on fire when you flourish or uppercut them.

name: Emperor Flame
description: Absorb fire produced by you, once you reach 5 stacks your next attack will be an automatic Explosive Finish flourish. This flourish will deal additional damage and proc Wither, reducing your opponent's maximum health temporarily.
additionalInfo: Agitating Spark procs grant Emperor Flame stacks. At 5 stacks, gain the Emperor Flame status effect for 10 seconds, causing your next M1 to instantly proc Explosive Finish, dealing 15 Flamecharm damage. On top of this, this will deal an additional 25 Wither damage and apply burn. Emperor Flame also extinguishes self-applied burn through Agitating Spark. While Emperor Flame is on cooldown, the burn will not be extinguished and you cannot gain additional stacks. 30 second cooldown.

name: Mirage Clone
description: Successfully dodging leaves behind a heat mirage clone that sets enemies that swung at you on fire.
additionalInfo: 20 second cooldown. Causes an Eruption instead if you have Eruption path.

name: Grasp of Eylis
description: You can temporarily teleport to locations near your bounty target, if one can be found. However, you must stay close, or be desynchronized.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that can only be used in the Voidheart, teleporting you to your Bounty target. Choosing Stealth causes teleports you near, but far away from your target, hiding the bounty target. Choosing Ferocity teleports you close to your target, highlighting them through walls briefly. If Ferocity is chosen, your character will be enveloped in shadows, signifying that you have a bounty.

name: Voideye
description: Voidmother's blessing, the method to travel back to the Voidheart.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that teleports you back to the Voidheart on use. 1 minute cooldown.

name: Voidwalker Contract
description: You progress much faster from completing bounties, and less from events. Gain access to the Voidheart, and factions have a negative outlook on you.
additionalInfo: Gain increased EXP from bounties of all kinds, but gain reduced EXP from all other sources.

name: Cap Artist
description: Pressing CapArtist while crouching allows you to fake being dead. You also take a bit less damage from PvE while ragdolled as well.
additionalInfo: This can be deactivated by using the keybind again. Innately bound to Comma.

name: Pickpocket
description: Gain the ability to pickpocket by pressing N. Deal a little more damage the more notes you have against PvE opponents as well.
additionalInfo: You can only pickpocket Unconscious targets. Gain +0.0002% PvE damage for every 1 Note you have; grants +3% damage at 15,000 Notes.

name: Discharge
description: [Light Weapons] On 5th successful attack you will discharge static dealing lightning damage to those nearby.
additionalInfo: Deals 5 Thundercall damage with 5 Thundercall scaling, gaining 0.025 damage per point in Thundercall. Applies Shock or 1 Surge Rod on proc.

name: Rain of Static
description: After successfully casting lightning impact, strike down countless thunder at those below. In return your Lightning Impact will require more time to cast.
additionalInfo: When casting Lightning Impact, hover above the ground and fire multiple projectiles. Afterward, you strike down normally.

name: Windup Battery
description: Landing 3 Thundercall Mantras without whiffing reduces the windup of your next Mantra by 10%.
additionalInfo: Applies this bonus to non-Thundercall Mantras.

name: Static Blade
description: Hitting blocks, blocking or parrying hits will now generate an electric charge in your blade, granting a small speed buff. Charges can stack up to 5 times.
additionalInfo: Grants stacks when you '''get parried''', not when you parry attacks. Also grants stacks when you hit blocks or block attacks. Each stack lasts for 15 seconds and refresh upon gaining another, including when you're at max stacks. Each stack grants an ~2.35% speed boost, totaling to ~11.75% speed at max stacks.

name: Gathering Electricity
description: Reaching 5 Static Blade charges will now consume the stacks and apply a lightning buff to your blade. 60 second cooldown.
additionalInfo: Clears all Static Blade stacks on proc. You can still gain Static Blade stacks while Gathering Electricity is active. For 15 seconds, this increases the base damage on your weapon attacks, including criticals by 3.

name: Overcharge
description: Your next dash after activating Static Blade is enhanced by lightning.
additionalInfo: Lightning Dashes increase your dash distance travelled by 2.3x and the duration of i-frames from rolling, but will end early if you attack.

name: Thundercall Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Thundercall to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Thundercall Attribute. This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Thundercaller
description: Grants you the ability to command Lightning as a Thundercaller.

name: Adept Thundercaller
description: You can now obtain 1-star Thundercaller mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Expert Thundercaller
description: You can now obtain 2-star Thundercaller mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Master Thundercaller
description: You can now obtain 3-star Thundercaller mantras.
additionalInfo: This Talent will be removed if you do not meet its stat requirements.

name: Discovery of Fire
description: Flints and Flamecharm are for simpletons.
additionalInfo: Grants the Discovery of Fire Talent tool that consumes 20 Ether to cause a lightning strike after a 1 second delay. On hit, this deals 3 Thundercall damage and lights all nearby entities and campfires on fire.

name: Shocking Finish
description: Following a flourish up with a lightning beam causes it to be casted instantly.

name: Static Fakeout
description: Roll cancelling immediately after a parry will cause you to teleport behind your opponent.

name: Static Flash Clone
description: When using lightning clones you instead disappear leaving behind a static clone for a short duration.

name: Manipulator
description: Deal 20% more critical attack damage to charmed enemies, but the effect is removed on impact.
additionalInfo: 10 second cooldown. This is inherently weaker on multihit criticals due to it only proccing once then going on cooldown. Unnecessary Theatrics or Overcharm can be used to reapply the Charm after Manipulator removes it on the same hit.

name: Narcissist
description: Charming an already Charmed opponent Overcharms you briefly. Guess you really were always that great.
additionalInfo: Overcharms yourself for 4 seconds. Charms yourself for 8 seconds, halved to 4 seconds if you have Disbelief.

name: Sow and Mend
description: Sacrifice 35% of your blood for temporary health.
additionalInfo: Gives 25 flat Temporary Health on use. 30 second cooldown.

name: Cyclical Exsanguination
description: Whenever you deal more than 20 damage to an enemy in an instance, pause your temporary health decay for 3 seconds.
additionalInfo: 8 second cooldown.

name: Embolism
description: If an enemy is guardbroken while you have temporary health, convert your temporary health into additional damage.

name: Hypovolemic Focus
description: While you have temporary health, your opponent regains far less posture from parrying you.
additionalInfo: The opponent regains 20% less posture damage from parrying you.

name: Cheap Shot
description: Your attacks gain 10% PEN multiplicatively when you have an active speed boost.
additionalInfo: Multiplies your PEN by 1.1x at 65+ Agility. Cheap Shot's PEN multiplier will be reduced by 0.11% for every point in Agility below 65, having a minimum multiplier of +7.22% PEN (or 1.072x PEN) at 40 Agility.

name: Crippling Comeuppance
description: Landing Revenge puts your opponent's Mobility slot Mantras on CD and applies Sluggish to PvE enemies for 15s.
additionalInfo: 30 second cooldown. For every point of Agility below 100, Crippling Comeuppance's duration is reduced by 0.1 seconds, having a minimum duration of 12.5 seconds at 75 Agility.

name: Down Comes the Claw
description: Landing a Critical while you have a speed boost prevents your opponent from being able to dodge twice in a row for 5s.
additionalInfo: Lasts 6.5 seconds despite what the description states. You cannot reapply this effect if it is currently active. For every point in Agility under 75, Down Comes the Claw loses 0.055 seconds of duration, capping at a minimum of 5.11 seconds with 50 Agility.

name: Maiming Claws
description: Down Comes the Claw now disables your opponent's posture regeneration for 6s on proc.
additionalInfo: While their posture is paused, your opponent cannot restore posture by parrying, spitting, passive posture restoration, or through Steady Nerves. All other forms of posture restoration ignore this effect entirely. Maiming Claws' duration will be shortened if you do not meet its requirements. Maiming Claws cannot be refreshed if Down Comes the Claw is currently active.

name: Pursuit
description: If you land your Revenge, clear the cooldown immediately. (25s cooldown)
additionalInfo: Procs even if Revenge is blocked, parried, dodged, or vented. For every point in Agility below 90, Pursuit will gain +0.375 seconds to its cooldown, capping at 29.4 seconds with 65 Agility.

name: Face Cutter
description: Your Spine Cutter now deals an additional hit.
additionalInfo: Grants an additional hit to your Spine Cutter that deals 25% of your weapon's scaled damage. Similarly to Spine Cutter, the damage of this attack cannot be buffed and it has no PEN.

name: Turning of the Wheel
description: After perfect dodging a swing or critical attack, step backwards and ramp up your swingspeed.
additionalInfo: Using an M1 after dodging a weapon attack will cause you to step back and then advance with faster swing speed.

name: Wraith Path: Twisted Puppets
description: Your Flamecharm mantras summon puppets of shadow and flame. Your flames are now black.
additionalInfo: Your Flamecharm abilities and status effects are now black. Your regular burn is now much weaker, dealing 87.5% less damage, but it now spawns Puppets on a 4 second cooldown. Your Shadowcast abilities can now apply burn that deals 75% less damage than default burn. Both of these burn types drain 6.25 Ether from affected targets per tick. Puppets deal 20 Typeless damage and 10 posture damage. Increases the uptime of your Flame of Denial by 25%.

name: Burning Puppets
description: Your puppets can now inflict burn and fire-based Talents when they explode.
additionalInfo: Grants your Puppets 5 Flameharm scaling, increasing their damage by 0.1 per Flamecharm investment. Your Puppets now apply 'Puppet Burn', allowing you to create more Puppets. Despite what the Talent description states, your Puppets don't proc any Flamecharm Talents.

name: Burning Sacrifice
description: Sacrifice puppets who have been alive for half of their lifetime and burn purple for Emperor Flame Stacks, a damage boost per puppet, and a slight speed boost.
additionalInfo: Puppets will turn purple if they've gone 15 seconds without hitting anything. You can sacrifice these purple Puppets with this Talent tool, granting a 4% damage buff per Puppet sacrificed (caps at 12%) and a small speed boost for 6 seconds. Additionally this grants 1 Emperor Flame stack per Puppet sacrificed. This has a 15 second cooldown if a Puppet is successfully sacrificed, and a 1 second cooldown if not.

name: Explosive Rage
description: Causing explosion will make your puppets go into a frenzy, speeding up and dealing 50% more damage.
additionalInfo: While buffed, your Puppets will gain an orange swirling aura. On proc, this buffs all currently alive Puppets and all Puppets that spawn within the next 10 seconds. The following abilities and Talents proc Explosive Rage: Explosive Finish, Emperor Flame, Scorchblood, The Final Act, and the Detonation enchant.

name: Moths to a Flame
description: Your Twister Puppets now home towards burning enemies.
additionalInfo: Puppets will now home in on targets who are burning with either of Twisted Puppets' burn types. When a Puppet gets close to a burning target it speeds up.

name: Audacity
description: Once you've brought down your prey, instill fear into all those who would separate you from claiming it. Charmed or nearby enemies will fear for longer. Nearby allies gain a 10% damage buff (40s).
additionalInfo: Applies true stun to nearby enemies when you start a manual execution on a humanoid target. 25 second cooldown. The buff duration will be reduced by 0.1 seconds for every point of Charisma and Strength you are below Audacity's requirements, capping at a minimum 35 second duration with 75 Charisma and 25 Strength.

name: No Survivors
description: Your allies and yourself execute faster when affected by Overcharm.
additionalInfo: Reduces grip time by 0.5 seconds (16.67% faster).

name: Denial Repulse
description: You now emit a delayed burst of flames after coming close to death.
additionalInfo: When Flame of Denial protects you, release an explosion around you. This deals 20 Flamecharm damage with 5 Flamecharm scaling. This cannot be parried nor dodged, but can be blocked, dealing 5 posture damage. Has a windup of 0.6s.

name: Undying Flame
description: Your Graceful Flame burns brightly even underwater. Those that gather around it are soothed and regain sanity.
additionalInfo: Graceful Flame can be casted in the First Layer. It cannot be used in the Diluvian Mechanism or Depths Trials, however. Graceful Flame passively restores sanity and health to those around it.

name: Surge Path: Unstable Capacitor
description: Your lightning no longer applies Shock, instead apply Surge. At maximum stacks of Surge, your opponents will Overload, sending arcs of lightning in every direction.
additionalInfo: Turns your Thundercall abilities blurple. Shock is replaced with Surge Rods, a stacking status effect that Overloads upon applying five Rods and then landing an attack that would apply a sixth, consuming all of the Rods. Each Rod has an individual 30 second duration. Surge Overloads deal 2.5 Thundercall damage per Rod with 5 Thundercall scaling to Overloaded target, gaining 0.0125 damage per Thundercall investment, and 2 Thundercall damage per Rod in an AoE that does not hit the Overloaded target.

name: Battery Sapper
description: If your Human Battery targets have Ether, it will drain their Ether to help pay for your Mantras. 10s cooldown.

name: Catalytic Strike
description: Posture breaking an enemy will Overload their Surge stack.

name: Closed Circuit
description: Surge Overloads that fail to arc to other opponents will deal additional damage to the Overloaded enemy.
additionalInfo: Adds 5 Thundercall damage with 5 Thundercall scaling to the Overload, gaining 0.025 damage per Thundercall damage. This is a flat value that does not depend on Rod count.

name: Human Battery
description: When you are out of Ether, convert the Surge stacks of nearby enemies into Ether to pay the cost of your Mantras.
additionalInfo: Each Rod equates to 10 Ether. Works on Rods that weren't applied by you, but does not work on Rods applied to you.

name: Flashboil
description: Landing Ice/fire attacks on burning/chilled enemies extinguishes the flame and generates steam.
additionalInfo: Steam deals 2 typeless damage per tick, at 6 ticks per second. Steam cannot be blocked nor parried.

name: Boiling Point
description: Using a fire mantra near your own steam cloud detonates it.
additionalInfo: Deals 10 typeless damage. This cannot be parried nor blocked. Procs when you hit the Steam cloud with your Flamecharm Mantra, meaning your opponent can parry your Mantra and this will still proc.

name: Action Surge
description: Adrenaline Surge now increases your swing speed by 0.04 for its duration.
additionalInfo: Both this and Vigil's Grace are applied before Lightning Cloak's swing speed multiplier.

name: Bear Trap
description: Landing a hit with your critical against an opponent makes your opponent unable to jump for a duration. Also slows your opponent and procs Sluggish on PvE.
additionalInfo: Affected targets cannot jump for 4 seconds. Targets gain 6 seconds of Bear Trap immunity.

name: Blade Dancer
description: Landing a Basic Attack removes your roll cooldown.

name: Cut to the Chase
description: Air Counter damage scaling is largely increased. Landing an Air Counter now initiates an uppercut. Deal 5% more damage to PvE enemies in the air.
additionalInfo: Adds 10 True damage to your Air Counter. The damage bonus will be lessened if you do not meet the Talent's requirements.

name: Speed Demon
description: Your attacks now inflict a reduced-strength bleed while you have a speed boost. 1s cooldown.
additionalInfo: Speed Demon's bleed deals 2.5% of your weapon's scaled damage every 0.3s, three times. This totals to 7.5% of your weapon's scaled over a 0.9 second period. Bleed deals typeless damage.

name: Spinning Swordsman
description: Running attacks do +15% extra damage when you have a speed boost.

name: Oath: Visionshaper
description: You vow to only see that which you wish to see. Reality itself is malleable, pliable to your deft hands.

objectives: Complete Aelita's Encounter or Carnival of Hearts, bring a Dark Feather to Surge.

name: Cheap Trick
description: When hit below half health briefly disappear, leaving behind an illusion clone to keep your enemy occupied for a short duration. Briefly disappear after knocking an enemy.
additionalInfo: Being hit while under half HP grants I-frames and turns you invisible for a very short duration. 60s CD. Knocking an opponent turns you invisible for 2.5 seconds with no I-frames.

name: Reality Shift
description: Command the closest conjured servant to attack their hallucinating target, either using a Critical Attack or a Mantra.
additionalInfo: Your last used Mantra or critical attack will be stored in your clones when you summon them. Using the Reality Shift Talent tool or hotkey will perform the stored action.

name: Shared Mimicry
description: The servants you have conjured will imitate your actions when you Swing/Block/Parry/Jump.
additionalInfo: Your clones will also Vent when you Vent. This can trigger even if you do not have Tempo or if you press G while in an animation.

name: Encore
description: Your Sing will stun opponents who are already charmed.
additionalInfo: Applies 0.4s of true stun. Doesn't affect allies.

name: Vow of Mastery
description: The Vow of Mastery grants the Master the power to command their Subject. To initiate a vow you must ask the other player if they'd like to make the vow. e.g. "wanna make a vow of mastery?"
additionalInfo: Players who take the vow are considered allies with their master and others who take the vow. Commands Given: "Sleep", "Drop", "Run", "Eat", "Say (Text)", "Use", "Locate", and "Leech" at base. "Fight" and "Sacrifice" at 50 Charisma, "Return" at 60 Charisma, and "Explode" at 75 Charisma.

name: Command: Live
description: Once per hour, command a servant to defy all odds and obey your command - live.
additionalInfo: Fully heals your Servant if they are below 40% health. The cooldown of this Command scales on your Charisma investment.

name: Command: Summon
description: Command your servant to obey your summons and appear before you no matter the distance.
additionalInfo: Teleports the subject to the master regardless of distance. Teleportation takes 10 seconds to complete, and any hit will cancel it. 30 second cooldown for the Master, 2 minute cooldown for the Servant.

name: Chronostasis
