description: Landing a Basic Attack or Critical puts the target's Resonance on cooldown for a short duration, while also applying Ether Sunder to PvE opponents.
additionalInfo: On hit, apply a 13 second Resonance cooldown. This cannot proc if their Resonance is already on cooldown.

name: Conditioned Swimmer
description: You lose less hunger and thirst while swimming.

name: Brutal Momentum
description: [Heavy Weapons] Successfully dodging will give you hyperarmour on your next swing.

name: Matador
description: Deal +20% more damage to human enemies with hyperarmor.

name: Showstopper
description: When an enemy would roll through one of your physical attacks, stomp the ground, dazing anyone nearby. Removes speed buffs from target upon landing.

name: Switchblade
description: You can now utilize Dagger Talents when not wielding a dagger.
additionalInfo: This applies to all weapon types, applying the effects of Dagger Talents to any equipped weapon.

name: Warrior's Swing
description: [Heavy Weapons] Reduces incoming damage by 5% if hit during Heavy swing hyperarmor.

name: Haunted Gale
description: Landing 3 Galebreathe Mantras without whiffing calls forth a Haunted Phantom. The Phantom will attack alongside you for the next 8s before dissipating.
additionalInfo: On proc, gain the Haunted status effect, spawning ghosts that attack your opponent every time you land a Mantra. Ghosts have 15 base damage with 5 Galebreathe scaling. Having Gale Wisp active increases the duration of Haunted by 3 seconds. If you have Apparitions, landing a Galebreathe Mantra while having the Haunted Gale status effect will create an Apparition instead while non-Galebreathe Mantras will summon Haunted Gale's Ghosts like normal.

name: Agility Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your agility to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Agility Attribute. The requirements to obtain this Talent will be increased to 77 or 78 if your Aspect has increased Agility on spawn, though this limitation will be removed if you have the Multifaceted Echo Unlock. The quest requirement for this Talent will be removed if you've obtained it previously on your account.

name: Ash Ember
description: The more wither your opponent has, the more damage your burn deals.
additionalInfo: At 90 FLM 90 WPN you gain a 0.0175 burn damage increase per 1 point of wither. This has very slight Flamecharm and Weapon scaling.

name: Brassneck
description: Knocking an enemy grants you 20% damage resistance for 15 seconds.
additionalInfo: Works on non-humanoid monsters, applying the damage reduction after they die.

name: Careful Handling
description: Reduce your chances of dropping ingredients on death.

name: Dragon's Song
description: Using a mantra after an uppercut grants ether.
additionalInfo: Grants +20 Ether on proc. 2 second cooldown.

name: Full Reset
description: Knocking an enemy resets your resonance cooldowns. This effect has a 60 second cooldown.
additionalInfo: Also works on non-humanoid monsters, resetting your Resonance cooldown after they die.

name: Gourmand
description: Your hunger and thirst gain from eating is increased.
additionalInfo: Increases hunger and thirst gain by 20%.

name: Heavy Haul
description: Enemies who carry you move significantly slower. Take slightly less posture damage from large enemies. Takes one to know one.

name: Martyr
description: When you're knocked Unconscious, enemies gain less health and posture, and allies around you are granted Martyrdom for 20s
additionalInfo: Martyrdom grants a +20% damage and damage reduction buff to your allies. Enemies who knock you restore only half of the posture and health they would normally obtain (50% -> 25%).

name: Polite Awakening
description: Upon recovering from being Unconscious, your health is restored up to a minimum of 15% of your max health.

name: Ready or Not
description: The first attack to hit you while out of combat has its damage cut in half.

name: Replenishing Knockout
description: You gain more health and posture from downing enemies.
additionalInfo: Knocking enemies will replenish 1.5x more of your health and posture (50% -> 75%).

name: Treefelling Blow
description: You can collect lumber from the trees you fell with your fists. It's only natural.
additionalInfo: Allows you to gain Wood when you destroy trees with Strong Left.

name: Assassin's Strike
description: Your Rapid Slashes now deals twice the amount of damage.
additionalInfo: Doubles the base damage of Rapid Slashes.

name: Battle Frenzy
description: The grip on your weapon tightens, reduce the posture of all mantras you block with this effect scaling with the number of combat tags you have on your character.
additionalInfo: This reduces the posture damage of incoming Mantras by 1 per hit, per combat tag you have. If you have more combat tags than the Mantra does posture damage, this can go into the negatives and your posture will be restored instead.

name: Belief
description: Your medium weapon mantras now deal extra damage based on how much Willpower you have.
additionalInfo: All of your Medium Weapon Mantras gain a second damage instance that scales directly on your Willpower investment and deals true damage. This deals 0.15 damage per 1 Willpower investment, up to 15 damage at 100 Willpower. This has no cooldown. Having One With Flame active adds an additional +0.05 damage to Belief, for every 1 Flamecharm investment you have.

name: Blitz
description: Increase how quick you release your Prominence Draw.
additionalInfo: Decreases Prominence Draw's windup by 0.1s (from 0.55s to 0.45s).

name: Blood Drinker
description: Recover health on hit. When landing a critical, deal 30 bleed damage over 5 seconds.
additionalInfo: Restores 4% of the user's maximum health upon landing M1 attacks. The "bleed" is a unique damage over time status effect that is not bleed. This deals 6 damage per tick and ticks 5 times over 5 seconds. This can proc on Motif-given critical attacks. If you are knocked during the duration of this "bleed" effect, you will be instantly gripped.

name: Bulwark Breaker
description: Increase the size of your Pressure Blast, with the last hit of it dealing increased posture damage. Your Pressure Blast is also now unparryable.
additionalInfo: Increases the AoE and range of your Pressure Blast. The final hit of your Pressure Blast deals 3x the posture damage (from 12 to 36), increasing the total posture damage of the Mantra from 36 to 60.

name: Careful Stance
description: Gain a bit more autoparry frames on successful parries.

name: Clutch Recovery
description: When at 30% health or below, every time you land a light attack or critical hit heal 1%.
additionalInfo: If you are at or below 30% of your maximum health, heal 1% of your maximum health upon landing any weapon attack.

name: Corporeal Dissolution
description: Applies Wither on any weapon attack that drains Ether, and scales on the amount of Ether drain.
additionalInfo: Caps at 30 Wither damage per proc.

name: Cruel Counter
description: When using your initial charge up on your Krulian Knife, if you interrupt someone's attack with it apply Cruel Counter on them, massively increasing the damage they take from your critical attacks.
additionalInfo: If you interrupt someone's attack with the shock from your Krulian Charge critical, apply the Cruel Counter status effect to your opponent, increasing all damage taken by critical attacks for 20 seconds. This grants a 40% damage buff to all critical attacks (including those that aren't Krulian Knife's), bypassing the damage modifier caps.

name: Curved Edge
description: Your light weapon mantras now gain 30% more chip.

name: Expeditionary Evasiveness
description: The design of this rapier allows you to much more swiftly attack in tandem with your mantras, giving Agility mantras you use +3 levels in all stats, even bypassing the level cap.
additionalInfo: Your Agility Mantras gain 3 Mantra levels, bypassing the level 5 cap. This is not displayed on the Mantra tooltip. Jetstriker Mantras are unaffected by this.

name: Expeditious Combo
description: Landing an uppercut will grant a buff to your Onslaught for 15 seconds, using Onslaught during this time will massively increase the speed of it.
additionalInfo: Passively increases the speed of your Onslaught. After landing a basic attack uppercut, gain the Expeditious Combo status effect for 15 seconds, displayed on the cooldown indicator. Casting Onslaught while you have this status effect will massively increase its speed, consuming the status effect in the process. This has no cooldown, but must be manually refreshed every time you use it.

name: Extended Trauma
description: Successful light attacks and criticals on your opponent now also gives them a bit of posture.
additionalInfo: Deals 3 posture damage to non-blocking opponents on M1, and 10 posture damage on critical. This cannot posture break, and this does not benefit from posture damage modifiers.

name: Finishing Slay
description: If you land a critical attack while also having stacks from the Chain of Perfection talent, consume all those for a massive damaging attack. This works on other players as well.
additionalInfo: Consumes all of your Chains of Perfection stacks for a secondary instance of damage on your critical. This deals 7 typeless damage per Chain of Perfection stack in PvP, or 166 typeless damage per stack in PvE. The first 5 hits that normally do not grant stacks will contribute to this, allowing you to deal 150 PvP damage or 3.5k PvE damage at maximum Chain stacks. This can be buffed, but it is not considered as a weapon attack, limiting buffing options. Finishing Slay has no cooldown, allowing multi-hit criticals to deal massive damage in PvE.

name: Forced Fulfilment
description: Your Metal Greatsword now has Metal Fakeout as its critical attack. Landing a critical attack using your Metal Greatsword attaches a heavy rod onto your opponent, heavily slowing them.
additionalInfo: The Metal Fakeout critical only works while you are in range of a target. Additionally, this critical applies Bleed and counts as a weapon attack, not a Mantra. The rod applies a 52.5% slow for 15 seconds.

name: Fortify
description: Slow down your movement in exchange for fortifying your defenses.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that grants 15% damage reduction at the cost of reducing your movement speed by 36%.

name: Phantom
description: For the next 5 seconds, your next basic attack bypasses block after landing a crit. [45 second CD]
additionalInfo: Your weapon attacks that bypass block apply shaky block.

name: Pierce Through
description: Remove the autoparry frames the first hit of your base spear critical has.
additionalInfo: The default spear critical attack no longer cancels if the first hit is parried. Additionally, parrying the first hit of this critical does not provide autoparry frames.

name: Pugnacious
description: Become stronger the more you are combat tagged. Gain even more strength whenever you grip a player.
additionalInfo: Gain various stacking buffs scaling on the amount of combat tags you have. Gain a further damage buff upon executing a player. On basic attack, gain +10% to the following stats: damage, posture damage, elemental damage resistance, physical damage resistance, chip damage, and speed boost per combat tag you have. The damage, posture damage, and chip damage effects ignore the modifier caps but cap at +30%. The resistance bonuses are multiplicative to other sources of their respective resistance types. The speed boost has no cap in effectiveness.

name: Punishing Riposte
description: When parrying a guardbreak, enhance your critical for the next 15 seconds. If you land your crit on your opponent's block while it is enhanced, immediately guardbreak your opponent.

name: Rat's Spirit
description: Each hit of your critical will deal an extra 10 true damage per combat tag whenever you are combat tagged by 2 or more people.
additionalInfo: Being combat tagged by 2 or more players will cause your critical attack to deal an additional 10 true damage per hit. This scales on how many combat tags you have, gaining +10 damage per.

name: Rosen's Technique
description: If you use Tactical Reload, Rosen's Peacemaker has 45 seconds less off its cooldown.
additionalInfo: Reduces the cooldown of Tactical Reload by 45 seconds; from 90 seconds to 45.

name: Sable Winds
description: You can now Inhale Shadowcast mantras. Aftercut effects now drain a small amount of ether based on the damage they deal.
additionalInfo: Inhale bonuses now apply to Shadowcast Mantras as well.

name: Sacrificial Boon
description: Sacrifice 5 knowledge to activate Blessing, giving you a random blessing from Navae.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that consumes 5 KnowledgeSprite on use to grant the user a random buff within a set pool. This has a 0.5 second cooldown, potentially allowing you to stack the buffs. Potential buffs are: 20% damage buff, hyperarmor for 10 seconds, instantly heal 50 health, thirst restoration, stomach restoration, or a speed boost for 10 seconds.

name: Soar
description: Retain full walkspeed while using your crit.
additionalInfo: This allows you to retain your full momentum during your weapon critical. This Talent will be disabled if you equip a Motif onto the Withered Gale Pale.

name: Sovereign's Counter
description: Improve the efficiency of every counter you use. This effect becomes stronger for Punishment if you have the Riot Breaker talent.
additionalInfo: Punishment has its reflected damage output increased by 12.5% additively, meaning at level 5 you can reflect 112.5% of someone's damage on top of the base damage. If the Authority Commander Outfit is equipped, the longevity of the attack window on your Punishment is increased by 3x; from 20 seconds to a full minute. Prediction's active frames are increased slightly. Curse of the Unbidden has its posture restoration increased by 10%, restoring 40% of your posture. Payback has its active counter frames increased by 0.7 seconds.

name: Spinal Splinter
description: Landing a backstab with your critical deals 15 extra true damage.
additionalInfo: If your critical attack hits your opponent's back, it will gain an secondary damage instance that deals 15 true damage.

name: Static Beatdown
description: Landing a Thundercall mantra electrifies the metal in your Cestus for 8 seconds, extending how long your opponents are stuck in shaky block based on your total Thundercall investment.
additionalInfo: Shaky block duration scales on your Thundercall investment, increasing by +0.004s for every point in Thundercall.

name: Subzero
description: Landing a running attack inflicts your opponent with a deep freeze. Additional light hits after the opponent thaws out will briefly slow them as well.

name: Swift Strike
description: Land a light attack behind your opponent to enhance your next critical, allowing you to teleport behind your opponent and strike them. This enhanced critical also procs assassination talents.
additionalInfo: On proc, you gain the Swift Strike status effect indefinitely. This effect will be consumed when you use your critical. The teleport has a range limit. 20 second cooldown.

name: True Seraph Slash
description: Landing the first hit of your critical attack enhances your next critical, giving you access to the Angels' spear smite ability. Having Starkindred Wings out or Angel's Guise adds 1 bolt to your enhanced crit.
additionalInfo: This deals 0.75x of your weapons scaled damage as typeless damage per hit (4 at base). Having Angel's Guise or Starkindred wings out adds an additional hit. Having both adds a second additional hit and summons an allied Sworn Angel.

name: True Shatter
description: Landing a critical shatters your opponent, ridding them of their speed debuffs and dealing true damage scaling off how slow they were.
additionalInfo: Deals 5 true damage per slow debuff.

name: Vital Wound
description: Uppercutting your opponent punctures their lungs, slowing their rate of posture recovery by 30% for 30 seconds.
additionalInfo: Uppercutting your opponent applies the Vital Wound status effect, reducing their passive posture recovery by 30% for 30 seconds. This has no cooldown, but it cannot be refreshed or reapplied while it's active.

name: Actions Speak Louder
description: Your Critical Attack cooldown is 20% shorter, but your Resonance cooldown is 20% longer. In areas where your Resonance is suppressed, reduce your cooldown by 10% instead.
additionalInfo: In 1v1 Chime of Conflict, your critical cooldown is reduced by 10% instead.

name: Alloyed Soles
description: Reduces the duration of Knockdown applied to you.
additionalInfo: Reduces knockdown duration by 75%.

name: Already Dead
description: You take reduced damage from abilities with a health cost.
additionalInfo: Removes the self damage from Deepspindle's running critical. Reduces the self damage from Shade Devour, Flame Within (on cast, NOT the burn ticks), Rush Hour, Shadow Travel, Electrify, and 'Poison' Corrupt Resonance downside. Reduces the self Wither gain from Symbiotic Link and the 'Wither' Corrupt Resonance downside.

name: Angel's Guise
description: You resemble one of the Sworn Angels.
additionalInfo: Grants immunity to the Watcher's Watcher Gaze attack, preventing Sanity loss, vision distortion, and the spawning of Hollow Angel(s). Additionally grants unique dialogue with the Watchers.

name: Art of the Deal
description: Your rapport with merchants gives you lower prices!
additionalInfo: Reduces the purchase price of items by 10%.

name: Blinded
description: Your vision is obscured by something. Somehow, you feel safer. You remember the warmth of your youth.
additionalInfo: Makes everything darker and creates fog at long distances. Grants immunity to the Flame Blind and Gaze Mantras.

name: Blood Convergence
description: Receive 10% more healing from all healing sources when you have temp health.

name: Blood Pact
description: Gain 50 bonus temporary health whenever you knock/kill an enemy.

name: Blood Necrosis
description: Your bloodless gems heal 33% less than usual.
additionalInfo: You will now need a scaled damage of 75 to hit the regular Bloodless Gem heal cap of 15.

name: Blood Plague
description: For every light attack you land, add one Blood Plague stack on your opponent. Landing a Critical Attack converts all Blood Plague stacks into temporary health but missing the attack loses them.
additionalInfo: M1s apply stacks of Blood Plague. On critical, all Blood Plague stacks will be consumed to grant Temporary Health if your critical attack lands, with the amount of Temporary Health given scaling on the stacks of Blood Plague. The stacks of Blood Plague will be consumed regardless of if your critical attack lands, however.

name: Brute Strength
description: Your vent is replaced with a ground slam attack that knocks back enemies.
additionalInfo: Deals 35 Blunt damage with 20 Posture damage. This cannot be buffed through damage modifiers. Increases your Vent's windup from 0.25s to 0.5s.

name: Coldseep Reactor
description: By cultivating the localized chemosynthetic microorganisms within the Depths and utilizing them as a power source, your helm thrums with a protective field of static electricity and heat.
additionalInfo: You can no longer gain parasites while in the Second Layer.

name: Cosmic Connection
description: All celestial and astral related abilities are buffed.
additionalInfo: Increases Astral's damage buff in PvE from +20% to +25%.

name: Crippling Impact
description: Landing a critical  on someone while Wrath Gem is active disables their vent for a few seconds.
additionalInfo: The duration of this effect scales on your Strength investment, being 2 seconds + 0.015 seconds per point of Strength. This lasts for 3.5 seconds at 100 Strength.

name: Destructive Yell
description: Your Ardour Screams now break campfires around you and have a larger AoE.
additionalInfo: Your Ardour Scream destroys all campfires within its range.

name: Diver's Resilience
description: You can parry unparryable attacks from giant monsters, but due to the heft of the plate, you have slightly reduced speed.
additionalInfo: You can now parry certain NPC attacks that are normally unparryable. 10 second cooldown.

name: Drop Dead
description: Take less damage when you are crouching.

name: Elegy of Light
description: The Unspoken Vow of the Waking God resonates through you, if briefly. Protects you from the effects of Deep Gems for 3 minutes and provides you Gem Enhancement. Remains dormant until you take the life of an equal.
additionalInfo: On use, Deep Gems cannot have their effects proc on you and your Deem Gems have increased effectiveness in PvE for 3 minutes. This ability requires you to kill a player of equal or higher level or a boss to recharge its effect.

name: Enforcer's Strength
description: Your enemies recover 20% less posture on parry.

name: Enforcer's Technique
description: Your flourishes deal 35% more damage.

name: Ether Adeptness
description: Your mantras now deal extra chip.
additionalInfo: Grants 5% chip damage.

name: Ether Emergency
description: When you get hit below 25% health, exhaust all of your ether to gain a flat health boost (healing scales of total max ether). You are briefly unable to cast Mantras.
additionalInfo: On proc, restore health equal to 15% of your maximum Ether. 5 minute cooldown.

name: Ether Tension
description: Deal bonus true damage whenever you guardbreak an opponent with a mantra.
additionalInfo: Deals 10 true damage.

name: Ether Pinpoint
description: Mantras that have Might Gem on them now ignore fully ignore the posture bonus from shields.

name: Fatal Strike
description: Landing a guardbreak with a strength mantra that has a Wrath Gem on it devastates your opponent, slowing them down.
additionalInfo: Applies a 50% slow for 5.5 seconds. 10 second cooldown. This deals an extra 15 true damage on proc if you are using the full Reinforced War set.

name: Featherfall
description: Prevents falls from damaging you. After sufficient damage has been resisted, the pendant will go inactive and require time to recharge.
additionalInfo: Nullifies fall damage. Once 255 fall damage has been nullified, this will go on a 2 minute cooldown, disabling its benefits.

name: Flashwind
description: Anytime you proc Air Pressure or Overcharge, give yourself the ability to have enhanced dashes again for a few seconds.
additionalInfo: After using a Gale or Lightning dash, gain the Flashwind status effect for 3 seconds, allowing you to perform Flashwind dashes.

name: Focused Strikes
description: All criticals deal 15% more posture damage.

name: Footwork Mastery
description: Landing a critical gives you an immense speed boost for 10 seconds.
additionalInfo: The speed boost lasts 15 seconds despite what the description states. 45 second cooldown.

name: Force Your Way
description: You can parry unparryable attacks from giant monsters, at the cost of armor durability.
additionalInfo: You can now parry certain NPC attacks that are normally unparryable. On proc, your armor will be drained, with the amount of armor lost being based on the damage the attack would normally deal. This Talent does not work if you have no armor durability.

name: Grotesque Resilience
description: You take reduced damage from 'Damage over Time' effects.
additionalInfo: Reduces burn damage by 50%. Reduces Flame Within's burn and bleed damage by 25%.

name: Heartwing Beat
description: Your heart beats a new rhythm, as your aerial attack takes on a new manifestation.
additionalInfo: Your aerial attack is replaced with Heartwing Beat, a slashing attack that applies bleed and deals Wither damage. This attack has a base damage of 25.5, copying the scaling stat from your equipped weapon. You cannot proc Air Counter or Relentless Hunt on Heartwing Beat. 6 second cooldown.

name: Herbivore
description: You gain more nutrition from eating plants.

name: I'm Blue
description: Improve the efficiency of your Blue Gems. Blue are the gems you use.
additionalInfo: Increases the effectiveness of Blue Gems by 40% additively.

name: Immortality
description: The remnants of the helmet's Mind Veil stir into life when you would be made Unconscious soaking all damage for a brief duration. 30s CD. Viscosity is rejected.
additionalInfo: Grants one instance of knock prevention. Having this Talent disables the Viscosity Enchantment.

name: Inky Pearls
description: The ether you eject is coated with inky shadow. Your vent now steals a small amount of ether.
additionalInfo: Turns your Vent black and makes it drain 47.5 Ether on hit. Additionally, your Vent can now proc certain Shadowcast Talents on hit like Sightless Still or Twisted Puppets' Shadowcast burn.

name: Instant Nucleation
description: Take less damage for a few seconds after you are guardbroken.

name: Jester's Ruse
description: Anytime you take damage, there's a 10% chance it gets completely nullified. Anytime you deal damage, there's a 10% chance it also gets completely nullified.
additionalInfo: Visionshaper's Cheap Trick visual effect plays on proc. This can proc if an attack is blocked, dodged, or parried. When this happens, the visual effect will play, but nothing will happen.

name: Laminated Armor
description: Reduces all incoming damage by 2/3 (applied after damage multipliers).
additionalInfo: Reduces damage taken and dealt by a flat 2 (3 in Vow of Iron). This is applied after regular resistances, allowing you to potentially fully nullify damage taken.

name: Mass Effect
description: For every Might Gem you have equipped on your mantras, slightly increase each Might Gem's power.
additionalInfo: Increases the posture damage bonus of Might Gems by 2.25% additively, for every Might Gem you have equipped on your Mantras.

name: Mindspark
description: The damage of your flames scale with how insane you are.
additionalInfo: Your burn damage is increased based on how low your Sanity is.

name: No Interruptions
description: When combat tagged by 2 or more players, render any ranged attack a lot less effective.
additionalInfo: Grants extremely high damage reduction and true hyperarmor against attacks that are coming from opponents from far away. This requires you to be combat tagged by at least two people. Self-combat tags do not count, but NPC combat tags do (you will still need to be combat tagged by at least one player for this to activate).

name: No Limits
description: Increase the cap on Bloodless Gem healing.
additionalInfo: Increases the cap for Bloodless Gem healing to 30. Due to Blood Necrosis reducing the healing gained from Bloodless Gems, you will need a scaled damage value of 150 to hit the 30 healing cap.

name: Osseous Surge
description: Flourishing an enemy enhances your boots for 10 seconds, allowing you to spawn a wave of bones in the way you're facing. Right click to activate this.
additionalInfo: Press right click within a 10 second window after landing a flourish to stomp and send a wave of bones in the direction you're facing. This deals high damage and sends your opponent upwards.

name: Praise The Sun
description: When standing in sunlight increase your natural health regen and reduce how long antiheal effects last on you.

name: Repeated Blows
description: Any strength mantra that has a Wrath Gem on it will reset its cooldown if you land a critical while a Wrath Gem is active.
additionalInfo: This has no cooldown, theoretically allowing you to infinitely reset the cooldown of your Strength Mantras.

name: Rock Blaster
description: Doubles your ore yields when mining.

name: Seamaster's Guile
description: While you're at the helm of a ship, it takes 25% less damage
additionalInfo: Your boat will take 25% less damage if the person piloting it has this Talent.

name: Sharpened Dagger
description: All backstabs deal 1 extra true damage (4 extra damage if done to PvE).
additionalInfo: This applies to attacks used against your opponent's back, not assassinations.

name: Simmerbloom
description: Basic Attacks on Pleeksty's Inferno are now granted flames.
additionalInfo: Basic attacks with Pleeksty's Inferno now apply burn with no cooldown.

name: Simple Buff
description: Your light attacks deal 7.5/15% more damage. Pretty simple.
additionalInfo: Grants a 7.5% (15% in Vow of Iron) damage buff to M1s.

name: Skillful Recovery
description: Increases passive Posture regeneration by 20% (or 35% in Vow of Iron). Recover 20% more posture when parrying attacks.

name: Sloped Plate
description: Reduces the amount of damage you take when guardbroken by 10.

name: Smoldering Touch
description: Guardbreaking your opponent sets them on fire.

name: Sorcerer's Skill
description: Decrease the amount of tempo it takes to vent by 5.
additionalInfo: This restores 5 Tempo after using your Vent instead of decreasing the Vent cost.

name: Sorcerer's Surge
description: Your vent's cooldown is reduced by 2.5 seconds.

name: Star Duster
description: You take 30% less damage from airborne enemies.

name: Stormcall
description: Anytime you land a storm strike apply stormcall shock on your opponent, damaging them if they try to use a mantra while its active.
additionalInfo: Your Stormcall Shocks from other Specialist Equipment Talents apply the Stormcall Shock status effect. If your opponent attempts to cast a Mantra while affected, they will take 15 Galebreathe/Thundercall damage and they will gain the Shock and Winded status effect.

name: Stronger Under Pressure
description: Your mantras with might gem now slow down your opponents, scaling with how many combat tags you currently have.
additionalInfo: This applies an 8% slow per combat tag you have, lasting 1 second.

name: Surestep
description: Your boots secure your footing in all forms of terrain by digging into the ground with metal spikes.
additionalInfo: Makes you immune to the ragdoll and movement speed debuff of the Wind from the Second Layer and Moon's Eyrie.

name: Survivalist
description: Resist the effects of Weather Effects.
additionalInfo: Take less damage from Acid Rain.

name: Temple Guard
description: For the first 0.3s of your Critical Attack's windup, you take 90% less damage from any attacks that cancel your windup.
additionalInfo: You will only gain the damage reduction if your critical attack gets interrupted.

name: Umami
description: Feast on foes with mighty cutlery. Chef Weapons now steal opponents hunger.
additionalInfo: Has a 35% chance to proc with a 3 cooldown per proc attempt, going on cooldown even if it fails to proc. The hunger and thirst steal are NOT affected by damage modifiers or resistances, rather exclusively being based on scaled damage dealt. Procs on: The Long Tong of The Law, The Flippers of Fate, The Pastry Paster, and Fondant Splitter.

name: Volt Draft
description: Using Inhale will now also make your Basic Attacks apply a storm strike. [20 second CD]
additionalInfo: This has a proc window of 5 seconds after using Inhale. Storm Strikes from this Talent deal 0.125 * (Thundercall + Galebreathe investment) Thundercall damage, capping at 25 damage with 100 points invested in both Attunements. Can proc Grounding Bolt.

name: Volt Reflex
description: Your dodge window is increased with the power of lightning, but also increase the cooldown of your dodges.
additionalInfo: Increases the dodge window based on your Thundercall investment. Increases your dodge cooldown (for both dodge types) to 2.4 seconds.

name: Way of the Wind
description: Being in the air briefly increases the speed of your mantra casts. This effect only lasts while you're in the air.
additionalInfo: On proc, a wind of gale will erupt from your legs, signifying that the effect is active.

name: Whistleguard
description: The favor of the winds is yours: landing three hits (five for light weapons) without taking damage against your opponent envelops you in a shield of wind.
additionalInfo: The wind shield grants one (1) autoparry frame and has a cooldown of 10 seconds. The shield will be dispelled early if you get hit (proccing the shield), cast a Mantra, feint an attack, or use a critical attack.

name: Winter's Protection
description: Your tightly-bound winter gear negates elemental damage buffs from weather on damage against you. Also seems to provide some resistance to the Gale.
additionalInfo: Increases the time it takes for the Second Layer's parasites to kill you. Negates weather-reliant damage buffs such as Frostdraw's increased damage when its snowing or Thundercall's increased damage when it's raining.

name: Woodland Terrain
description: You move slightly faster on grass.

name: Wormwarder
description: Your lantern generates a shroud of static electricity around you that the flesh-burrowing parasites of the Eternal Gale detest. It's not exactly the lightest thing to lug around, though.
additionalInfo: Makes you entirely immune to the Second Layer's Parasites, but at a cost of granting you a mobility debuff.

name: Bane
description: Activate to make your light attacks teleport to the closest enemy nearby.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that on use allows you to teleport to your opponent when you M1 for 20 seconds. This tool has a 100 second cooldown. The teleportation has a range limit of 25 studs. Additionally grants a speed boost for the full duration.

name: Battle-Hardened
description: Reduce how much damage you take from mantra guardbreaks by 20%.

name: Benefactor
description: Gain reputation for selling goods to Antiquarians within faction territories.
additionalInfo: Grants faction reputation upon selling items to their respective Antiquarian.

name: Breeze
description: Gain a permanent +2 speed at all times.
additionalInfo: Increases your studs/s movement speed by +2 permanently. This is not counted as a speed buff.

name: Brunt
description: While 2-handing, you take less posture damage.
additionalInfo: Reduce posture damage taken by 10% while 2 handing a weapon.

name: Centurion's Resolve
description: Your Legion Kata/Imperium Kata attacks deal 4% more damage.

name: Chief's Will
description: Way of Navae light attacks have 10% additional penetration.
additionalInfo: Gives M1 attacks and criticals with the M1 tag +10% PEN if you are using the Way of Navae fist style.

name: Circuit Breaker
description: Electrify no longer deals self-damage on use.
additionalInfo: Using this with the Deepscorn Casque will cause you to heal upon using Electrify.

name: Corrosive Touch
description: Landing a successful Critical Attack or Flourish will corrode a portion of your opponent's Armor.
additionalInfo: On proc, drain 5% of your opponent's armor. This has a 10 second cooldown.

name: Crippling Darkness
description: Your non-Basic Attacks have 20% PEN.
additionalInfo: Grants +20% PEN to any non-weapon attack. This not only affects Mantras, but things like Bleed or Burn too.

name: Demon Step
description: Activate to gain brief iframes while moving forward. This requires 50 ether to activate and increases your posture by 20% each use.
additionalInfo: On use, lose 50 Ether to travel a short distance forwards in iframes. Additionally, 20% of your current posture will be dealt to you as self-posture damage.

name: Devastating Power
description: Gain extra Ether for every Mantra in your arsenal.
additionalInfo: Gain 10 maximum Ether for every Mantra you have equipped.

name: Ferryman's Curse
description: Wearing this gives you a 20% chance to convert incoming elemental damage into Lightning damage.

name: Fists of Navae
description: Double the amount of ether you gain on successful light attacks.

name: Fleetfoot
description: Gain an initial speed boost when slide jumping.
additionalInfo: After using a Lightning or Gale dash, all dashes within the next 3 seconds will become enhanced. These enhanced dashes have the same effectiveness as Lightning and Gale dashes.

name: Focused Hematoma
description: Increase the amount of temporary health you receive by 15%.

name: Hunter's Reflexes
description: You have a slightly larger dodge window.
additionalInfo: Increases the dodge window by 0.05s.

name: Hyperbody
description: Apply a buff to your allies around you that increases your speed, defense, and regeneration. This effect becomes weaker the more allies you buff with it.
additionalInfo: Provides 35.5% damage reduction, scaling up with the amount of players buffed. Provides a 7.5 studs/s movement speed bonus, scaling down with the amount of players buffed. Hyperbody has a 30 second duration, but this duration will be reduced by 3s for every player buffed (including yourself). 2 minute cooldown.

name: Intrepid Flame
description: Flames wear off twice as fast on you. Flames that come from your Flame Within deal much less damage on you.
additionalInfo: Halves the maximum burn duration.

name: Knack
description: Trees yield more Wood when felled. Your Repair speed is increased.

name: Legendary
description: Parrying and landing hits with your weapon gives you ether back.

name: Lethal Dose
description: The poison from your hidden blade lasts twice as long.
additionalInfo: Doubles the duration of the Hidden Blade poison effect, from 8 seconds to 16.

name: Life Leech
description: Your summons now heal you each time they deal damage.
additionalInfo: The healing gained is based on summon damage dealt. This works on the following summons: monsters from the Parasol's Blight enchantment, The Weaving Web's critical attack, Illusory Servants, Illusory Counter, Lightning Clones, and Flame Sentinel.

name: Looter
description: Get extra loot from items you turn in for rewards.
additionalInfo: This affects: turning in Artifacts or the Strange Egg at a banker, turning in Sacks to Mercille, handing in pure ore to a Blacksmith, and trading in Explosive Crates to Scope.

name: Merchant's Accord
description: Merchants and Antiquarians will do business with you no matter how poor your reputation is.
additionalInfo: This Talent does NOT allow you to use the Antiquarian in the First Layer if you are not Deepbound or Ignition Delver.

name: Mocking Favor
description: When taunting, Aelita or Tillian appears, bestowing upon you a random boon of affliction. (30s cooldown)
additionalInfo: Grants a random buff or affliction from a set list whenever you spit or use an emote.

name: Overwhelming Might
description: Strong Left now guard breaks at level 5.
additionalInfo: 60 second cooldown.

name: Paired Soul
description: Wielding a katana with this outfit grants extra damage.
additionalInfo: Katana deals 25% more damage. Alloyed Katana, Shattered Katana, and Purple Cloud deal 5% more damage. This is a damage modifier.

name: Primal Rage
description: If you are below 50%, unleash your rage and increase the amount of damage you deal for 25 seconds as well as being able to see enemy health when you hit them.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that can only be used when you are under 50% health. While buffed, your hits will showcase the health percentage of your opponent. Additionally, gain a 25% damage buff for the duration of the effect. 3 minute cooldown.

name: Refreeze
description: Landing any sort of ability that causes bottom freeze reduces the cooldown of your Orbital Ice by 20 seconds.

name: Repeated Propulsion
description: Reduce the cooldown of Dancing Steps and Graceful Steps to 1 second.

name: Riot Breaker
description: You receive 15% less posture damage and deal 10% more posture damage when under attack by 3 or more enemies.

name: Scholar's Intuition
description: INT, WILL, and CHA Training Gear is 50% more effective.

name: Serpent's Dance
description: Unleash the power of Fang and Coil to unlock a devastating Running Critical Attack, feint to cancel momentum.
additionalInfo: This critical deals 1x of your weapon's scaled damage. This critical can only be used on Cestus that do not have a unique critical.

name: Soul Rip
description: Kill a player to gain 2 runes. Activate a rune when using this talent, and gain immense physical power, defense, and infinite ether for 25 seconds. Beware its strenuous downside.
additionalInfo: Grants a 50% weapon damage buff, ?% defense, infinite Ether, and a speed boost for the buff duration. Once the buff wears off, one of your legs will break, removing your ability to sprint for 30 seconds.

name: Sunset Ricochet
description: Makes your bullets ricochet to a nearby enemy when hitting an opponent.

name: Tempest Evolution
description: Your slide-jumped Wind Blades are naturally stronger and if landed grant +20% damage in the air for a few seconds.
additionalInfo: Increases the slide jump variant of Wind Blade's damage by 20%. Additionally grants a 20% damage buff for 15 second after landing slide cast Wind Blade. This damage buff only applies while you are airborne.

name: The Path, Unveiled
description: Your Jus Karita attacks deal 10% more damage.

name: Tidekeeper
description: Losing 25% of your health within the span of 3 seconds grants a 15% damage buff, 20% defense buff, and prevents from being knocked for 10 seconds.

name: Tidal Shock
description: Landing a successful Critical Attack will temporarily put you in a state where you dodge all mantras, as well as dazing your opponent.
additionalInfo: Your Critical attacks will apply Daze on hit. For the next 4 seconds after landing your Critical attack, if you were to be hit by any Mantra, you'll automatically dodge the Mantra instead, voiding its damage. This can be used to void self damaging Mantras. 13 second cooldown.

name: Unbreakable
description: You have reduced stun duration when block broken.
additionalInfo: Reduces the stun duration from being guardbroken by 33%; from 1.05s to 0.7s.

name: Vigil's Grace
description: Whenever you gain a speed boost, increase your swingspeed by 0.02.
additionalInfo: Stacks additively with Action Surge. Both this and Action Surge are applied before Lightning Cloak's swing speed multiplier.

name: Wind Dancer
description: Roll cancelling twice in quick succession will grant you a speed boost. One of your rolls must dodge a hit.
additionalInfo: Grants a 10% speed boost for 8 seconds. 10 second cooldown.

name: Withering Soul
description: Your Basic Attacks proc 12.5% of their damage as Wither. Wielding the Deepspindle or Umbrite Witherblade will double the amount to 25%.
additionalInfo: The Wither applied is based off your weapon's scaled damage.

name: Bloodless Overdrive
description: Gain bonus temp health everytime you land a mantra with a Bloodless Gem.

name: Captain's Call
description: Call up two Blacksteel Pirates to aid you in battle.
additionalInfo: On use, this summons two allied Blacksteel Pirates to assist you. 5 minute cooldown.

name: Critical Heal
description: Every time you heal, you have a chance to proc a Critical Heal, healing you 30 health. [5 second CD]

name: Enforcer's Pull
description: Your Enforcer's Pull is improved. Land a flourish to make it even stronger.

name: Etherguard
description: Warped Blue Gems now provide a bonus effect when landed using a mantra, Etherguard. This effect gives extra resistances to mantras based on how much ether they cost to cast + gain elemental protection against PvE.
additionalInfo: When landing a Mantra with a Warped Blue Gem equipped, gain the Etherguard status effect, granting you damage reduction to Mantras and elemental resistance in PvE. The damage reduction for Mantras scales on the Ether cost of the Mantra you got hit by.

name: Lasting Trauma
description: Anytime you land a Wrath Gem, your opponent becomes fearful, being unable to use their critical for a few seconds after you land it. This also buffs Fatal Strike, causing it to deal 15 true damage on proc.
additionalInfo: This applies the Fearful status effect for 19 seconds. Wrath gems have a 10 second cooldown, meaning you can potentially disable your opponent's ability to use their critical indefinitely. You deal 15 true damage if you guardbreak an opponent with a Strength Mantra that has a Wrath Gem on it.

name: Offensive Recovery
description: If all your mantras have Might Gems equipped, lose posture any time you hit opponents block with a mantra.
additionalInfo: If all of your equipped Mantras have a Might Gem equipped, hitting your opponent's block with Mantras will restore your posture.

name: Shock Trooper Specialist
description: Empower the mantras taught to you by your Legion Specialist Captain. You also now conjure a storm strike on your opponent by landing Gale and Thundercall mantras.
additionalInfo: Upon meeting a damage threshold, create a Stormcall Strike. The Storm Strikes deal 40 Thundercall damage and can proc Grounding Bolt. Additionally, your Electro Carve, Grand Javelin, and Thunder Kick become green, and your Astral Wind, Champion's Whirlthrow, and Gale Lunge become yellow. All of the aforementioned Mantras have their base damage increased by 15%.

name: Sorcerer's Supply
description: Increase the amount of Tempo you have by 10/30.
additionalInfo: Increases your Tempo by 10 in Pathfinder or 30 in Vow of Iron.

name: Test
additionalInfo: This is a placeholder Talent for a placeholder Outfit.

name: Residual Fury
description: [In Berserk State] Landing your critical grants +50% PEN on Basic Attacks for 8s.

name: Righteous Rage
description: [In Berserk State] You deal increased damage the lower your health is.
additionalInfo: Temporary Health does not count for this effect.

name: Rip and Tear
description: Regain health upon defeating an enemy.

name: Ruinous Recovery
description: Enemies recover 15% less Posture when parrying. Guardbreaking an enemy by parrying them deals massive damage, and can be done against even the strongest of foes.

name: Until It Is Done
description: Your Berserk State lasts until you willingly end it.
additionalInfo: Your Berserk has an indefinite duration, ending only when you use the tool again.

name: Breakthrough
description: Posture damage on light attacks are increased by 10%.
additionalInfo: Increases the posture damage of M1s by 10%.

name: Calamity Punch
description: Every successful Strong Left builds up stacks to perform a larger scale punch.

name: Dormant Strength
description: At max Calamity Punch stacks increased posture damage & physical damage.
additionalInfo: Increases your Strong Left's damage and posture damage if you are at max Calamity Punch stacks.

name: Relentless Barrage
description: Every swing from Rapid Punches deals more posture than the last. At max punch stacks enables hyperarmor during the barrage.
additionalInfo: Your Rapid Punches posture damage per hit scales on the amount of hits landed/blocked. At max Calamity Punch stacks, gain hyperarmor during Rapid Punches.

name: Shattering Left
description: Your Strong Left and Wind-up punches will always guard break mobs.
additionalInfo: Turns your Strong Left and Wind-Up enhanced attacks into guaranteed guardbreaks against blocking NPCs.

name: Threefold Impact
description: Every stack built with Strong Left provides a buff. 1st successful attack will reduces cooldown, 2nd ignores armor, and 3rd increases damage & guardbreaks.
additionalInfo: Grants buffs to your Strong Left based on how many Calamity Punch stacks you have. At one stack, your Strong Left cooldown will be reduced. At two stacks, your Strong Left will additionally deal typeless damage. At three stacks, your Strong Left will also guard break and deal more damage.

name: Blessing of the Moonseye
description: The Moonseye is not one eye, but many. All of them watch you. All of them know of your sins.

objectives: Go to the Moon's Eyrie and interact with the beam of light.

additionalInfo: Upon obtaining this Talent, you will lose all of your Sanity permanently. Defeating the three main progression bosses while having this Talent will unlock the Prince of the Moon Memento.

name: Ether Blade
description: Draw your foes ether into your weapon when you parry ether-based attacks. Gain Ether when you parry mantras.

name: Blinkstep
description: Your regular dash is enhanced into a Blinkstep above 90% ether but now has an ether cost.
additionalInfo: If you have 90% or more Ether, your regular dash will be replaced with a Blinkstep. This has much more distance than a regular dash. Consumes Ether on use.

name: Cutting Pace
description: Dodging attacks will now grant 'Cutting Pace' stacks. Mantras and basic attacks consume a stack to shorten wind-up and increase damage, procs after dash.
additionalInfo: Buffed attacks deal 15% more damage, have a slightly shorter windup, and are purple.

name: Drift
description: You're no longer slow enough to have to rely on parries. Dodge instead.
additionalInfo: Your parry is replaced with a low distance dodge if you successfully parry an attack.

name: Drifting Cloud
description: Cutting Pace now unsheathes the full potential of your Purple Cloud.
additionalInfo: Proccing Cutting Pace now unsheathes your Purple Cloud, giving it new animations and changing the damage type to Slash.

name: Faster Blade
description: A successful "Drift" now grants a speed boost.
additionalInfo: Procs when "parrying" an attack.

name: Lackluster Guard
description: You aren't used to having to block, resulting in weaker posture.
additionalInfo: Reduces your maximum posture.

name: True Drifter
description: You are a true drifter. Gain double the 'Cutting Pace' stacks and consume stacks to Blinkstep below 90% ether.
additionalInfo: Anytime you would have gained 1 Cutting Pace stack, gain 2 instead. You can now consume Cutting Pace stacks to use Blinkstep without being at 90% or more Ether.

name: Twin Drift
description: Hitting an enemy in the back after a roll cancel will bring upon twins who will follow up your assault.
additionalInfo: Performing a basic attack after a roll cancel will perform a second slash, then two light purple clones of yourself will attack the target.

name: Barrage Mastery
description: For every Ether Erudite stack you have, gain one extra orb whenever you fire your Ether Barrage.
additionalInfo: Increases the projectile count of Ether Barrage based on how many stacks of Ether Erudite you have.

name: Ether Amplification
description: For every Ether Erudite Stack you have, increase the size and damage of your Pressure Blast.
additionalInfo: Turns Pressure Blast light blue.

name: Ether Blitz
description: For every Ether Erudite Stack you have, reduce the windup of your enhanced Master's Flourish. This consumes your Ether Erudite stacks on use.
additionalInfo: Turns Master's Flourish light blue.

name: Ether Burst
description: Landing Rapid Slashes on your opponent gives them an overflow of Ether, causing them to take bursts of damage based on how many Ether Erudite stacks you had.
additionalInfo: Consumes your Ether Erudite Stacks. Turns your Rapid Slashes light blue.

name: Ether Erudite
description: The more total Ether you have, the more damage you deal. Gain Ether Erudite Stacks to improve your combat abilities. The max amount you can hold is 6.

name: Ether Quell
description: Landing a Critical Attack or Guardbreaking an opponent gives you 1 Ether Erudite Stack.

name: Ether Reflux
description: Successfully countering an opponent with Prediction gives you 2 Ether Erudite stacks.

name: Flames of the Past
description: Your flamecharm mantras now call forth fiery homing spirits.
additionalInfo: Your Flamecharm Mantras now spawn Twisted Puppets' Puppets on hit.

name: Pleetsky's Wrath
description: After dealing 500 damage with Flame Mantras, call forth a hail of fiery swords.
additionalInfo: Spawns swords from the sky, similarly to First Light's critical attack.

name: Electrical Accumulation
description: While having 4 or more orbs, automatically gain 4 charges of Static Blade whilst you have 4 orbs.
additionalInfo: Passively gain 4 stacks of Static Blade if you have 4 or more orbs.

name: Gathering Storm
description: Your damage is stored in a lightning orb. Sheathing your weapon will shoot the lightning orbs at the opponent. The orbs will do more damage based on how many orbs are being stored up.
additionalInfo: All weapon damage is stored instead of being dealt initially, similar to the Poser's Ring. Upon reaching damage thresholds of stored damage, lightning orbs will appear above your character's head, with a cap of 8 orbs. Upon sheathing your weapon, the orbs will attack your opponent, dealing all of the stored damage at once.

name: Heir of Lightning
description: At max orbs, Lightning Cloak is enhanced.
additionalInfo: Increases the base duration of Lightning Cloak to 15 seconds.

name: Orb Discharge
description: If an extra orb is available, you can consume it to vent if you don't have enough tempo.

name: Command Phoenix
description: Command your Phoenix to scout, and dive into enemies.
additionalInfo: Summoning an adult Phoenix, then commanding it to take air will allow you to select a spot where it should Divebomb on the next usage of the Talent.

name: Heliodar Wings
description: Take flight [H].
additionalInfo: Pressing H will sprout your Heliodar Wings. Hold Space while flying to ascend, Q to speed up, or CTRL to descend. Flying consumes Heartfire Gauge. If you run out of Heartfire Gauge while flying, you will be set on fire, ending the flight early. Taking damage from any source will cause your flight to end early.

name: Ascended Phoenix Flames
description: Once per fight, when an attack would down you immediately revive with 30% HP.

name: Prince of the Wind
description: You are the one who the wind bends around. Your galebreathe is enhanced.

name: Hardened Shell
description: Your Natural Armor grows sturdier, being able to take more hits before breaking.
additionalInfo: Increases your Natural Armor durability.

name: Steady Mind
description: Despite the finality of your mind and body succumbing to the effects of the depths, you manage to ward it off for a little longer.
additionalInfo: You can spend more time in the Depths before gaining Afflictions.

name: Glide Mastery
description: Experience using the glider you crafted results in you being able to glide faster in the air. You've also trained to quickly pull it out in dire situations, resulting in you no longer taking fall damage.

name: Acute Hearing
description: After years of using Echolocation, you've trained your ears to sense danger from even further away. You are also able to sense when someone completes a job.
additionalInfo: Your Echolocation now has a sound effect on proc.

name: From The Ashes
description: Using an Etris Flask when at 30% health or below now grants you a damage buff and resistance buff for 30 seconds.

name: Lone Wolf
description: Despite the loyalty of your allies, you recognize that you sometimes need to hunt alone. Deal more damage to targets who are only combat tagged by you.

name: Scales of the Edenkite
description: In order to resolve conflict in Lumen, you need to be able to handle any situation thrown at you. Activate your Scales to reduce all damage taken by 80% and de-aggro enemies briefly.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that lasts 5 seconds with a 3 minute cooldown. The deaggro effect only works in PvE, and is extremely ineffective, as most enemies will immediately reaggro. The deaggro effect does not work against bosses or in Depths Trials.

name: Scholar's Mark
description: You now are able to inflict yourself with a Mark. The duration of this scales with how many people you inflict with the effect as well.
additionalInfo: You can now use Capra Marks to buff yourself.

name: Largent
description: Your diplomatic skills extend into your ability to barter. Gain 300 extra notes per chest when turning in a sack.

name: Tailor Made
description: These were specifically made for your kind. Etris Flasks now heal you 45% more than usual.

name: Mothwing Defense
description: Further refining how sharp your antennae, you can now immediately recognize a sneak attack and brace yourself for it. Reduce all backhit damage by 50%.

name: Navae's Technique
description: A passed down technique from generations ago to refine your Ether control. Reduce how much ether it takes to cast mantras by 30%.

name: Innate Agility
description: You hinge on your instincts to keep you alive, even in battle. Slightly increase your dodge frames.

name: Retrograde
description: Your existence is... questionable. No one understands where you have come from. Your ability reflects this, activate to start your Retrograde timer. Activating the ability again will reverse your actions, with the cooldown scaling with the time.
additionalInfo: Gain a Talent tool that records your location, health, Ether, and posture on use. Upon using the tool again or waiting 5 seconds, you will be transferred back to your original location, restoring you back to the state and location you were at when this tool was initially used.

name: Depths Denizen
description: The city you once called home is now your only way out of the depths, perhaps you can use this to your advantage. Gain extra leeway when attempting to escape the depths.

name: Weapon's Training
description: Training with different weapons taught you how to wield all of them more proficiently. Gain slightly extra weapon scaling on all weapons you use.

name: Alloy of the Heavens
description: Posture attack from mobs reduced by 50%
additionalInfo: Reduces posture damage taken from mobs by 50%.

name: Deal Maker
description: Your rapport with merchants allows you to attach a flat fee of 20 notes to all your sales.
additionalInfo: This is unaffected by Snake Oil.

name: Know When To Run
description: Your magic coffin has a higher chance to draw depths loot, but the price is increased.
additionalInfo: Increases the price of using the Magic Coffin by 50% in exchange for adding the entire Depths lootpool to it.

name: Stack the Deck
description: Charmed enemies will grant you even more damage multipliers on your Taunt counter.

name: Soul Veil
description: Soulthorn now directly siphons the song of your enemies. Accumulating stacks and increasing your power. Perfect plays are encouraged.
additionalInfo: Each successful attack with the Soulthorn builds up stacks of Soul Veil, increasing your weapon damage by 7.5%. This caps at a 30% damage buff. If you take damage while Soul Veil is active, the opponent who hit you will steal your Soul Veil stacks until you hit them back. This can prove fatal.

name: Ambush
description: When coming out of Tacet, gain a 30% damage boost for 5 seconds.

name: Avaricious Blade
description: Every strike landed lines your pockets.
additionalInfo: Dealing damage by any means gives 1 Note, with backhits giving 50 Notes instead. This can proc on self damage.

name: Double Jump
description: Take the Wind Step and refine it into your own technique, reducing the cooldown and improving its efficiency.
additionalInfo: Reduces Wind Step's cooldown to 5 seconds and lowers the Ether cost. You will need to equip Gale Boots to gain the Wind Step Talent.

name: Fatal Backstab
description: Weapon backstabs deal an extra 5 true damage on your opponent (20 extra damage if done to PvE).

name: Lethal Depressant
description: Assassinating an opponent decreases the damage they deal by 25% for the next 30 seconds.

name: Rogue Assassin
description: Your assassinations now deal an extra 50 true damage (200 in PvE).

name: Terrifying Paralysis
description: Your Hidden Blade disables opponents' ability to roll for 3 seconds.

name: Total Silence
description: Massively reduce the sound of your footsteps and rolls.

name: True Skulk
description: Massively reduce the sounds of your mantra casts.

name: Weakening Venom
description: Assassinating an opponent decreases the damage they deal by 25% for the next 30 seconds.

name: Frostride
description: Your footsteps echo the legend of Saint Jay, freezing the sea beneath.
additionalInfo: You can now walk on water by creating ice below your feet. This has no cooldown and does not cost Ether.

name: Jay's Judgement Gavel
description: Breaking a frozen enemy free with your Critical saps their lifeforce.
additionalInfo: Landing your critical on a frozen or bottom frozen enemy will deal extra damage and heal you.

name: Rebuke in Stasis
description: Bottom freeze enemies nearby when countering with Punishment, freezes mobs affected when re-casted.
additionalInfo: Your Punishment will apply bottom freeze to mobs if you land the counter hit.

name: Verses of Harmony
description: Each elemental stance grants access to select talents from the corresponding attunement.
additionalInfo:
Gain access to the following Talents while in the respective Saint Stance. Upon swapping out of the Saint Stance, all granted Talents will be lost. Some of these Talents have an additional level requirement.
Flamecharm: Dancing Steps, Immolation, Agitating Spark
Frostdraw: Condensation Drip, Saint Jay, Frozen Legs, Fragile Freeze, Chilling Flourish
Galebreathe: Pressure Break, Wind Step, Air Pressure, Cyclone Blade, Inhale, A World Without Song
Shadowcast: Dark Rift, Lasting Sorrow, Dark God, Dark Hours, Shadow Overflow, Singularity
Thundercall: Static Fakeout, Stratoshock, Resolve Crusher, Static Blade, Gathering Electricity

name: Focused Perception
description: Massively increase the range of your Rhythm if you use it while Tranquil Circle is active.

name: Purge Shot
description: Landing an arc beam while your opponent has anti heal stacks purges the stacks, with it dealing 5 true damage for every stack they had.
additionalInfo: Landing Arc Beam removes all stacks of anti-heal from your opponent, dealing 5 true damage for every stack they had.

name: Scornful Scowl
description: Your Glare stuns enemies for much longer.

name: Unmended Eye
description: All mantras you land now apply anti heal.

name: Dancer's Beat
description: Your Vent is replaced with Dancer's Beat. You increase the speed, damage, and stun of your next Basic Attack. However, should your attack fail to land, you'll be stunned and your Tempo will be greatly reduced.
additionalInfo: Your Vent can no longer be used defensively, unless it is used to escape an otherwise inescapable move, but does not cost Tempo to use. You need to have at least 20 Tempo to use Dancer's Beat. Your next M1 used within 1 second of using Dancer's Beat will deal higher damage, more stun, and have a higher swing speed. If you are hit before you use your next attack, wait out the 1 second proc window, or if your next attack does not land (including if it was blocked, parried, or dodged), you will lose 60 Tempo and will be stunned for 0.5 seconds. 2.5 second cooldown.

name: Dancer's Geas
description: You deal +30% damage when striking with the tip of your weapon, but deal 15% less damage when striking below half of its range.
additionalInfo: Also procs on weapon criticals. When you land an attack from the tip of your weapon, an icon of a pair of hands clapping will appear, signifying that you've activated the buff. When you land an attack from half or less than half of your weapon's range, an icon of a thumbs down will appear, signifying that you were debuffed.

name: Dancer's Impale
description: Hitting an enemy after a perfect dodge makes your next attack deal 30% bleed damage. If that attack would already bleed, it adds +10% chip damage instead.

name: Dancer's Sting
description: Striking with the tip of your weapon applies +25% PEN and +25% Chip Damage.

name: Ga Buidhe
description: Backstabs now count as the tip of your weapon.
additionalInfo: Attacking your opponent's back now procs all Talents and effects that would normally proc when attacking with the tip of your weapon.

name: Ga Dearg
description: Striking a bleeding enemy with the tip of your weapon extends the bleed.
additionalInfo: Hitting a bleeding enemy with the tip of your weapon will reapply the bleed.

name: Kick the Beat
description: Dancer's Beat now works with Critical Attacks.

name: Not My Tempo
description: Dancer's Beat grants Hyperarmor.

name: Two Left Feet
description: Posture breaking an opponent grants you +50% PEN for 3 seconds.
additionalInfo: 14 second cooldown.

name: Ignition Rite
description: Landing fire attacks with the phoenix summoned regenerates Heartfire.

name: Heartfire Renewal
description: Regenerate Heartfire whenever you are burning. Upon revival with Phoenix Flames, restore half of your Heartfire gauge.

name: Solborn
description: Harness your Heartfire to command the Phoenix bound to your soul.
additionalInfo: Spawns a small orange, stationary, Phoenix near you. The size of the Phoenix will increase based on the user's level. This Phoenix can be used like a campfire to rest and heal yourself.

name: Explosive Ignition
description: Ignite nearby steam, causing a large explosion.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool, that when used while standing inside of a steam cloud causes a very large explosion after a delay, dealing high damage and consuming the Steam cloud.

name: Mist Mobility
description: Anytime you proc Boiling Point, increase the speed at which you reload your Vapormaw Carbine and increase your Critical Attack's fire rate.
additionalInfo: Despite what the description states, this actually procs when you activate Flashboil, and not Boiling Point.

name: Steampunk Soldier
description: Increase the size of your steam which you activate Flashboil. Flashboil's cooldown is also reduced.

name: Alloy Siphon
description: Iron Pull siphons armor from your foes, restoring your posture.

name: Steelvessel
description: Landed attacks deal posture damage but when guard broken take massive damage. Posture gain on parry is reduced.
additionalInfo: Take posture damage instead of health damage. Upon being guardbroken, take a large amount of damage to your healthbar. Your healing and posture restoration from parrying attacks is reduced.

name: Magic Coffin
description: A jack of all trades, all attribute requirements are ignored. Activate your Coffin with C.
additionalInfo: Activating your Coffin takes 50 Notes. This Note cost will increase by 50 per Power, costing 1,000 Notes at Power 20. When used, the Coffin acts like a loot box, randomly rolling an item to give you. There is a 1% chance to grant the Skull, giving you high tier loot. This chance is increased by 1% per level, up to 20% at power 20. There is a 5-10% chance to roll a blank, doubling the chest of the next box. This can stack. Coffin activation uses your Resonance keybind. You can use any weapon or equipment item without meeting their attribute requirements.

name: True Mirage Clone
description: Successfully dodging leaves behind a heat mirage clone that sets enemies that swung at you on fire.
additionalInfo: 20 second cooldown.

name: Spark of Theros
description: Your Thundercall is imbued with the spark of Theros, altering its appearance and properties.
additionalInfo: Turns your Thundercall white and changes your Shock to Blightshock, applying Wither to affected targets.

name: Storm Return
description: Being under lightning/wind status effect causes your Basic Attacks and Criticals to do 10% more damage. (Amplified with Lightning Cloak)
additionalInfo: Being under the effects of Amped or Lightning Cloak will proc this effect.

name: Compelling Offer
description: Any charmed enemy below 50% hit with your mantras or critical will mysteriously begin attacking everyone but you. [Madness] Your taunt also now functions as a counter that stacks damage multipliers with every successful taunt.
additionalInfo: Madness from this Talent procs when attacking charmed enemies who are below 50% health. Using Taunt as a counter displays Prediction's visual effects but with a dark purple color. This also plays a laughing sound effect and reduces Taunt's cooldown to 1 second. Taunt counter does not deal damage, but instead stacks Taunt's damage buff effect.

name: Jackpot
description: Charmed enemies now have a chance to be hit critically, multiplying the damage.

name: Sweeten the Deal
description: Madness can now be applied to enemies at 80% health or lower.

name: Taunting Tongue
description: Your taunt now applies Madness.

name: Voice of the Mad God
description: Any time you apply charm it now applies "Madness" to enemies directly.

name: Precision Hitter
description: Your Basic Attack posture damage is increased by 15%.

name: Void Glutton
description: Siphon some of your enemies ether when you kill them. This gets added onto your health permanently, however you are now slowed at all times. This slow increases the more health you have siphoned.
additionalInfo: Gives 2 maximum health when you kill a player. You will also be slowed, with the slow being based on how much maximum health you've siphoned.

name: Dark Harvest
description: Steal all of the hunger of enemies caught in your Shadow Vortex. Knocking a player also greatly enhances your next Shadow Vortex.

name: Erupting Shade
description: The size of your shadow eruption increases with how much siphoned health you have gained from wiping players.

name: Ether Repletion
description: Hunger stolen from other players now grants you ether as well.
additionalInfo: Hunger stolen from players through any means will proc this Talent.

name: Hearty Ether
description: Devouring Eye steal procs now heal you based on the amount of ether stolen.

name: Null Recovery
description: Sacrifice 20% of your hunger bar to recover 10% of your health back.

name: Pleeksty's Inheritance
description: You inherit the teachings of Amorus Pleeksty, augmenting your flamecharm mantras.
additionalInfo: Makes your Flamecharm Mantras extremely loud.

name: Blade Threading
description: Your Metal Greatsword now has Metal Fakeout as its critical attack. Landing Critical attacks applies metal rod and slow.
additionalInfo: The Metal Fakeout critical will only be used while you are in targeting range. Additionally, this attack has innate Bleed and counts as a weapon attack, not a Mantra.

name: Hex Bullet
description: Bullets that hit your opponents block shatter into dust on impact, unleashing a maddening smoke that increases your opponent's sanity.

name: Monster Slayer
description: Deal 25% more damage to giant enemies.

name: Night Night
description: Uppercut attacks blind opponents for 15 seconds.

name: Reforged Alloy
description: Anytime you consume iron rods using Metal Pull or any Rending Needle technique, reduce the cooldown of your next critical based on the amount of rods consumed.

name: Reverse Necrosis
description: Landing any mantra will now heal you based on how slow your opponent is.

name: Sadistic Split
description: Guardbreaking your opponent now heals you. The amount of this heal is based on how much insanity your character currently has.

name: Shatter
description: Landing a critical shatters your opponent, ridding them of their speed debuffs for 5 frost damage per debuff.
additionalInfo: Landing a critical attack removes all speed debuffs your opponent has, dealing 5 Frostdraw damage per debuff.

name: Analyze
description: Marking enemies with your Callout analyzes them, making them take 20% more damage from all sources for 10 seconds.
additionalInfo: 45 second cooldown.

name: Beginner's Luck
description: Slightly increase the amount of loot you find in chests.

name: Blend In
description: You resemble one of the Enforcers, become unnoticeable by regular depths mobs.
additionalInfo: Most monsters in the Depths will be neutral you while you have this equipment on.

name: Blood Siphon
description: Your Critical Attack now siphons a bit of health, healing you 10% of the damage you dealt.

name: Clutch
description: For every combat tag you acquire, gain 4% more posture resistance.

name: Conditioning
description: Reduce all slows you receive by 40%.

name: Cursed Immortality
description: Instead of getting knocked, get set to 75% health. When this effect occurs, this guarantees that you depths trial will become corrupted for the rest of your character's run.
additionalInfo: Instead of being knocked, your health will be set to 75% of its maximum instead, with a 5 minute cooldown. Once this Talent procs, all future Depths trials will automatically be corrupted for the rest of your character's life. This Talent does not proc during the Zi'eer boss fight.

name: Emergency Rations
description: Eat some of your emergency rations, healing you for 20 health. You can only use this 3 times before having to sit at a campfire outside of combat again.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool with 3 charges. Using the Talent tool consumes one of the charges to heal you for 20 flat health. This has a 15 second cooldown. Resting at a campfire, while not in combat, restores all charges

name: Ether Efficiency
description: All mantras you cast now have a reduced cost of 30 ether.

name: Ether Upgrade
description: All mantras you cast now get one bonus level on top of their current level.

name: Experienced Healer
description: Everytime you heal yourself, gain 5 extra health on top of that.
additionalInfo: 10 second cooldown.

name: Fictitious Force
description: Reduce the power of all speed boosts you gain by 50%. Deal extra true damage based on how fast you are.
additionalInfo: Halves the effectiveness of all speed boosts. Adds true damage to your attacks, with the true damage scaling on your speed boosts and momentum.

name: Flare Drop
description: Landing mantras sets your opponent on fire.
additionalInfo: Applies burn when you land a Mantra with a 5 second cooldown.

name: Flask Amplifier
description: Heal an extra 15% from flasks.
additionalInfo: Increases the healing gained from Etris Flasks by 15% additively, meaning Flasks will restore 65% health on use instead of 50%.

name: Gale Boots
description: Reduce the amount of fall damage you take by 50%.

name: Gunslinger's Fury
description: When having a side gun equipped with a gun or rifle, use a critical in the air to shoot a barrage of bullets towards your opponent.
additionalInfo: If your main weapon is a Pistol or a Rifle, and you have an offhand Pistol equipped, your critical will be replaced with the Soulwrought Gun's special attack if used midair.

name: Haste
description: Gain a permanent +3 speed buff at all times.
additionalInfo: Increases your movement speed by +3 studs per second. This does not count as a speed boost for Talent procs.

name: Hellion Shift
description: The more insane you are the more iframes you gain on your dodge.

name: Heretic's Sacrifice
description: A chant that heavily sacrifices your sanity to regain a bit of health.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that drains a significant amount of sanity to heal 20 raw health. If you are already at 0 Sanity, you will still be healed at no downside.

name: Iron Stance
description: Be able to shrug off being ragdolled every so often.
additionalInfo: Grants immunity to one instance of ragdoll. If this procs, it will go on a 20 second cooldown.

name: Navae's Conviction
description: All Navaen related combat weapons are empowered.

name: Natural Healing
description: Every time you eat plants, heal 2% of your health.
additionalInfo: "Plants" refers to any plant-based food item.

name: Omen
description: Your Shadow Travel now has no windup and always requires health to teleport.

name: Pace
description: Hitting opponents apply a speed boost. The faster you are the less damage you take.
additionalInfo: Grants damage reduction based on the combined potency on all speed boosts you have. Landing attacks grants a speed boost.

name: Piercing Shot
description: Activate to make your next critical attack with any gun have 100% chip and shatter your opponent's armor for a few seconds, making them take increased PEN from all sources.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool, that on use, enhances your next critical attack used with any Rifle or Pistol. Enhanced critical attacks gain 100% chip damage and apply the Pierced Armor status effect to your opponent, increasing incoming PEN for a few seconds.

name: Poisoned Knife
description: Your Deepwound's anti heal now lasts 60 seconds on assassination instead of 20.

name: Pyreborne
description: Your Flamecharm mantras have all stats amplified.
additionalInfo: Increases the base damage of all Flamecharm Mantras by 30%.

name: Risky Defense
description: Decrease how much posture damage you take from physical attacks by 25%, but take 50% more posture damage from mantras.
additionalInfo: Increases incoming posture damage from Mantras by 50%. Decreases incoming posture damage from weapon attacks by 25%.

name: Royal Charge
description: When landing a running attack while using a club to gain a bit of temp health.
additionalInfo: Running attacks with Club weapons grant Temporary Health. 20 second cooldown.

name: Safety First
description: At the start of fights, gain 25% damage resistance for 30 seconds.

name: Sky Aid
description: Take 80% less damage while in the air.

name: Slick
description: Coat of the infamous thief Emiya Konga. Improves the user's sliding abilities. This effect stacks with Konga's Clutch Ring.

name: Steel Grip
description: When you are blockbroken, negate it and set your posture to 80%.
additionalInfo: 90 second cooldown.

name: Tempo Sap
description: Activate to make your dagger's light attacks steal tempo per hit for 20 seconds. [Dagger]
additionalInfo: 1 minute cooldown.

name: Tenacity
description: Greatly shorten the amount of time you are guardbroken for.
additionalInfo: Reduces the stun duration from being guardbroken by 75%; from 1.05s to 0.26s.

name: The Rich Get Richer
description: Gain 15% more notes whenever you sell something.

name: Vessel's Gamble
description: When you get guardbroken you take 3 times the damage of the attack.
additionalInfo: Though this Talent is actively detrimental to the user, the Corrupted Vessel's Boots +20 Posture offsets the downside.

name: Weather Resistant
description: Take 30% less damage when under less than ideal weather conditions.

name: Explosive Rounds
description: Every bullet that lands now detonates on your opponent.

name: Hunting Trap
description: Place down a trap that upon being stepped on will render your opponent unable to move for a bit.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that places a bear trap on use. 60 second cooldown. Walking onto a bear trap deals high damage and renders you immobile for a few seconds. The bear trap cannot trigger again once it has been triggered. You can trigger your own bear trap.

name: Overdrive
description: Go beyond your limits. All mantras you cast deal twice as much damage for 10 seconds.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that doubles the damage of your Mantras for 10 seconds. 3 minute cooldown.

name: Rush
description: Massively reduce your dodge cooldown.

name: Training Wheels
description: Increase the amount of parry frames you have by 20%.

name: Unyielding Frost
description: Your Chilled can proc through block, with blocked Chilled procs lasting 80% of the duration.
additionalInfo: If you have less than 100 Frostdraw, your Chill duration (when applied through block) will be reduced down to 25% of its original duration instead.

name: Unyielding Inferno
description: Your flames burn just as strong even in the fiercest of storms.
additionalInfo: Negates the innate 10% damage debuff Flamecharm Mantras, First Light's critical, and Twisted Puppets' Puppets receive during the rain. Prevents your burn from being extinguished by the rain.

name: Oath: Saltchemist
description: You vow to dedicate body and mind to the furthering of the Material Arts. Your body is a conduit through which true knowledge shall be siphoned. Knowledge is power, and you shall be its vessel.

name: Swiftkick Prodigy
