description: Hitting successive Basic Attacks with Jus Karita will give a temporary speed buff.
additionalInfo: Your third M1 will grant a speed boost for a short duration.

name: Ankle Cutter
description: You can now do a special ground slash while sliding, applying a temporary speed debuff to those hit, as well as preventing jumping.
additionalInfo: Deals 37.5 Oath damage. If in Flow State, this is increased to 52.5 and the windup is reduced. Has innate bleed. 6 second cooldown.

name: Piercing Will
description: When your sanity is below 35%, gain up to +15% PEN on your attacks. Starting at 5% PEN, the lower your sanity, the higher your PEN.
additionalInfo: Grants a 10% PEN bonus at full insanity despite what the description states. The bonus PEN is applied starting from 35% Sanity.

name: Ancient Metalwork
description: Your critical hit can channel the effects of your Ironsing Rods and disrupt the resonances of others, disabling them for 25 seconds.
additionalInfo: Landing your weapon critical puts your opponent's Resonance on a 25 second cooldown.

name: Both Ends
description: Pressing M2 after landing a light attack with the staff performs a follow-up swing from the opposite end.
additionalInfo: The followup attack has fast swing speed, but it only deals 45% of your weapon damage.

name: Counter Spin
description: After blocking an attack, press M2 to counter with your staff.
additionalInfo: On proc, swiftly thrust your Staff forwards, dealing 45% of your weapon's damage on hit.

name: Breakthrough Drive
description: Knocking a player refreshes your Glorious Charge cooldown and extends both effects it has by 5 seconds. [90 second CD]

name: Slider Style
description: Raise the cap of how fast you are able to slide. Your Jus Karita fighting style gains a new sliding crit. Its power stems from how fast you are sliding when using the critical attack.

name: Stasis Strike
description: Your crystal explosions deal more damage whenever your opponent is also bottom frozen.
additionalInfo: Stasis Strike increases the damage of your crystal explosions by 1.67x when your opponent is bottom frozen.

name: Decisive Blow
description: Hitting an enemy with your Critical Attack immediately after they dodge (or any time against mobs) now procs Knife's Journey. Your Knife's Journey procs do 2x Armor damage.

name: Karita Combo
description: Remove the endlag from your next running attack. [5 second CD] Landing a critical attack right after your running attack makes that critical attack have no cooldown and deal more damage. [10 second CD]

name: Righteous Crash
description: Slamming down your opponent in the air with a flourish or your upgraded Vanguard Jus Karita critical deals extra true damage based on high up in the air they were.

name: Swiftkick Master
description: Proccing Swiftkick Prodigy now extends its duration to 15 seconds.

name: Soaring Swiftkick
description: Flying Swiftkick no longer consumes your speed boost and instead gives you more speed.

name: Vanguard Style
description: When using the Jus Karita critical attack, turn it into a kick that brings your enemies up in the air. Landing the critical attack while your opponent is in the air brings them up and slightly stun them while upgrading your next critical.
additionalInfo: This new critical attack has 20 base damage with no investment scaling.

name: Vanguard's Onslaught
description: Landing a Vanguard Style Jus Karita critical attack makes you deal 20% more damage in the air for the next 5 seconds.

name: Justicar's Mark
description: Mark someone you wish to protect for a minute. While marked, you take 20% of the damage they receive but they take 20% less damage. Marking someone also cause you to take 20% more damage while they are marked.
additionalInfo: Grants a Talent tool that allows you to apply the Justicar's Mark status effect on one of your allies. While this effect is active, the marked target gains 20% damage redirection, as 20% of the damage they would have taken is redirected to you instead. Additionally, you take 20% more damage.

name: Kindness
description: Whenever you heal another player, heal 5 health yourself.
additionalInfo: 3 second cooldown.

name: Righteous Violence
description: Landing a Critical Attack heals your marked ally. Landing a Jus Karita critical or Karita Swap heals your marked ally even more.

name: Mark Mastery
description: Reduce the amount of extra damage you receive while your ally is marked with the Justicar's Mark from 20% to 5%.
additionalInfo: Reduces the additional damage you take from marking an ally from 20% to 5%.

name: Justicar's Blessing
description: Allies you mark with Justicar's Mark gain 15% more healing.

name: Emergency Mark
description: Applying a mark on someone who has less than 20% health heals them for 10% of their health.
additionalInfo: Applying a Justicar's Mark on an ally who has 20% or less current health health them for 10% of their maximum health.

name: Trained Legs
description: Slightly increase your climb strength.
additionalInfo: Increases your maximum climb height.

name: Swiftfoot
description: Reduce all slows you receive by 10%.

name: Marked Descent
description: When your Justicar's Mark target takes damage, they are revealed. Using your Karita Divebomb will target them.
additionalInfo: Targets the enemy who hit your marked ally, not the marked ally themselves.

name: Justicar's Preference
description: Replace your critical with the Jus Karita critical attack.
additionalInfo:
The Jus Karita critical will adopt your equipped weapon's scaling stat.

Having the Vanguard Style Talent will override this Talent, allowing you to use the Vanguard Style critical on any weapon instead of the default Jus Karita one.

name: Justicar's Adaptation
description: Jus Karita running attacks and criticals can now proc Jus Karita talents even if you aren't currently using Jus Karita. Your Jus Karita running attacks can now also proc fist talents.
additionalInfo: This Talent synergizes extremely well with Justicar's Preference and Justicar's Technique, allowing you to proc the effects of this Talent on any weapon.

name: Justicar's Technique
description: Replace your running light attack with the Jus Karita running light attack. With the Justicar's Training, your legs extend the range of this running attack by an extra 0.5.
additionalInfo: Replaces your weapon's running attack animation with the Jus Karita one, and adds 0.5 range to your running attacks.

name: Justicar's Gift
description: Your Justicar support mantras now heal your allies for 10 health instead of 5. Increase the duration of your Karita Aid to 15 seconds.

name: Unstoppable Force
description: [Greathammer] You take 15% less posture damage when parried.

name: Vacuum Punch
description: Your Gale Punch pulls enemies in before you hit them.
additionalInfo: Gale Punch Mantra will now pull players towards the user during the windup of the Mantra. Increases Gale Punch's windup by 0.1s.

name: Scorchblood
description: Guardbreaking your opponent using a bloodrend mantra causes a blood explosion, setting your opponent on fire and poisoning their blood.
additionalInfo: Deals 16.5 damage in an AoE on proc.

name: Dark Replenishment
description: Knocking out an enemy in combat restores a portion of your ether.

name: Strength Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Strength to its fullest.
additionalInfo: Removes the 75 investment cap on the Strength Attribute. The stat requirements to obtain this Talent will be increased to 77 or 78 if your Aspect has increased Strength on spawn, though this limitation will be removed if you have the Multifaceted Echo Unlock. The quest requirement for this Talent will be removed if you've obtained it previously on your account.

name: Beiruul's Vengeance
description: Deal 5% more damage to factions that despise you. Serves them right.

name: Another Man's Trash
description: Take unequipped equipment when mugging a player. Gain a little more damage against PvE the more you are currently carrying.
additionalInfo: If the player you are mugging doesn't have any Notes, you will still take any unequipped equipment. You cannot steal Soulbound or Enchanted items. Gain +0.001% damage for every 1 Weight you're carrying. Every 100 Weight = +1% damage.

name: Mantra Permanence
description: Knocking an enemy with a mantra refunds the cost of the mantra.

name: Ironclad Punishment
description: Your Ironsing mantras deal more posture damage to enemies the more armor durability they have.
additionalInfo: Gain +0.15% posture damage on Ironsing Mantras for every 1% armor durability your opponent has, capping at +15% if your opponent is at maximum armor.

name: Ether Proselyte
description: All of your Elemental Mantras below Lv. 5 are now 1 level higher. Your Mantras are now converted to the element of your current stance.
additionalInfo: Increases the level of all Attuned Mantras by 1 unless they are already level 5. This is not displayed on the Mantra's tooltip. Allows your non-Ironsing/Bloodrend Attuned Mantras to proc the Attunement Talents of your current Saint Stance. (E.g. Clutching Shadow in the Flamecharm Stance can proc Scorched Peak). Not all Attuned Talents are compatible with Ether Proselyte.

name: Hero's Assist
description: Heroes come to your aid based on your current stance.
additionalInfo: Each Saint has a specific spawn requirement and ability when spawned. You can spawn heroes independent of your current Saint Stance. This passive ability works once per Saint Stance, requiring you to cycle to the next one to reactivate.

name: Perpetual Distillery
description: Your very body has become a distillery for your alchemy. Gain 3 Autobrew slots that will automatically produce 3 concoctions of your choice.
additionalInfo: Upon using the Distillery's Talent tool, you're given three empty spaces where you input your potions. You're able to switch the mode from "Throw" to "Drink", and vice versa. Each potion in the Distillery will be given as a Talent tool, using the potion on use. Potions in the Distillery go on cooldown when used. Drink potions place other drink slots on a cooldown if they share buffs.

name: Unnecessary Theatrics
description: Deliver a one-liner on uppercuts, flourishes and critical attacks that charms your opponents briefly.
additionalInfo: The charm proc has no cooldown, but the one-liners do. Instantly reapplies Charm after Manipulator removes it, on the same hit.

name: Bulletproof
description: You take no Armor damage from guns. You take 5% less Armor damage from other sources.
additionalInfo: This has no effect on your natural armor or incoming PEN.

name: Oh The Irony
description: Opponents affected by 'Taunt' receive double iron rods for the duration.

name: Taste The Rainbow
description: Every time you shoot, switch your ammo type. [Dual Guns]

name: Rule Through Fear
description: Executing an enemy applies Overcharm to nearby allies and yourself.
additionalInfo: Overcharms for 10 seconds.

name: Merciless Blade
description: Increases your Execution speed by 40%.
additionalInfo: Reduces the time it takes to successfully Execute down to 1.8 seconds from 3 seconds.

name: Stratoshock
description: Your lightning deals an additional +5% damage when in the rain.
additionalInfo: All sources of Thundercall damage innately gains a 5% damage buff if it is raining. This Talent adds an additional 5%.

name: Apparitions
description: Your Haunted Phantoms become Apparitions that apply Winded on hit. Apparitions cannot be parried if you are in Phantom Step.
additionalInfo: Apparitions can only spawn from Haunted Gale being procced on Galebreathe Mantras or by proccing effects that would normally apply Suffocation.

name: Donation Drive
description: Consuming 'Charm' on an opponent replenishes some blood. Additionally, you can also activate this effect and Manipulator through blockbreaking with a Bloodrend mantra.
additionalInfo: Donation Drive's cooldown scales on your Charisma investment, having an 8 second cooldown at 60 Charisma and gaining 0.1s for every point in Charisma below 60. Donation Drive has a 8.5 second cooldown at 55 Charisma, and a maximum cooldown of 10.5 seconds at 35 Charisma.

name: Fried Circuits
description: Overloading an enemy applies Sapped for 5s.
additionalInfo: Targets affected by Sapped have the cooldowns of their Mantras increased.

name: Enrage
description: Whenever you stun an opponent who's taunted with Encore, enrage them.

objectives: Wipe with the Strange Merchant Memento

name: Justicar Whistle
description: Request aid from a Justicar.
additionalInfo: Upon using the provided Talent tool, a Justicar may respond to your call for aid, teleporting to your server to assist you with events and protect you in combat. If you are a Lone Warrior or Deepbound, you will lose access to the Whistle at Power 16.

name: Justicar's Call
description: Lend your aid to those in need.
additionalInfo: Upon using the provided Talent tool, a UI will pop up that shows a list of all Castaways who have used the Justicar Whistle tool. Upon selecting one, you'll teleport into their server, and you'll be tasked with protecting them against Voidwalkers and assisting them in events. Assisting Castaways with this tool is the main progression method of this Origin.

name: Sacred Aura
description: Landing your Sacred Hammer critical attack applies an aura of protection around you, reducing the damage you take by a flat 2.5, multiplying based on how many combat tags you currently have on you.

name: Continuous Bleed
description: Every time you land a crit, flourish, or uppercut, increase the amount of bleed damage you deal for 15 seconds. This is stackable.
additionalInfo: Reduces your bleed damage per tick by 5%, while adding an additional bleed damage tick per stack. This results in a net increase of ~26.7% more bleed damage for the first stack, with slightly diminishing returns for every stack you gain. Each stack has an independant duration, and stack gain has a 1.5 second cooldown.

name: Rage Amp
description: At 2 or more combat tags, your critical now applies anti-heal while also increases the size and damage of your critical. This scales with the amount of combat tags you have.

name: Ebb and Flow
description: Landing a medium mantra increases your heavy mantra's level by 1 and vice versa. This is stackable and can increased to a max of +5 levels. All stacks are removed if your medium/heavy mantra is defended against.

name: Spinal Shatter
description: Landing the Crescent Cleaver critical attack causes your opponent to be unable to sprint for 8 seconds. [10 second CD]

name: Mudskipper Gripper
description: When executing an opponent with your critical attack, summon mudskippers to aid you in battle.

name: Terrapod Tracer
description: Deal 0.5% of your opponent's health to opponents who heal off of you.
additionalInfo: This only works while your opponent has Anti-Heal.

name: Broodlord's Scream
description: Using Sing, Taunt, or Ardour Scream applies anti heal for the duration of the move.
additionalInfo: Applies 100% Anti-Heal. These abilities will also gain the Broodlord Scream sound effect.

name: Overflow
description: Double the amount of tempo you receive when landing light attacks.

name: Cruentare
description: Increase the amount of all bleed damage you deal by 50%. Your Whirling Blade now now heals you when landing it.
additionalInfo: You heal for 25% of the damage your Whirling blades deals.

name: Scorching Decay
description: The wither dealt from your Emperor's Flame is massively increased.
additionalInfo: Increases the Wither applied from Emperor Flame from 25 to 75.

name: Mythic Stability
description: Players and regular mobs cannot instantly execute you while you're on your feet. Protects you from one instance of instant execution while Unconscious.
additionalInfo: 1 minute cooldown.

name: Mercenary Blade
description: For every 10% stealth you have, deal 1 extra damage on all sources of damage.

name: Stay of Execution
description: Increases the time taken to execute you by 20%. Saving others from being executed grants you both 10 TempHP (20s CD)

name: Cook's Kit
description: Each food item's max quantity is increased by 5. Your kit comes with a lighter.
additionalInfo: You can light Campfires without a Flint.

name: Chemistry Kit
description: You no longer drop potions on death. You have a 25% chance to brew an extra potion.

name: Max Ammo
description: Landing the cannonball of your critical attack removes your critical attack's cooldown.

name: Scammer
description: If your opponent tries to parry the fake hit of your critical attack, your critical attack will inflict a stronger daze upon your opponent.

name: Blade Scholar
description: Landing your fist critical attack switches your stance to that fist style. Retain the same swing speed and damage your Markor's Inheritor had. You gain more swingspeed the more Intelligence you have.
additionalInfo: Upon landing your critical, your weapon will swap to Iron Cestus/Anklets of Alsin for 15 seconds, retaining the base damage and swing speed of your Markor's Inheritor. Your investment scaling will be set to 7 Heavy Weapons (unaffected by Alloying your Inheritor), and 2 Intelligence while active. For every 1 Intelligence investment you have, gain an additional +0.002x swing speed while your weapon is Fists, allowing for 1.05x at 100 Intelligence. As this changes your weapon type, you will be able to proc Fist Talents while this effect is active. Enchantments carry over, but quality stars do not. If you do not have a Fist Style, you will equip Untrained Fists, which deals halved damage.

name: One With Flame
description: When equipping a Worshipper Longsword and Worshipper Shield, you take 25% less damage while on fire and every mantra you use sets enemies on fire.
additionalInfo: These effects only apply while you are burning. Also turns your Medium Weapon Mantras orange and adds Flamecharm scaling to your Belief while active.

name: Devastating Recovery
description: Enemies recover 30% less posture when parrying your Zweihander light attacks.

name: Sweeping Edge
description: Your Master's Flourish is larger and can now proc flourish talents.

name: To The Finish
description: You take 10% less damage when below 30% health.
additionalInfo: For every point of Fortitude below 50, To the Finish loses 0.166% damage reduction, having a minimum value of 5.833% damage reduction at 25 Fortitude.

name: Good Luck Charm
description: Makes you feel a little better, probably.

name: Worshipper's Tolerance
description: Reduce the burn damage you take by 15%. While on fire, parrying an opponent's attack now sets them on fire [45 second CD].

name: Swift Blade
description: Proccing Wind Gem now gives you 10% more light attack posture during its duration. Extend the duration of Wind Gems by 2 seconds.

name: Momentum
description: Speed boosts now give you a bit of extra chip based on how fast the speed boosts are making you.

name: Dancing Steps Of War
description: When landing a flourish, gain a speed boost and massively reduce the cooldown of your dodges for 2 seconds.

name: Blind Spot
description: [Land Critical Attack or Hidden Blade] Apply Blinded for 5 seconds.
additionalInfo: 15 second cooldown.

name: Thresher Thrasher
description: Adapt to the ways of the thresher, increasing how long you are able to stay underground with Beast Burrow by 30%, and reducing its cooldown by 25%.

name: Traditional Execution
description: Flourishing an opponent turns your next critical attack into the Katana critical attack. Also extends Dancing Steps Of War's effects by 0.5 seconds.

name: Champion's Shield
description: Deal an extra 25% more posture. Deal even more posture the more posture you have.
additionalInfo: Grants a +25% Posture damage buff. Additionally, grants a further Posture damage buff, scaling on the amount of Posture your character has.

name: Propagandist
description: Your Sing will now stir your allies into a frenzy, causing them to become Overcharmed for 15s, applying Charmed to enemies they hit with Basic Attacks.

name: Gut Rot
description: Landing a flourish enhances your next instance of anti-heal, doubling its duration for how long it lasts.

name: Second Nature
description: Ardour Scream no longer consumes ether and now instead adds 10 seconds to its cooldown.

name: Rotten Regeneration
description: Heal 20% more off enemies who have anti-heal on them.
additionalInfo: Grants increased offensive healing, such as from Bloodless Gems, when targeting enemies who are afflicted with Anti-Heal.

name: Continuation
description: Everytime you swing your weapon, fire a series of slashes forward after that act as another light attack when landing.
additionalInfo: Light attacks fire projectiles that count as light attacks for other effects. This massively improves the weapon's range.

name: Extension
description: For every hit you land with Rangescraper, extend the weapons range by 1 for 8 seconds. This effect stacks.

name: Elemental Mentalist
description: Empower your Overcharm, allowing you and your allies to bring forth your high stat attunement's elemental effect into your light attacks when overcharmed.
additionalInfo: Applies to criticals with the M1 tag. When Overcharming yourself, your light attacks apply the status effect that correlates with your highest invested Attunement. When Overcharming your allies, their light attacks apply the the status effect that correlates to their highest invested Attunement. Does nothing if the Overcharmed party does not have an Attunement.

name: Sclerosteosis
description: Anytime you lose 10% of your health in one hit, reduce the next instance of damage you take by 99%. [5 sec CD]
additionalInfo: You need to take 10% of your maximum health as damage in a singular instance of damage for this effect to activate. The damage resistance is only applied when you get hit by weapon attacks or Mantras. Self damage can proc this effect.

name: Camaraderie
description: Landing a critical attack reduce your allies' mantra cooldowns by 5 seconds and heals them 1%. [1 sec CD]

name: Swiftscales
description: Fang and Coil's base critical gains a small buff to its speed, range and endlag.
additionalInfo: The increased range is telegraphed with a green version of the Fang and Coil critical vfx.

name: Thread Ripper
description: When used by a Contractor, your Critical is empowered to eviscerate your opponents.
additionalInfo: If the player is a Contractor, the Palace Tachi critical will autogrip knocked or low health targets.
